OneClipboard is a collection of collaborative apps to automatically sync clipboards on remote devices. This is the server part. It has no knowledge-of or access-to any clipboards, it simply relays text between connected clients.

fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.name: PDF Inspector
fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.summary: Inspect, select, edit and delete the elements inside any PDF
fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.description:
PDF Inspector opens a PDF and shows what is actually inside it. Like a browser's developer tools, it parses each page's content stream into a navigable tree of elements (text blocks, vector paths and images) so you can find any single element, select it on the page or in the tree, and edit it. Edits go to a saved copy; your original file is never touched.
Highlights:
* DevTools-style element tree: every page is parsed into a structured tree of text, path and image nodes, grouped the way the PDF draws them. Switch between friendly labels and the raw content-stream operators.
* Two-way selection: tap an element on the page or tap its row in the tree, and the other side highlights to match, with a clear bordered outline on the canvas.
* Edit in place: move and resize an element, recolor its fill or stroke (entered as hex, with the element's color space shown), and retype text. When the original font lacks a character, re-encode the line with a fallback font, bundled or taken from your device or imported. Changes are written straight back into the content stream, with full undo and redo.
* Surgical delete: remove exactly the element you picked by rewriting just its part of the content stream, leaving the rest of the page untouched.
* Save a copy: write your edited PDF to a new file through the system file picker; the source document is left unchanged.
* Smooth viewing: pan and pinch-zoom, fit to width or height, a global zoom that carries across pages, and a full-screen mode.
* Dockable inspector: the inspector panel docks to the side in landscape or the bottom in portrait, can be resized, and can be made transparent to see the page through it.
* Material You: Material 3 design with dynamic color on Android 12+, light / dark / system themes and a choice of accent colors.
Private and open:
* Open source, no accounts, no telemetry.
* No network access and no storage permission: files are opened and saved through Android's Storage Access Framework, so the app only ever touches the documents you explicitly pick.
PDF Inspector works with the drawing primitives a PDF already contains: select, move, resize, recolor, retype and delete them. It is not a word-processor-style text editor, so lines do not reflow, but when the original font is missing a character you can re-encode the text with a fallback font, bundled or taken from your device or imported.

fdroid:com.furthersecrets.chemsearch.name: ChemSearch
fdroid:com.furthersecrets.chemsearch.summary: Search compounds, structures, reference and use practical chemistry tools.
fdroid:com.furthersecrets.chemsearch.description:
ChemSearch is an open-source chemistry reference and utility app for Android. Search compounds, inspect structures, browse offline references, and use practical chemistry tools all in one place.
SEARCH
Search PubChem by name, CAS number, formula, CID, or structure. Includes autosuggestions, spelling matches, caching, and specific error diagnostics.
Advanced Search filters by elements (included/excluded), molecular weight, charge, 3D data, GHS hazards, and name text. Result pages provide identifiers, structures, safety data, synonyms, and summaries with tap-to-copy actions. Expanding a result also reveals the compound's published spectra (NMR, IR, mass, UV, and Raman) grouped by technique.
STRUCTURE & ISOMER SEARCH
• Structure Search: Draw molecules with atoms, bonds, charges, and templates. Search PubChem for exact, substructure, superstructure, or similarity matches. Import/export SMILES, InChI, and MOL files.
• Isomer Search: Search compounds by molecular formula. View molar mass, atom counts, and degrees of unsaturation. Sort by relevance or name.
PERIODIC TABLE
Browse all 118 elements with category filters, shell diagrams, physical properties, and spectra. Interactive heatmaps display trends for electronegativity, atomic radius, ionization energy, density, melting point, and boiling point (in K, °C, or °F) with top-five rankings.
CHEMICAL DATABASE
Offline database with 1500+ substances, 200+ ions, 120+ functional groups, and 300+ reactions. Covers acids, salts, oxides, ores, polymers, amino acids, vitamins, alkaloids, drugs, esters, organometallics, and silicates. Search by name, alias, or formula.
CHEMISTRY TOOLS
Includes 15 tools for calculations and reference:
• Molar Mass Calculator
• Empirical Formula Finder
• Oxidation State Finder
• pH / pOH Calculator
• Reaction Balancer
• Precipitate Predictor
• Reaction Predictor
• Limiting Reagent
• Percent Yield
• Reaction Scaling
• Dilution Calculator
• Ideal Gas Law
• SMILES Visualizer
• 3D Molecule Viewer
• Compare Compounds
Stoichiometry tools calculate reagent consumption, leftovers, and atom economy.
LIBRARY & RECENT SEARCHES
Save compounds as Favorites or Downloads (Basic, Structures, or Complete) for offline use. Long-press to copy formulas, open in PubChem, or delete. Export and backup library data via CSV or JSON. Search history supports pinning, sorting, and grouping.
HOME SCREEN & WIDGETS
• Compound of the Day: Daily compound card with formula and typical uses.
• Widgets: Compound of the Day and Random Compound (with refresh button).
• Shortcuts: App-launcher shortcuts to Search, Library, Tools, and Settings.
• Explore: Quick access to Structure Search, Isomer Search, Periodic Table, and Database.
DISPLAY & OPTIONAL AI
• Themes: Light, Dark, AMOLED true-black, 5 color accents, and card or flat layouts.
• Optional AI: Fetch compound summaries via Google Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or Mistral AI using your own API key.
• Preferences: Configurable temperature units (K, °C, °F), haptics, and cache controls.
LOCALIZATION
Available in 16 languages: English, Bengali, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, and Swedish.
DATA, PRIVACY & LICENSE
• Free and open source under the MIT License.
• No account, analytics, tracking, or app backend. Data stays on your device.
• Network access is only used for external queries (PubChem, Wikipedia, or configured AI).
• For study and reference only; consult official SDS for laboratory work.

fdroid:com.sidhant.wallet.name: Wallet
fdroid:com.sidhant.wallet.summary: Offline card vault with AES-256-GCM encryption. Zero internet, total privacy.
fdroid:com.sidhant.wallet.description:
Wallet is the ultimate privacy-first vault for your credit, debit, loyalty, and identity cards. Designed with a zero-knowledge architecture, Wallet ensures your most sensitive information stays exactly where it belongs: encrypted on your device.
Why choose Wallet?
🚫 TOTAL PRIVACY (OFFLINE BY DESIGN)
Wallet does not have internet permission. Your data never leaves your device, making it 100% immune to cloud leaks, remote hacks, or third-party tracking. True privacy is offline.
🛡️ MILITARY-GRADE ENCRYPTION
Every detail—card numbers, images, and custom fields—is protected using industry-standard AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with Argon2id key derivation (RFC 9106). Your master key stays safely in your device's hardware keystore.
🎨 PREMIUM "LIQUID GLASS" DESIGN
Experience a beautiful, modern interface with glassmorphism effects, smooth staggered animations, and full support for premium Light and OLED Dark modes.
📲 APPLE WALLET & PKPASS SUPPORT
Easily import your digital passes and tickets. Support for .pkpass files allows you to move your boarding passes, coupons, and event tickets into a secure, offline vault.
🔐 BIOMETRIC PROTECTION
Secure your vault with your fingerprint or face unlock. Authentication is required on app start, and before destructive actions like backup restore or data deletion.
🔄 SECURE ENCRYPTED SHARING
Share passes or loyalty cards securely via End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) QR codes. Your data is encrypted for transfer and can only be decrypted by another instance of the app.
💾 SECURE BACKUPS
Create encrypted backups (.wbk) of your entire vault, including passes, and settings. Every backup is protected by Argon2id key derivation, memory-hard and resistant to GPU attacks.
📸 ENCRYPTED CARD SCANS
Store high-quality, encrypted images of the front and back of your physical cards. Access them digitally whenever you need them, without compromising your security.
Key Features:
- 100% Ad-Free: No distractions, no tracking, just your cards.
- Smart Detection: Automatic card network detection (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, etc.).
- Custom Fields: Add unique data points to any card or pass.
- Tap-to-Copy: Instantly copy details for seamless online transactions.
Protect your identity and simplify your life. Experience the peace of mind that comes with true local security.

fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.name: N0RMA
fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.summary: Spot trackers, drones and camera-like Wi-Fi. Nothing leaves your phone.
fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.description:
N0RMA helps you check whether anything nearby is tracking or watching you - using only your phone's own Bluetooth and Wi-Fi radios. No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. It cannot even connect to the internet.
WHAT IT DOES
- Finds Bluetooth trackers that are separated from their owner (Apple Find My / AirTag-style, Tile, Samsung SmartTag, Chipolo) and ignores normal "owner nearby" signals
- Listens for FAA Remote ID drone broadcasts over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, worded honestly as claims (Remote ID can be faked)
- Flags camera-like and drone-like Wi-Fi networks
- Tells you in plain words: "All clear", "Keeping an eye on something" or "Needs your attention" - with live proof it is working
- Tap-to-find: tap an alert for a hot/cold meter, warmer/colder arrow, a real compass sweep, and a GPS+compass arrow for drones that broadcast a position
- Room sweeps: build a baseline per room, spot what is NEW, and see which room a device is probably in
- Survey walks: log what you hear while you walk, see rough source positions, and save a KML (Google Earth) or WiGLE-format file - saved locally, nothing uploads
- "This is mine" for your own trackers and camera-like sources so they stop flagging
- Smart devices: nearby gadgets grouped by maker, plus a privacy checklist (Amazon Sidewalk, Ring/Alexa accounts, router)
- Physical-inspection checklist per room, and a camera-lens finder that uses the torch to spot lens glints in a dark room
- Sweep report: which rooms you swept and inspected, what was NOT checked, and what was flagged - it never says a place is "clear"
- Dark, low-glare screens and a dim-red night mode, so searching at night does not light up the street
- Discreet mode: neutral notifications hidden on the lock screen, PIN lock, hidden from recents and screenshots, a Notes/Weather disguise, one-tap quick exit
- "Try it with sample data" shows every screen working before you trust it with anything real
HONEST LIMITS
A quiet screen is NOT a guarantee of safety. A phone cannot see drones without Remote ID, cameras that only record to an SD card, cellular/GPS trackers, or most hidden devices. Signal-strength distance and direction are rough estimates, and walls bend them. Android limits how often Wi-Fi can be scanned and needs the Location switch on (N0RMA does not read, save or send your location). Some phones stop background apps to save battery.
PRIVACY
Everything stays on the phone. There is no internet permission. The camera permission is used only by the Lens finder, only while it is open: pictures are analysed in memory and thrown away, never saved or sent. History is deleted after 30 days, and you can delete everything with one tap. Drone operator positions are shown live and never saved. The optional address search for your home uses Android's own lookup service; GPS and typed coordinates send nothing.
SAFETY
If you find something you do not own, leave it where it is, photograph it, and contact local law enforcement. Never shoot at, jam or interfere with a drone. If you feel unsafe (for example because of a stalker or abusive partner), contact local police or a hotline; in the US, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233.
Detect-only: N0RMA never jams, spoofs or transmits. Free and open source (MIT).

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyboardga.name: Boardgame Clock (Privacy Friendly)
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyboardga.summary: (SECUSO) Boardgame Clock offers timers for boardgame time tracking
fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlyboardga.description:
Privacy Friendly Boardgames Clock offers stopwatches and timers to support time tracking while playing boardgames.
The app offers different modes depending on the game that is played. If the game is round based players and round times can be continued. The app tracks the time that the player needs in each round and alerts the player if he or she takes too much time.
Privacy Friendly Boardgame Clock furthermore offers a time tracking mode. This is a stopwatch for each player that participates in the game as well as for the overall game time.
How does Privacy Friendly Boardgame Clock differ from other similar apps?
1) Minimal permissions
Privacy Friendly Boardgame Clock does request to storage permission in case the data is backed up.
2) No advertisement
Moreover, Privacy Friendly Boardgame Clock completely relinquishes advertisement. Many other apps in the Google Play Store display advertisement and therefore might violate the users privacy, shorten battery life or use mobile data.
Privacy Friendly Boardgame Clock is part of the Privacy Friendly Apps group developed by the research group SECUSO at Technische Universität Darmstadt. More information at: https://secuso.org/pfa

fdroid:space.subread.dictionary.summary: Pop-up dictionary for Yomitan dictionaries, from the text menu of any app
fdroid:space.subread.dictionary.description:
SubRead Dictionary is a pop-up dictionary for Yomitan dictionaries.
 How to look up a word 
 Select a text in any app and choose "SubRead Dictionary" in the text selection menu.
 Share a text to the app.
 Send a word from SubRead Overlay.
The pop-up opens over the app. It shows each term at the start of the text, the longest term first, with the reading, the pitch accent, the frequency and a button for the audio. A tap on a character of the text looks up the text from that character.
 Dictionaries 
Import a Yomitan .zip file (format 3), for example JMdict, Jitendex, a pitch accent dictionary or a frequency list. The order of the dictionaries in the settings is their order in the pop-up.
 Audio 
 Local audio: choose the android.db file of the Local Audio Server for Yomitan. The app copies it into its folder.
 Remote audio: optional and off by default. Give one URL per line, with {term} and {reading}. The default line is JapanesePod101. A Local Audio Server on your network also works.
 Anki 
The "Anki" button of a term sends the term to SubRead Anki, which makes the card.
 Other apps 
Other apps can read the terms of a text through a content provider.
 Privacy 
Nothing leaves the device, except when a remote audio source is on. Then the word goes to that server.

DISCLAIMER: Puffin Cloud Browser is NOT a web browser.
Puffin Cloud Browser is the client app that accesses the cloud server which runs the web browser. The Puffin client app and the Puffin cloud server do not communicate in HTTP protocol and the data exchange is not in HTML format. The Puffin client app is like the remote desktop client and the Puffin cloud server is like the remote desktop server. Puffin Cloud Browser gives the audience the illusion of a web browser but it is not, in reality, a web browser. Puffin Cloud Browser can only "display" the web content rendered on the cloud servers but can't "render" the web content itself on the client devices.
==== Differentiating Features ====
* Browser Isolation
* Cloud Acceleration
* Data Saving
* Download to Cloud
* Flash Game
* Full Desktop Mode
* Internet Access Protection
* Virtual Gamepad/Mouse/Trackpad
==== Important Limitations ====
* Only works on websites that are publicly accessible from the US
 -- Does not work for private IP, corporate Intranet, and geo-restricted websites
* Only works in countries that are not excessive in censorship
 -- Does not work in China, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and United Arab Emirates
* For some websites, Puffin server IP blocks need to be white-listed
 -- Puffin can bring an excessive load to some websites
More info at Puffin FAQ https://help.puffin.com/faq

apple-macos:6758920580.name: Fires EU
apple-macos:6758920580.description:
Fire — Real-Time Wildfire Monitoring
Fire brings live wildfire monitoring to your fingertips using NASA satellite data, the Copernicus EFFIS European feed and Portugal's official Civil Protection data. Follow active fires across Europe, get push alerts when a wildfire is detected near you, and report what you see on the ground.
REAL-TIME SATELLITE DATA
• Fire detection from NASA FIRMS (VIIRS sensors on NOAA-20 and NOAA-21)
• Updates within about 3 hours of the satellite pass
• Colour-coded intensity: Low, Moderate, High, Extreme
PORTUGUESE CIVIL PROTECTION
• Official live fire data from ANEPC (Proteção Civil)
• Per fire: firefighters, vehicles and aircraft deployed
• Status from first alert to resolution, with resource-history charts
PUSH ALERTS ACROSS EUROPE
• Sent by the server — the app does not need to stay open
• In Portugal from the official ANEPC feed, elsewhere from Copernicus EFFIS
• Country and source in every alert
• Alert radius from 5 to 200 km (default 15 km), plus your saved places
• A satellite detection must be confirmed twice before an alert is sent, for fewer false alarms
CITIZEN REPORTS
• Seen a fire? Tap "Report fire" and send a report, with a photo if you like
• Six categories: wildfire, building, vehicle, industrial, agricultural, other
• Others can confirm a report or flag a false one
• Optional private sign-in with Apple or Google; earn reputation through accurate reports
FIRE SPREAD FORECAST AND WIND
• Elliptical spread model based on published wildfire research (Anderson 1983, Alexander 1985)
• Live wind, humidity and soil moisture from Open-Meteo
• Forecasts at 1, 3 and 6 hours
• Wind map with colour-coded arrows across the visible area
INTERACTIVE MAP
• Standard, satellite and NASA true-colour views — see smoke plumes and burn scars
• Fire Weather Index from Copernicus EFFIS (official 6-class danger scale)
• Burnt areas and IPMA daily fire risk for Portugal
• Map legend: tap ⓘ on the map to see what every colour and symbol means
STATISTICS
• Active fires by country across Europe
• Portugal in detail: severity, resources over time, fire types, status, districts
SAFETY CIRCLE
• Share your location with family and friends, see them on the map and know when one of them is near a fire
PRIVACY FIRST
• No account needed to view fires or receive alerts
• Your location only leaves the device when push alerts are on
• No third-party tracking or analytics
20 LANGUAGES
English, Portuguese, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Greek, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Serbian, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese and Chinese.
DATA SOURCES
NASA FIRMS, Copernicus EFFIS / Emergency Management Service, ANEPC (Proteção Civil) and IPMA. Weather from Open-Meteo. Fire is for information only and should not be your only source for emergency decisions.
Universal app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Contains ads.

flathub:net.nymtech.NymVPN.name: NymVPN
flathub:net.nymtech.NymVPN.description:
NymVPN is a decentralized VPN powered by the Noise Generating Mixnet. It protects not just your
 traffic but your metadata: the patterns of who you talk to, when, and from where. No single server
 sees who you are and what you do, so there are no meaningful traffic logs to keep or hand over.
 Two modes, one app:
 dVPN mode : 2-hop WireGuard (AmneziaWG) for fast streaming and browsing on a decentralized
 network.
 Mixnet mode : 5-hop routing through the Noise Generating Mixnet, a more private successor
 to Tor, with cover traffic to defeat traffic analysis. Ideal for crypto, email, and messaging.
 What you get:
 Anonymous accounts: no email, no name
 Pay with crypto or cash; zero-knowledge credentials delink your payment from your VPN use
 Anti-censorship technology: beat VPN blocking with QUIC, AmneziaWG, and more
 Swiss jurisdiction, outside the 14 Eyes
 Fully open source, independently audited
 70+ countries, with entry and exit server selection

fedora-packages:arprec/arprec.name: arprec
fedora-packages:arprec/arprec.summary: Software package for performing arbitrary precision arithmetic
fedora-packages:arprec/arprec.description: ARPREC is a software package for performing arbitrary precision arithmetic. It consists of a revision and extension of Bailey's earlier MPFUN package, enhanced with special IEEE numerical techniques. Features include: * Written in C++ for broad portability and fast execution. * Includes C++ and Fortran 90/95 interfaces based on custom data-types and operator/function overloading, which permit the library to be used with only minor modifications for many conventional C++ and Fortran-90 programs. * Includes all of the usual arithmetic operations, as well as many transcendental functions, including cos, sin, tan, arccos, arcsin, arctan, exp, log, log10, erf, gamma and Bessel functions. * Supports three arbitrary precision data-types: mp_real, mp_int and mp_complex. * Supports many mixed-mode operations between arbitrary precision variables or constants and conventional variables or constants. * Includes special library routines, incorporating advanced algorithms for extra-high precision (above 1000 digits) computation. * Includes a number of sample application programs, including programs for quadrature (numerical definite integrals), PLSQ (integer relation finding) and polynomial root finding. * Includes the "Experimental Mathematician's Toolkit". This is a self-contained interactive program that performs many operations typical of modern experimental mathematics, including arithmetic expressions, common transcendental functions, infinite series evaluation, definite integrals, polynomial roots, user-defined functions, all evaluated to a user-defined level of numeric precision, up to 1000 decimal digits.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts Jekyll front matter YAML to an AST JekyllFrontMatterBlock node.

fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2hp.name: foo2hp
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2hp.summary: Linux printer driver for HP 1600, HP 2600n
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2hp.description: foo2hp is an open source printer driver for printers that use the Zenographics ZjStream wire protocol for their print data, such as the HP Color LaserJet 2600n and the HP Color LaserJet CP1215. These printers are often erroneously referred to as winprinters or GDI printers. However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. In fact, ZjStream printers are raster printers which happen to use a very efficient wire protocol which was developed by Zenographics and licensed by most major printer manufacturers for at least some of their product lines. ZjStream is just one of many wire protocols that are in use today, such as Postscript, PCL, Epson, etc.

fedora-packages:libslz/libslz.name: libslz

It does not implement decompression at all, zlib is perfectly fine for this. The purpose is to use SLZ in situations where a zlib-compatible stream is needed and zlib's resource usage would be too high while the compression ratio is not critical. The typical use case is in HTTP servers and gateways which have to compress many streams in parallel with little CPU resources to assign to this task, and without having to limit the compression ratio due to the memory usage. In such an environment, the server's memory usage can easily be divided by 10 and the CPU usage by 3.

firefox-addons:2671317.name: checkVT - Browser Security
firefox-addons:2671317.summary: checkVT sends the selected URL through a parsing process, then to VirusTotal to check if it has been analyzed for malware.
firefox-addons:2671317.description:
checkVT (check VirusTotal) is an open source project developed by Emyll Almonte for an independent research class supervised by Dr. Vaibhav Anu (Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science), Montclair State University.
checkVT is a simple web browser extension that takes a selected URL via context-menu and submits it directly to be checked against all engines on VirusTotal with an added feature. VirusTotal is a free service that uses over 70 antivirus scanners and URL/domain blacklisting services to analyze suspicious files and URLs to detect types of malware. The feature checkVT incorporates is a process that tries to find the effective URL (redirect) if it exists on the URL that was submitted, and sends that URL to VirusTotal instead of the URL that was selected. This extra step helps users see the VirusTotal results for the URL/domain that they would have ended up at, as opposed to the original link they clicked on. URL redirection is a major phishing method that attackers use to masquerade as legitimate websites.
For more info and to see the open source code, please visit the GitHub repo: https://github.com/ealmonte32/checkVT

firefox-addons:3010599.summary: Find cheaper versions of products while shopping online. Compare prices instantly before you buy.
firefox-addons:3010599.description:
🐶 Sniff It — Find Cheaper Products & Spot Overpriced Stores in One Click
Stop overpaying online. Sniff It is a free price comparison and product-finder extension that quietly checks whether the item you're about to buy is being resold at a huge markup — and shows you visually similar products at fair prices, instantly.
Whether you stumbled onto a slick Shopify store, a no-name dropshipper, an unfamiliar fashion site, or a paid Instagram ad, Sniff It does the homework for you. The moment you land on a product page, it reads the title, price and product image, runs a fast market check against AliExpress, Amazon and direct-from-manufacturer sources, and warns you when you're being charged way more than the product is actually worth. No clicks. No noise. Just smarter shopping when it matters.
✨ NEW: Hover any image, find the product
On any shopping page — product pages, category listings, search results — pause your cursor on a product image for a second and a "Find this product" button slides in. One click pulls up visually similar items on AliExpress and Amazon with thumbnails, prices, and real order counts. Browsing a fashion lookbook? Hover the photo. Scrolling Etsy or a Shopify store? Hover the listing. Sniff It will find the same item — or close cousins — at the best price available online.
🔍 What Sniff It does
• Automatic price check on every product page — compares the store's price against typical market rates and flags inflated listings before you check out.
• Scam-store detection — analyzes the domain, TLD and product category for the signals that usually point to low-quality dropshipping or shady resellers.
• Reverse image search built in — both the new hover-to-find button on shopping pages AND a floating puppy on product pages open a panel of visually matched alternatives.
• Variant aware — pick a different color or size and Sniff It uses the photo you're actually looking at, not the default-color shot.
• Respects real brands — on official stores like nike.com or ray-ban.com , it stays quiet about overpricing (you can't get the genuine item cheaper) but still surfaces similar styles when you want to compare.
• Per-site mute — silence alerts on any store with one click, then manage muted sites from the settings panel.
• Recent sniffs history — every product you've checked is saved with thumbnail, title and price; reopen the page, pull up alternatives, or clear the list whenever you like.
• Multi-currency support — detects the store's currency automatically and converts to your preferred display currency using daily exchange rates.
🛡️ Privacy first — what we don't do
• We don't track your browsing history.
• We don't collect or sell personal data.
• We don't read page content outside of product metadata (title, price, image, currency, domain).
• We don't show ads. Ever.
💸 About affiliate links
Some of the alternative-product links Sniff It surfaces (AliExpress, Amazon) include affiliate codes. If you click through and buy on those sites, we may earn a small commission — at no extra cost to you. The price you pay is unchanged. This is what keeps Sniff It completely free for everyone.
👤 Who it's for
• Shoppers who see a product on an unfamiliar store and want a second opinion before checking out.
• Anyone tired of paying 4× the AliExpress price for the same generic gadget dressed up on a slick Shopify site.
• Gift buyers who want to sanity-check a price in seconds.
• Fashion shoppers who like the look of an item but want to see if there's a similar one for less.
• Bargain hunters, frugal shoppers, and anyone who hates being upsold.
Install Sniff It, keep shopping the way you always do, and let it warn you only when it matters. 🐾

firefox-addons:3067803.name: Party Tools for Roll20
firefox-addons:3067803.summary: A shared loot inventory for Dungeons and Dragons 5e and 5.5e games on Roll20: bags, coins and a full who-took-what log that everyone at the table can see and edit. It is kept inside your own campaign, so there is no server and no account to create.
firefox-addons:3067803.description:
A shared loot bag for your D&D group on Roll20, for both 5e and 5.5e.
Everyone at the table sees the same inventory. Drop items in, take them out,
split the coins, and it updates for everyone else within a second or two.
All of it lives in your own Roll20 campaign, stored as journal handouts.
There is no server involved, no account to create, and I never see any of it.
WHAT YOU NEED
A D&D game on Roll20's Jumpgate engine. If your game is still on Roll20's
older Legacy engine, the panel will not start, and it will tell you that is
why.
Both rulesets are supported, but not identically. Dragging items in reads
Roll20's D&D 5e compendium, which covers the 2014 rules (5e) and the 2024
rules (5.5e) alike. Sending an item onto a character sheet needs Roll20's
D&D 2024 sheet specifically; on the 2014 sheet, or any other sheet, the item
is recorded as assigned to that character instead of being written onto it.
Bags, coins, splitting and the log work whatever sheet you use.
WHAT IT DOES
Bags of loot the whole party can see and edit. The DM creates the bags,
everyone fills them.
Drag an item from the Roll20 compendium onto a bag and its name,
description, weight, cost and rarity come with it. You can also type in your
own items for anything homebrew.
Every bag has a coin purse. Splitting coins shows you the maths before you
commit to it: what converts down, what is left over, and who gets what. Each
share is held against a character until they take it.
Claim an item onto your character sheet, and move it back into a bag later.
A weapon stays a weapon, keeping its attack and damage.
Every change is recorded against a name and a time, so there is always an
answer to who took the rope.
You can search across every bag, sort within one, and rename them.
IF YOU ARE THE DM
You can make a bag hidden. Roll20's own servers withhold its contents from
players, so it is genuinely hidden and not just tucked out of sight in the
interface.
You can also disguise an item, so players see a written description instead
of its real name until you choose to reveal it. Anything you do in secret
goes to a separate log only you can read.
PRIVACY
Party Tools only runs on Roll20 game pages, so it cannot see anything else
you do in your browser. There is no analytics and nothing is sent to me.
Full policy:
 https://github.com/drsmith18/roll20-inventory-quest-tracker/blob/main/PRIVACY.md 
It is free and it is staying free. There is a Ko-fi link in the panel if it
earns its keep at your table.

Solve punchy puzzles, unlock new lands and explore hundreds of levels !
Tap, match and squish your way around the Lollipop World.

bluejetty:00177524:ios.name: Maximus 2
bluejetty:00177524:ios.summary: MAXIMUS 2 is a fantasy beat-em-up (brawler) that focuses on crunchy and satisfying combat. We captured the spirit of some of the best classic beat-em-ups, melding them into one memorable experience. Fight solo or with up to 4 players cooper
bluejetty:00177524:ios.description:
MAXIMUS 2 is a fantasy beat-em-up (brawler) that focuses on crunchy and satisfying combat. We captured the spirit of some of the best classic beat-em-ups, melding them into one memorable experience. Fight solo or with up to 4 players cooperative multiplayer!
STORY Is a single, continuous shot. This hasn’t been done since the 80's, rather than simply cutting from one stage to the next, the players enter an animated transition to the next area, creating the illusion of a fantastic journey.
MULTIPLAYER co-op in real time, fight together with up to 4 players online or on the same device with Bluetooth controllers.
HEROES with their own roles and weapons. The tank, the wrestler, the magician, the outlaw, the healer and the ninja.
TEAMWORK If you work together, you survive. Players can revive a fallen teammate, support or heal them and gang up to juggle enemies off each other in the air.
Supports iCloud.
There are a few in-apps available but we allow the whole game to be playable and unlocked through gameplay. 
Please consider the Premium Upgrade if you wish to support our game development.
Requirements
An internet connection is required for Online Multiplayer mode.
400 MB of storage space.

bluejetty:00178805:ios.description:
Play Classic Solitaire – Fun, Relaxing, and 100% Free to Play!
Enjoy the timeless charm of Classic Solitaire – one of the most beloved classic card games! Whether you have a few minutes to unwind or want to play for hours, this timeless Solitaire card game lets you play at your own pace anytime, anywhere—no wifi needed!
Solitaire, also known as Patience, is a classic card game loved by players of all ages, including adults, seniors, and classic card game lovers. If you love classic card games like FreeCell, Spider, Pyramid, TriPeaks, or Yukon, you'll feel right at home with this smooth and satisfying single-player Classic Solitaire experience.
It's more than just a card game – it's a relaxing way to unwind, challenge yourself, and become a Solitaire or Patience master!
Key Features:
- No In-App Purchases: Enjoy the full Classic Solitaire experience without in-app purchases, hidden upgrades, or paid unlocks.
- Play Anytime, Anywhere: No wifi? No problem. Enjoy a free offline Solitaire game, perfect for travel, commuting, or relaxing at home.
- Simple Controls. Tap or drag cards easily with smooth, responsive controls designed for relaxing play.
- Classic Solitaire Gameplay: Enjoy timeless Solitaire gameplay with satisfying card movement and familiar rules.
- Daily Challenges: Take on new challenges every day to earn trophies, coins, and exclusive rewards.
- Rewarding Events: Complete limited-time and special events to collect postcards and build your festive collection.
- Large, Easy-to-See Cards: Play more comfortably with large, easy-to-see solitaire cards that make every move easy to follow.
- Auto-Complete: Finish winning games faster with the auto-complete feature when all remaining moves are clear.
- Magic Help: Use Magic to complete sequences and move them to the Foundation when you need a little extra help.
- Customizable Themes: Personalize your solitaire game with dozens of backgrounds, including cats, dogs, nature, and flowers, along with diverse card faces and backs.
- Draw-1 and Draw-3 Modes: Choose your preferred challenge and play Classic Solitaire card game your way. Left- or right-handed mode is also supported.
- Dynamic Winning Animations: Celebrate every victory with lively, animated effects that add extra excitement and joy.
Fair and Enjoyable Solitaire for Everyone
We're committed to giving you a great experience — fair, supportive, and rewarding:
- Carefully Designed Deals. Enjoy thoughtful Solitaire deals that feel fair, balanced, and satisfying to play.
- Helpful Tools. Use unlimited undos, hints, and extra support to keep your Solitaire game smooth and relaxing.
- Generous Rewards. Earn bonuses as you play and enjoy more ways to make Classic Solitaire feel your own.
How to Play Classic Solitaire:
In this free and addictive Solitaire card puzzle game, the goal is to move all 52 solitaire cards from a single deck to 4 Solitaire Foundations, sorted by 4 suits - hearts, diamonds, spades, and clubs. Each Foundation is built up in order from Ace to King. In the tableau, solitaire cards can be stacked in descending order, alternating red and black.
Download Classic Solitaire now! Relax your mind, train your brain, and enjoy this free solitaire game anytime, anywhere – Play for free!

Embark on an exciting puzzle adventure where you connect and merge numbers to rack up high scores and unlock thrilling rewards. This game combines strategy, relaxation, and endless challenges, ensu
bluejetty:00095509:ios.description:
Welcome to the World of Number Fusion Fun!
Embark on an exciting puzzle adventure where you connect and merge numbers to rack up high scores and unlock thrilling rewards. This game combines strategy, relaxation, and endless challenges, ensuring you'll keep coming back.
How to Play
Number Ball Drop Mechanics
Drop and Align: Number balls fall from the top of the game board. Use taps or swipes to control where they land.
Automatic Merging: Once a ball lands, if it's adjacent to another ball with the same number, they merge into a single, higher-numbered ball.
Merge and Upgrade Strategy
Create Larger Numbers: Merge as many balls as possible to form bigger numbers. Each merge clears space and boosts your score.
Plan Your Moves: Strategize your ball drops to maximize merges and prevent a cluttered board.
Simple and Intuitive Controls
Swipe or Tap: Choose to swipe or tap to guide the falling balls. The controls are easy and suitable for all ages.
Unlimited Time: No rush! Take your time to plan each move and enjoy the game at your own pace.
Game Features
Easy to Start, No Pressure
Beginner-Friendly: Simple rules and straightforward controls make this game perfect for casual gamers seeking a relaxing experience.
Mind-Sharpening Fun: Merge and number games keep your brain active and engaged while you have fun.
Challenge High Scores
Push Your Limits: Strive to beat your previous high scores. With endless possibilities, there's always room for improvement.
Become a Master: With practice and strategy, become a number fusion master.
Vibrant Visual Effects
Eye-Catching Design: The game features a beautiful, colorful interface that's easy on the eyes.
Engaging Animations: Watch satisfying animations as number balls merge and upgrade, adding to the enjoyment.
Endless Challenges and Fun
Unlimited Gameplay: Play as much as you want with no time limits or restrictions.
Train Your Brain: Exercise your cognitive skills and improve strategic thinking while having fun.
Why Choose This Game?
Addictive Gameplay: The simple yet challenging mechanics of number merging will keep you hooked.
Relaxing Experience: Perfect for a quick break or a long gaming session, offering a balance of fun and relaxation.
Perfect for Puzzle Enthusiasts: If you love strategy and planning in puzzle games, this is a must-try.
Download now and start your number fusion adventure! Merge, upgrade, and achieve high scores in this delightful journey. The world of number fusion awaits!

bluejetty:00176213:android.summary: Grand Hospital is a hospital simulation game that truly restores the operation and construction of a hospital! Here you need to run a personalized hospital, recruit skilled staff, and use professional and fast treatment techniques and equip
bluejetty:00176213:android.description:
Grand Hospital is a hospital simulation game that truly restores the operation and construction of a hospital! Here you need to run a personalized hospital, recruit skilled staff, and use professional and fast treatment techniques and equipment to cure patients with various difficult diseases. Let's train more great doctors who have good skills and are committed to saving lives. Come and build an elite team!
Game Features.
- You'll get a realistic and rich experience of running a hospital simulation!
Design and decorate the hospital, rationally arrange the layout of various departments and equipment according to your preferences. There are triage desks for diagnosing illnesses, treatment rooms and laboratories for healing. Many different styles of hospitals are waiting for you to unlock!
‒ Recruit powerful professional doctors and nurses!
Recruit professional doctors and nurses from different departments. Do a good job in time and task management to form a professional team. Speed up doctors' treatment and improve the hospital's visibility!
‒ Receive all kinds of patients, discover the cause, and heal patients!
The image of the patient and the cause of the disease are derived from daily life, making the character more vivid and imaginative, so that the player has a greater sense of immersion.
- Keep making money and saving money!
Recruiting excellent teams, improving skills, building various cutting-edge medical equipment, and treating patients, so that you will continue to make money and develop into a wealthy Grand Hospital!
‒ Comparing competitions can inspire players to have a stronger desire to win!
Take part in tournaments and ranking matches. Challenge various difficult tasks and jobs to create a super hospital with a higher cure rate!
Break through the thinking and constraints of traditional simulation games to give players a free and open creative world. Join the hospital as soon as possible and experience the successful life as the president of Grand Hospital!

bluejetty:00175014:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00175014:ios.description:
Experience the raw power and beauty of nature with this comprehensive self-guided driving tour through Yellowstone National Park!
Yellowstone:
This enormous volcanic caldera has captured the American imagination for decades, and you’re about to learn why. Full of awe-inspiring geysers, astonishing waterfalls, and some of the only wild bison and wolves on the continent, this park simply can’t be missed.
Marvel at the 200-foot eruptions from Old Faithful and the even bigger explosions of steam and boiling water from its cousins. Peer deep into the Abyss Pool (if you dare) and follow a boardwalk through steaming hot springs which never freeze, even in the dead of winter! And try not to let your jaw drop too low when you see Grand Prismatic, an immense hot spring which radiates brilliant colors.
Watch herds of bison graze in Lamar Valley and elk plod around Mammoth Hot Springs. And keep an eye out for Yellowstone’s elusive but always regal wolf packs! Along the way, you’ll hear extra details about everything Yellowstone, from the volcanic formation of the landscape to the corruption and poaching at the park’s inception and stories of the first explorers to trek through this magnificent wilderness. 
Start from any of the park’s entrances (North, South, West, East, Northeast) and tour with total flexibility. Featuring riveting stories, an engaging narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
See all this and more on our Yellowstone tour.
■ Boiling River
■West Thumb
■ Abyss Pool
■ Fisherman’s Cone
■ Birds of Yellowstone
■ Shoshone Lake
■ Continental Divide
■ Bighorn Sheep
■ Old Faithful
■ Castle Geyser
■ Grand Geyser
■ Morning Glory
■ Fairy Falls & Grand Prismatic Spring
■ Firehole River
■ Fountain Paint Pot
■ Gibbon River
■ Lodgepole Pines
■ Artist’s Paint Pots
■ Norris Geyser Basin
■ Electric Peak
■ Swan Lake Flats
■ Sheepeater Cliffs
■ Golden Gate Bridge
■ Mammoth Hot Springs
■ Elk
■ Wraith Falls
■ Bison
■ Petrified Tree
■ Lost Lake
■ Roosevelt Lodge
■ Lamar Valley
■ Wolves
■ Coyotes
■ Devil’s Den
■ Dunraven Pass
■ Yellowstone River
■ Canyon Village
■ Grand Canyon of Yellowstone
■ Bears
■ Yellowstone Lake
■ Moose
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest. 
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase
No monthly subscription. No time limits. No usage limits. Enjoy this tour as many times as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year. 
FREE DEMO:
Check out the free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or Wi-Fi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged, or take an external battery pack.

bluejetty:00021591:ios.summary:
Find My Car - Your Ultimate Parking Companion
Have you ever experienced the frustration of losing your car in a busy parking lot or not remembering where you parked? 
If the answer is yes, then we have the perfect solution for you.
Introd
bluejetty:00021591:ios.description:
Find My Car - Your Ultimate Parking Companion
Have you ever experienced the frustration of losing your car in a busy parking lot or not remembering where you parked? 
If the answer is yes, then we have the perfect solution for you.
Introducing Find My Car, the app that takes the hassle out of parking and ensures you never lose your car again. 
Whether you're traveling to a new city, running errands, or simply enjoying a day out, our app is here to make your parking experience seamless and stress-free.
Key Features:
Save Car Location
With Find My Car, you can effortlessly save the precise location of your vehicle with just a single tap. No more wandering around aimlessly; your car's location is now at your fingertips.
Track Driving and Journeys
Whether you're heading out on a road trip or a daily commute, you can track driven distances. 
You can set your base locations as starting points for your journeys, and Find My Car will calculate and save the distances.
Synced Parking History with iCloud
Your parking history is securely and automatically synced with iCloud, ensuring that your data is available across all your devices.
Navigate Back to Your Car
Say goodbye to the days of searching for your parked car. 
Find My Car provides reliable navigation that guides you straight back to your vehicle, no matter where you are.
Reminders and Notes
Worried about exceeding your parking time limit? 
Activate a notification that reminds you when it's time to head back to your car, helping you avoid costly fines. 
Plus, leave handy notes to describe your parking location, level, or any other details that assist you in locating your car.
Apple Watch App
If you own an Apple Watch, you can try the watch companion app to efficiently guide you back to your parked car. 
The compass will point you in the fastest direction for a swift return to your vehicle.
Feel free to send us an e-mail on info@findmycar.app - We love to hear from our users.
Link to Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Link to Privacy Policy: https://grumsendev.dk/privacy/Find-My-Car-Privacy-Policy.pdf

bluejetty:00149499:ios.description:
Welcome to the Fit Father Project App! We are the #1 Fitness Program and Community for Dads 40+. We help busy dads and men 40+ lose weight, build muscle, and get themselves healthy for their families.
Our Fit Father Program has transformed the lives of over 50,000+ Dads and we’re just getting started!
It’s our Mission to help busy Dads over 40 get their health back. We want to help every Dad reach healthy weight, build muscle, and create habits to stay healthy long-term… for himself and his family. 
We provide nutrition + exercise guidance geared for weight loss, muscle building, general health improvements, flexibility, and even stress relief.
The Dads who join our community get instant access to our meal plans, workouts, and health guidance… all inside this insanely powerful Fit Father App. The app literally hands you everything: easy delicious meal plans, workouts (for all fitness levels), accountability coaching, fun challenges, daily motivation, and more! We help you set goals and achieve them quickly using our Program that’s so engaging & effective… it will change your life. 
The Fit Father App also gives you access to our incredible Community of Men. We call this group “The Brotherhood” …because as corny as that may sound, that’s exactly what it feels like. 
There’s no other better way to explain it than to say this Fit Father Program has attracted and transformed the lives of thousands of the most genuine, helpful, and good-valued men. And all these men love the FFP so much that we’re all hanging out and supporting one another inside our group “The Brotherhood” where we’re constantly sharing inspiration, support, genuine connection, camaraderie, and tons of motivation.
 We want you to become a Fit Father Member and join us because we believe in this:
“As iron sharpens iron, so too does one man sharpen another.” - Proverbs 27:17
This Fit Father Program & Community was founded by Dr. Anthony Balduzzi through a deeply personal journey. Growing up, Anthony watched his own dad get unhealthy and die at 42 years old. Anthony was 10 at the time. All the pain and healing Anthony experienced after his Dad’s death ignited his passion to help other Dads get and stay healthy for their families.
To date, the Fit Father Project has the MOST success story health transformations for Dads 40+ online. We have thousands. And it’s true… our meal plans, workouts, and habit guidance are world-class and so incredibly helpful. And everything our entire Program and approach to health is geared specifically for busy Dads 40+ so this Program actually fits your life and is sustainable long-term.
If you’re ready to experience a new level of health on a life-changing program that will turn you into a Fit Father, visit our website and become a member of the FFP today!
Join us here:
http://www.fitfatherproject.com
After joining, you get instant access to this Fit Father App to start your transformation!
---

bluejetty:00027364:ios.description:
Who are we?
We at Editorial Buen Camino have spent over 20 years creating guides for pilgrims (2004–2025). These guides are written and updated daily by pilgrim and journalist Carlos Mencos – winner of the Aymeric Picaud International Award for raising awareness of the Way of St James – together with his team.
The most used Camino app:
With over a million downloads on different platforms, this is the most used Way of St James app. It currently features 45 guides for as many routes. 
What does it include? 
Map with the route and all potential detours, both for walking and for cycling.
Profile of the terrain.
Customizable stage planner.
Real-time alerts about incidents along the Way.
Thousands of geolocalised points: accommodations, services, monuments, warnings...
Detailed information about each location.
Real-time weather forecasts.
Direct contact with the author via WhatsApp or email.
Available in 9 languages.
How much does it cost?
We know you’re on a pilgrimage. You decide how much to pay, and can even choose not to pay, depending on your situation.
How does it work?
Here’s a practical video-manual:
https://youtu.be/icp96ZHXQAU?si=QZAJXZFiN708KDyS
Languages available:
Spanish, English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Korean and Simplified Chinese.
Routes included:
French Route (passing through O Cebreiro and Sarria before reaching Santiago)
Central Portuguese Route from Porto (passing through Valença/Tui before reaching Santiago)
Coastal Portuguese Route (passing through Caminha and Vigo before reaching Santiago)
Portuguese Route from Lisbon to Porto

bluejetty:00076730:ios.name: Mafia42: Mafia Party Game
bluejetty:00076730:ios.summary: Be the survivor from the battle of logic and reasoning! Play Mafia game online with your mobile in Mafia42 to solve mystery crimes with your own strategy! With friends, family, and lover, find evidence and save the citizen by lynching villa
bluejetty:00076730:ios.description:
Be the survivor from the battle of logic and reasoning! Play Mafia game online with your mobile in Mafia42 to solve mystery crimes with your own strategy! With friends, family, and lover, find evidence and save the citizen by lynching villains.
Mafia42 is a chat-based social deduction game where people actively battle with one another and test their own strategies. Each player will be assigned among 30 plus different roles. And in each phases, players will use their skill to deceive, hide, or deduce. During the day phase, players will debate and deduce to find out the hidden villains and lynch them before the day ends. Logical thinking and strategies are required to find the criminals.
Various Characters
Play as different roles! Join as your favorite character. Use the gemstone to be assigned as your favorite role!
Unique Skill
Strategy is the key to win from villains! With various unique skills, survive during the night time! Finding hidden criminals depends on how you use the skill.
Villain's Crime
Every crime happens during the night time when Citizens are not around. Mafia team members are trying to use their skills to kill citizen. Focus on the situation! There might be a evidence to track them!
Effective Strategies
Logical thinking will help you to win the match. Make your own strategy that will help you go through the night time threats.
We highly recommend checking out our Wiki Fandom before playing to familiarize yourself with all the characters.
Features:
- 30 plus fun and exciting roles and more to come!
- Different characters with different special skills will be assigned.
- Enjoy with your friends and family online.
- Join a guild to socialize, cooperate and interact with other people.
- Multiple modes will entertain you with different experiences.
- Complete the daily quests to receive daily rewards.
- Collect rare icons by completing hidden missions!
- Customize your account with various items such as skins and nameplates.
Note:
Mafia42 has optional in-game items require payment. Under our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, you must be at least 13 years of age to download and join the battle. This app requires a network connection to play.

Free cancellation on most hotels. Because flexibility matters.
The CheapTickets app for iOS offers the ability to search and securely book the same selection of cheap flights, hotel rooms, rental cars and activities offered on CheapTickets.com. Plus, join our CheapCash loyalty program and start earning CheapCash on select flight bookings that you can instantly apply toward hotels in the app! HOTELS 
- Last minute hotel bookings welcome and free cancellation available!
- Pay when you book or when you arrive at the hotel. 
- Find hotels, motels, and inns around you on an easy-to-use map view.
- Review descriptions, photos, user ratings, and amenities from verified hotel guests.
- Sort results by deals, price, or reviews.
- Securely store your payment details for faster, easier, and safe bookings. 
FLIGHTS 
- Save even more on your flight with our combined one-way fares and get a single price for two separately issued tickets.
- Search and book round trip or one-way flights.
- Sort flights by price, time, or duration from any airline.
- Enter a departure date and destination, and your trip-ready. Book now!
CARS 
- Search thousands of cars to find cheap, quality rentals. Save big when you book in-app!
- Plan round trip rentals from any airport in the world to make your vacation, holiday or getaway a total breeze.
CheapTickets offers a simple, secure booking process, and 24x7 customer support. Use our convenient travel tools to view upcoming trip details, access address information and get maps for directions, receive alerts for flight delays, gate changes, hotel check-out times and more.
The CheapTickets app uses information for analytics, personalization, and advertising. By using our app, you agree to our privacy and cookies policies.

bluejetty:00142707:ios.name: Animal Kingdoms: Wolf Sim MMO
bluejetty:00142707:ios.summary:
Welcome to the Wild World of Animal Kingdoms!
Step into the paws of wild animals like the wolf, lion, fox and tiger and experience life as a fierce predator, pack leader, or cunning lone hunter. Breed and raise a family, play with friends
bluejetty:00142707:ios.description:
Welcome to the Wild World of Animal Kingdoms!
Step into the paws of wild animals like the wolf, lion, fox and tiger and experience life as a fierce predator, pack leader, or cunning lone hunter. Breed and raise a family, play with friends online and unlock special abilities as you create your legacy in the untamed wilds.
LIVE THE LIFE OF A TRUE WILD ANIMAL
Choose your path and play as a variety of animals, including wolves, foxes, and lions - each with their own journey. Customize your animal’s appearance, from fur color to rare mutations that make each creature truly unique. Establish your territory, raise a family, and express yourself in the world with both realistic and fun animal behaviors and abilities!
BREED A FAMILY, CREATE A LEGACY
Find a mate, raise your family, and protect your pups from danger. Breed unique coats, rare patterns and mutations to create a visually stunning lineage. Your family grows with you, each generation gaining new skills and growing your family’s legacy.
MASTER UNIQUE SURVIVAL SKILLS
Use your keen sense of scent as a fox, stalk prey with stealth as a lion or command your pack as a wolf. Each species has their own set of special skills!
EPIC STORIES
Start your adventure as a young wolf searching for their lost family after their parents are taken. Rumors suggest the lions are behind the disappearances. Determined to uncover the truth, you set out alone—until you cross paths with a loyal wolf mate who joins you on the adventure to bring your family back.
INTERACT, EXPLORE & SURVIVE A MASSIVE 3D OPEN WORLD
Travel through lush forests and sun-drenched savannas, each teeming with life, challenges and hidden secrets. Master the environment, using rocks, trees, and shrubs to your advantage in combat and stealth. Stay alert, as danger lurks around every corner, from rival packs to dangerous predators.
BATTLE BOSSES
Team up with your friends and test your strengths against powerful bosses. Use each animal's unique abilities, combine your strengths, and work together to battle these massive apex-predators.
SHOW YOUR STYLE
Customize your animal with accessories like hats, glasses, jackets and jewelry. Emote with gestures like courtship dances, wagging tails and play-bow - you can also carry your cubs!
MULTIPLAYER ADVENTURES WITH FRIENDS
Join friends in multiplayer mode and work together to conquer the wild. Form packs, engage in cooperative battles, and take on environmental puzzles that reward teamwork and strategy. With seamless online multiplayer, you can connect with players from around the world!
Download Animal Kingdoms today and start your adventure in a breath-taking wild world where every decision shapes your legacy. Create your story, lead your family, and survive in the ultimate animal simulator!
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
By downloading this game you are agreeing to our terms of service which can be found at: https://www.foxieventures.com/terms
Our privacy policy can be found at:
https://www.foxieventures.com/privacy
A network connection is required to play. Animal Kingdoms works best over Wi-Fi.
Website: https://www.foxieventures.com

bluejetty:00126187:ios.description:
AutoMute allows you to automatically mute,un-mute your iPhone,iPad on selected locations.
Automatically mute your phone at cinema, at the library and any other locations that you want to silence your phone. 
Don't forget to un-mute your phone when you leave those locations and miss important calls.
AutoMute will automatically un-mute your iPhone,iPad when you leave those locations.
Uses minimum battery power. Uses iDevice region monitoring with low battery usage.
Important:
**********
W-FI should be enabled in order to get accurate location.
**********
Instructions:
- Click on edit to create new location
- Enter location name
- Select the location from the map. You can select a location by using your existing contacts or search for a location.
- Select the operation when entering the location. The default is to mute the device. 
You can also set the volume to minimum or maximum.
- Select the operation when exiting the location. The default is to un-mute the device.
You can also set the volume to minimum or maximum.
- Enable Notify if you want to receive a notification on your device when the operation is executed. The default is to enable notification.
- Enable/Disable the saved location. When disabled the location is not used. 
Now to test the exit operation you need to exit the location. To test the enter operation you need to exit the location and enter it.
You can also test your Enter operation by using your current location.
We are doing our best to deliver great applications. If you encounter a problem or you have a question regarding AutoMute please feel free to contact us at support@novniv.com 
We will assist you ASAP!

Endless Wander is an offline roguelike RPG in a pixel art style. It features satisfying and challenging gameplay with infinite replayability and an indie soul.
THE ULTIMATE MOBILE ROGUELIKE:
Experiment and create the optimal build by combining weapon abilities and magical runes. Unlock unique characters, upgrade them, and explore a mysterious world filled with fierce enemies that offers infinite replayability.

Experience intense real-time action combat that puts your skill to the test. The simple and reactive touch controls combined with a smart auto-aim make fighting merciless enemies and bosses even more satisfying.
STUNNING PIXEL ART VISUALS:
Explore a variety of beautifully handcrafted pixel art environments and characters. Get captivated by an original soundtrack that changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.
OFFLINE GAME
No internet connection is required! Play offline anytime or use cloud saves to keep your progress on all your devices.
Endless Wander brings the soul of PC indie roguelike games in a fresh, unique, and mobile-first experience. Whether you're a roguelike beginner or you've battled through countless pixel dungeons before, Endless Wander is meticulously crafted to provide an exceptional roguelike experience.
Endless Wander is our first game at First Pick Studios.

bluejetty:00061781:ios.description:
Trucking Management Software:
TruckLogics is a trucking management software designed for fleet managers, owner-operators, leased operators, brokers, independent dispatchers, and service providers. 
It allows trucking businesses to monitor the real-time status of dispatches and drivers while also keeping accurate records of miscellaneous expenses while on the go. 
You can instantly notify drivers with all dispatch details, and they can handle their dispatch operations directly through the app.
Features you can enjoy in the TruckLogics mobile app:
Address Book: Import contacts directly from your mobile device into your TruckLogics account in just a matter of minutes.
Multi-User Access: You can enable your staff to access your TruckLogics account. They can use the mobile app and perform certain designated operations.
Dispatch Management: You can create and view all active, assigned, delivered, and canceled dispatches, along with each load’s freight details and load charges. 
Check Calls: Drivers can notify you and/or your customer/brokers on the status of the dispatch at any time. Cut down on unnecessary phone calls and keep everyone in the loop.
Freight Tracking: 
Get tracking for your drivers in as little as five-minute intervals, all while keeping your customers or broker updated. 
Driver Communication: 
Our chat feature allows you to improve communication even further. You can share and broadcast images, videos, trip documents, and truck locations to one or all of your drivers.
Record Fuel Ups: Add details regarding the fuel purchases to your TruckLogics account straight from the mobile app. Record the date, quantity, cost, and in what state the fuel was purchased. You can even take pictures of fuel receipts and upload them for record-keeping purposes. This feature is a lifesaver for quarterly IFTA filings, especially in the event of an audit
View Driver Settlements: Share your settlement estimates and finalized settlement details with drivers or contractors. View their pay percentage or rate, as well as all reimbursements and deductions you’ve added to their settlements.
Accounting Management: You can check your income and expenses while on the go with TruckLogics! Track and record Per Diem, toll fees, parking, and more in one easy-to-use application.
Document Management: Scan receipts or other documents on the go! Snap a picture of the document using your mobile device and upload it to the app. Never lose an important document!
View Business Reports: Everything you need to run and grow your business successfully is at your fingertips. 
Have any Questions, comments, or concerns? 
Contact our locally-based support team via phone, email, or live chat.

bluejetty:00085062:ios.description:
Get paid faster and avoid delay with all you need to access your benefits in one place. With the Alberta Blue Cross® app 100 per cent of health claims can be submitted online, saving you time and money. Simply sign in using fingerprint or facial recognition to take full advantage of being an Alberta Blue Cross® member today. 
The app offers several convenient features such as 
• your ID card—making it nearly impossible to forget at home,
• online claims submission—in most cases payment is available next business day,
• real-time claims history—find out if a claim has been processed with direct deposit date,
• cancel or modify a claim—quickly make changes without phoning or waiting on hold,
• upload receipts—take a photo of your receipt and upload,
• benefit lookup—whether it is for prescription drug, health or dental, you can look up eligibility, how much of a benefit has been used and see when your next full-maximum is available,
• direct-bill provider lookup—through google maps, find providers near you who direct-bill,
• Balance®—your online wellness platform, 
• direct deposit—sign up or update your banking information and stop waiting for cheques in the mail,
• premium payment—avoid disruption by changing your payment dates or frequency and make your payments online,
• personal information updates—prevent errors and easily update your email, address or phone number, and
• documents and resources—view your account balance, letters, bills and tax receipts.
With all of this and more, we hope you will give the Alberta Blue Cross app a try.
Are you having any trouble? Please contact us at appfeedback@ab.bluecross.ca.

bluejetty:00139480:ios.description:
Habit Tracker: Goals & Daily Planner
Build better habits, stay focused, and make progress toward your goals every day.
Create a routine that works for you with an all-in-one habit tracker and productivity planner. Track your daily activities, maintain streaks, organize tasks, manage your time, and understand your mood — all in one simple app.
Whether you're working toward personal goals, improving your productivity, studying, exercising, or developing healthier routines, you have the tools to stay consistent and see your progress over time.
Features
Track Habits and Reach Your Goals
Create personalized habits for fitness, reading, studying, mindfulness, self-care, and more. Monitor your progress with clear statistics and visual charts that help you understand how your routines develop over time.
Build Daily Streaks
Stay motivated by tracking consecutive days of activity. Celebrate milestones, monitor your consistency, and turn small daily actions into lasting habits.
Focus with the Pomodoro Timer
Make the most of your time with a built-in Pomodoro timer. Structure work and study sessions, schedule breaks, and build a more focused daily routine.
Plan Your Day
Organize tasks, routines, and priorities with a simple daily checklist. Keep important activities in one place and make it easier to follow through on your plans.
Set Personalized Reminders
Create reminders for habits, workouts, study sessions, and everyday activities. Get timely notifications to help you remember your priorities and maintain your routine.
Track Your Mood and Emotions
Record your mood and explore how it changes over time. Recognize patterns in your daily experiences and use these insights to make more informed lifestyle choices.
Create a Flexible Schedule
Set up habits that fit your lifestyle with daily, weekly, or monthly schedules. Track recurring activities and customize your routine to match your goals.
Improve Focus and Productivity
Break larger goals into manageable daily actions. Use habit tracking, checklists, reminders, and focus sessions to stay organized and make steady progress.
Customize Your Experience
Personalize your habits, schedules, reminders, and routines to suit your preferences. Build a tracking system that works for your lifestyle and priorities.
Make Every Day Count
Use your daily planner and habit tracker to:
• Build healthier routines
• Stay organized and consistent
• Improve focus and productivity
• Monitor your progress over time
• Track mood and daily activities
• Turn personal goals into achievable steps
Start today, track your progress, and build a routine that helps you move toward your goals — one day at a time.

bluejetty:00140714:ios.description:
The DogHouse puppy finder app is the #1 Dog Social Media app in the world. This dog finder app can help you find puppies in all of your favorite breeds such as French Bulldogs, American Bullies, English Bulldogs, Cane Corsos, Labradoodle & Goldendoodles, Pomeranians, Huskies, Shih Tzu, Dobermans, Rottweilers, and more! DogHouse is more than a pet finder, it not only allows you to connect with reputable dog breeders to find your new puppy or even stud service, it is also a full social media app with many resources and tools. You can learn all about Dog DNA with our DNA periodic table. The most impressive feature is our coat color calculator which runs over 1 million probabilities to predict the color of your entire litters. Our coat color calculators are built for French Bulldogs, Bullies, and English Bulldogs. In addition, try our raw and dry dog food calculators for the perfect nutritious diet for your dog or newly found puppy.
Introducing the ultimate dog and puppy finder app! Whether you're looking adopt or purchase a new furry friend to join your family or you just want to browse cute pups, the DogHouse app has got you covered.
Features:
- Puppy Finder/Stud Finder - Post studs, litters of puppies, find puppies and dogs for sale, or pet adoption by city, state, or country.
- Timelines by Breed - Frenchies, English Bulldogs, Bullies, Corsos, Pomeranians, Mastiffs, and more!
- Social network - We are more than a pet social media app, We are the #1 Dog social media app.
- Breeder Reviews - Leave breeder reviews and find reputable dog breeders with the best reviews.
- Verified Breeders - Breeders with gold check represent our verified breeders to help users from being scammed.
- Groups - Post in groups among other dog breeders or if you are looking for information as a dog parent you can ask questions in groups!
- Raw Food & Dry Dog Food Calculators - The best dog food app, let us be your dog food advisor. This dog food calculator also acts as a water tracker.
- Follow users - You are able to follow users and network with them
- Message users - We know communication is important when looking for pets for sale. You can message users directly.
- Coat Color Calculator - The Best breeding color calculator, take the guess work out and get a pretty accurate prediction of the puppy colors in your next litter.
- DNA Periodic Table - Learn dog DNA and dog colors whether you're a novice dog breeder or already an expert.
- Dog Name Generator - Good names are sometimes hard to think of but our dog name generator has Over 5,000 unique pet names to choose from.
- Dog Breeding Date Calculator - This dog pregnancy tracker and dog heat cycle calculator lets you input the mating date and this will calculate the gestation period for you.
- Litter Confirmation Generator - Creates an image for your upcoming litter
- Dog Pedigree Tree - Create up to 3 generation of dog pedigree
- Dog Age Calculator - Many people believe every dog year is equal to 7 human years. This just a myth, use our dog age calculator.
With our user-friendly interface, finding the perfect puppy or dog has never been easier. Browse through our extensive list of breeders and filter by location, age, gender, and more to find exactly what you're looking for. Our breeding color calculator is best in class and rated higher than color my frenchie and coat color calculator apps, plus we have many more features.
Whether you're a new dog owner looking for guidance on the best dog food for your puppy, or an experienced pet parent looking to switch up your dog's diet, our dog food app is here to help. If your dog is in her heat cycle our pet pregnancy tracker will calculate the delivery date for you. Swipe through popular pet name suggestions with our exclusive dog name generator. Learn dog DNA with our breeding coat color calculator. DogHouse is the one stop shop puppy finder and dog app. Download now and start making informed decisions about your dog's life!

bluejetty:00017913:ios.summary: FNB Allendale Mobile is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay o
bluejetty:00017913:ios.description:
FNB Allendale Mobile is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Bill Discovery: The app will automatically identify bills within your list of transactions and display a reminder to you when upcoming bills are due.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact FNB Allendale customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking by using advanced encryption technology. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access. This setting can be turned on or off in the preferences of the app.
GETTING STARTED
To use FNB Allendale Mobile, you must be enrolled as an FNB Allendale Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.
