bluejetty:00035296:ios.description:
Spirit Phone Innovations (SPI) — Experimental ITC Research Software
Spirit Phone Innovations (SPI) is an experimental paranormal research application developed to explore new approaches to Instrumental Trans-Communication (ITC). Conceptualized by paranormal researcher Sean Austin, SPI is designed to analyze environmental audio using artificial intelligence in a way that differs from traditional ITC-style applications.
At the core of SPI is SAM Mode, an experimental feature that analyzes environmental audio in real time and applies AI-based processing to identify and interpret audio patterns that may exist outside of normal human speech ranges. Unlike applications that rely on fixed word banks or pre-selected vocabulary, SPI is designed without predetermined phrase limitations, allowing for open-ended analysis rather than scripted responses.
KEY FEATURES
SAM Mode Audio Analysis: Experimental AI-driven analysis of environmental audio for potential anomalous patterns.
No Word Bank Limitation: Designed without a fixed vocabulary list, allowing results to remain unrestricted by preset phrases.
Session Logging & Word History: Detected words and session results are automatically saved to an in-app log folder, allowing users to review, compare, and document findings over time.
Language Interpretation (Experimental): Optional translation of detected words when foreign-language patterns are identified.
Estimated Voice Characteristics: Experimental analysis providing estimated age range and gender characteristics based on detected audio patterns.
Community Activity Mapping & GPS Directions: Users can place location pins to document reported activity, view shared locations from other users, and receive GPS directions to reported sites.
SPI was designed with the idea that ITC research benefits from documentation, pattern comparison, and shared exploration. The goal is not to provide predetermined answers, but to create an environment where users can explore potential patterns in audio and compare results across locations, environments, and sessions.
SPI is intended for exploration and research. Results are not guaranteed and may vary. Spirit Phone Innovations is an evolving platform committed to continuously expanding and refining its tools as AI technology advances.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
SPI requires a subscription to access its features. Two auto-renewable subscription tiers are available — Standard and Ghost — each offered as monthly or yearly plans.
Standard includes: EVP detection, frequency range control, and paranormal hotspot reporting.
Ghost includes: Everything in Standard, plus age and gender detection and multi-language EVP translation.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions at any time through your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://spiritphoneinnovations.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00131292:ios.description:

bluejetty:00129034:ios.description:
HabitBull is a simple, flexible habit tracker that helps you build good habits, break bad ones and keep your daily routine on track.
» Build streaks that keep you going
Every habit gets its own calendar, streak counter and success rate. Check in each day and watch your streak grow.
» Track anything
Yes/no habits or numbers: glasses of water, pages read, push-ups, cigarettes or hours of sleep. Set flexible goals like every day, 3 times a week, Mon–Fri only, or every 2 days.
» Break bad habits
Track smoking, drinking, nail biting or late-night scrolling. Once you see the pattern, it's easier to stop. HabitBull keeps you accountable.
» Stay on schedule
Reminders at any time of day, as many as you need, with optional sound and vibration.
» See your progress
Daily, weekly and monthly views, charts of your success rate and streaks, and notes for any day.
» Features
• Track habits, routines and repeated to-dos, each with its own calendar
• Streak counter and success percentage for every habit
• Yes/no or number goals
• Flexible goals: per day, per week, per month, certain weekdays or every few days (for example 30 push-ups every Mon–Fri, the gym twice a week)
• Charts of your success rate, streaks and entered values
• Notes for any day
• Several reminders per habit, with optional sound and vibration
• Inspiring quotes for each habit category
• PIN lock
• For iPhone and iPad
» HabitBull Premium
• Unlimited habits (the free version tracks up to 5)
• Cloud backup and sync across your devices
• Export your data to CSV
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
» How it works
1. Add a habit
2. Check in each day
3. Watch your streak grow
It takes a few months to turn a routine into a habit. Keep going on the hard days. HabitBull is there to keep you on track.
» Subscriptions and purchases
• HabitBull Premium is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase
• The yearly subscription starts with a 1-week free trial
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription
• Lifetime access is a one-time purchase, not a subscription

bluejetty:00022245:ios.description:
Your day is done. Your mind is still busy. Give yourself something gentler to listen to.
Sleep like a Baby brings rain sounds, white noise and nature sounds together in a mix you control. Choose a sound, add another, adjust the balance and save the combination you want to come back to tonight.
Not sure where to start? Answer a few quick questions for a sound suggestion that fits your night.
START WITH SOUNDS YOU LOVE
Rain on a window. Ocean waves. A familiar fan. Find your favourite, or layer sounds to create your own bedtime background. Rain, nature, white noise and baby sounds are free to use without a subscription.
A BEDTIME ROUTINE THAT FEELS LIKE YOURS
- Save favourite mixes so you can return to them without starting again.
- Set a sleep timer and let your sounds fade out gently.
- Keep listening with the screen off and use lock-screen playback controls.
- Set a bedtime reminder and dim the screen as you wind down.
FOCUS BY DAY. WIND DOWN AT NIGHT.
Home changes with your day, bringing Focus & calm sounds forward for work, study, unwinding or a nap. Switch between Day and Night when you want a different view. Keep the Focus row handy at night too, or turn daytime focus off in Settings.
Use familiar rain, nature and noise sounds by day, then return to your bedtime mix in the evening.
FOR YOUR BEDTIME, AND THEIRS
Explore white noise and baby sounds for your little one's bedtime routine, or choose a familiar sound for your own quiet time. You don't have to be a parent to sleep like a baby.
A STORY FROM YOUR IMAGINATION
Choose a topic and add a name if you like. AI creates a story and reads it aloud. Pick Daytime for a calm break, or Bedtime when you want to wind down for sleep — including daytime naps or sleep after a night shift.
FAMILIAR CHARACTERS. A NEW STORY.
Found a world you want to return to? After starting a story, Tonight lets you bring its characters back in a new one with one tap. No need to think of another topic.
GET TO KNOW YOUR NIGHTS
Review your sleep history, add a morning check-in and connect Apple Health to include sleep recorded by your Apple Watch. Use the sleep calculator for suggested bedtimes based on when you want to wake up.
Choose your sounds. Settle into your evening. Make tonight a little quieter.
Additional sound collections, unlimited stories and extended saving and sleep-history features require an optional Premium subscription. The free version contains ads.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00045555:ios.description: Alpha and Omega Ministries is a Christian apologetics organization based in Phoenix, Arizona. James White, director, is a professor, having taught Greek, Systematic Theology, and various topics in the field of apologetics for numerous schools. He has authored or contributed to more than twenty four books, including The King James Only Controversy, The Forgotten Trinity, The Potter’s Freedom, The God Who Justifies and What Every Christian Needs to Know About the Qur’an. He is an accomplished debater, having engaged in more than one hundred seventy-four moderated, public debates with leading proponents of Roman Catholicism, Islam, Jehovah’s Witnesses, and Mormonism, as well as critics such as Bart Ehrman, John Dominic Crossan, Marcus Borg, and John Shelby Spong. In recent years James has debated in such locations as Sydney, Australia, as well as mosques in Toronto, London, and South Africa. He is a Pastor/Elder of Apologia Church in Arizona. He has been married to Kelli for more than thirty-seven years, and has two children, and four grandchildren.

bluejetty:00028692:ios.description:
Embark on an adventure with the girls of this epic anime fantasy RPG, Blue Archive, and dive into its world of strategic combat, brought to life by stunning animations. Your journey through Kivotos will be one filled with victory and loss, love and heartbreak, all alongside an unforgettable, touching story. Build strong, deep relationships and get to know each student's unique story while leading your squad. So let's go, Sensei!
■A Fantasy-Filled Anime RPG You'll Never Forget!
Step into Kivotos and your adventure as a teacher will begin. Experience a story of love and friendship with stunning cinematics, in both 2D and 3D animation. Throughout your journey, you'll meet and befriend the students of this world, learning their unique stories and motivations. Each girl plays a vital role in the story: building strong bonds, forming squads to protect those they love, and creating heartwarming memories with Sensei!
■Lead Elite Anime Girls into Battle in this Tactical RPG Experience!
Form a squad with the girls you meet, each contributing their own unique combat elements. Adapt your strategies throughout the adventure to lead them to victory! With stunning animation and 3D cinematics, Blue Archive's combat is a blend of strategy and rich visuals.
■Foster Bonds with the Girls in Relationship Stories!
Every girl in Blue Archive has her own story of love to share. Foster strong bonds with your students in their relationship episodes as you unlock new sides to them in MomoTalk and private chats that shape this fantasy world. With every chapter, you'll find new connections and elements that make this RPG what it is today.
■Explore an Anime-Inspired Fantasy MMORPG Full of Stories
Experience a world where beautiful animation meets RPG mechanics. Its fascinating stories will immerse you as you experience life with the girls of Kivotos. Whether you're on secret missions, battling through gacha content, or enjoying club antics, every corner invites you into another adventure. Lead your squad into each challenge—victory and new stories await every encounter.
■Gacha Your Way to Victory—With Strategy, Epic Fantasy, and Anime Girls!
Recruit students to your squad and battle your way to victory! Each new girl brings a fresh story and a powerful element to wield in your adventure. As you take them into battle, you'll develop new strategies and formations for your RPG adventure. Create strong synergy and lead your squad to victory, unlocking secret episodes!
Blue Archive is more than a game—it's an epic RPG journey, filled with poignant stories of resilience, growth, and love. Experience a school story brought to life by unforgettable girls in this fantasy world. Meet the students of Kivotos and build your squad today!

Your journey through Kivotos will be one filled with victory and loss, love and heartbreak, all alongside an unforgettable, touching story. Build strong, deep relationships and get to know each student's unique story while leading your squad. So let's go, Sensei!

■A Fantasy-Filled Anime RPG You'll Never Forget!
Step into Kivotos and your adventure as a teacher will begin. Experience a story of love and friendship with stunning cinematics, in both 2D and 3D animation. Throughout your journey, you'll meet and befriend the students of this world, learning their unique stories and motivations. Each girl plays a vital role in the story: building strong bonds, forming squads to protect those they love, and creating heartwarming memories with Sensei!

■Lead Elite Anime Girls into Battle in this Tactical RPG Experience!
Form a squad with the girls you meet, each contributing their own unique combat elements. Adapt your strategies throughout the adventure to lead them to victory! With stunning animation and 3D cinematics, Blue Archive's combat is a blend of strategy and rich visuals.

■Foster Bonds with the Girls in Relationship Stories!
Every girl in Blue Archive has her own story of love to share. Foster strong bonds with your students in their relationship episodes as you unlock new sides to them in MomoTalk and private chats that shape this fantasy world. With every chapter, you'll find new connections and elements that make this RPG what it is today.

■Explore an Anime-Inspired Fantasy MMORPG Full of Stories
Experience a world where beautiful animation meets RPG mechanics. Its fascinating stories will immerse you as you experience life with the girls of Kivotos. Whether you're on secret missions, battling through gacha content, or enjoying club antics, every corner invites you into another adventure. Lead your squad into each challenge—victory and new stories await every encounter.

■Gacha Your Way to Victory—With Strategy, Epic Fantasy, and Anime Girls!
Recruit students to your squad and battle your way to victory! Each new girl brings a fresh story and a powerful element to wield in your adventure. As you take them into battle, you'll develop new strategies and formations for your RPG adventure. Create strong synergy and lead your squad to victory, unlocking secret episodes!

Blue Archive is more than a game—it's an epic RPG journey, filled with poignant stories of resilience, growth, and love. Experience a school story brought to life by unforgettable girls in this fantasy world. Meet the students of Kivotos and build your squad today!

bluejetty:00065886:ios.description:
Classic Gin Rummy Card Game — play Gin Rummy offline against the computer.
No internet required. No sign-up. Enjoy a clean, competitive Gin Rummy card game built for quick games, repeated play, and steady improvement.
Whether you are learning Gin Rummy or already know the game well, Classic Gin Rummy gives you flexible rules, adjustable AI difficulty, helpful hints, stats, completed-hand replays, and clear card play.
Why you’ll like Classic Gin Rummy:
• Play Gin Rummy offline
• No account or sign-up required
• Smart computer opponent
• Easy, Medium, and Hard AI difficulty
• Classic Gin, Straight Gin, and Oklahoma Gin
• Custom rules and scoring options
• Helpful hints to avoid common mistakes
• Stats tracking
• Replay completed hands
• Optional four-color deck for easier suit recognition
• Clear cards and smooth play
• Portrait and landscape support
• Fast play and one-tap play options
Choose your rules
Set up Gin Rummy your way with flexible options:
• Target score: 100, 250 or 500
• Simple, Traditional, or Hollywood scoring
• Classic Gin, Straight Gin, or Oklahoma Gin
• Optional Ace Must Be Gin rule
• Optional Spades Double Bonus rule 
• Replay hands after each round
Classic Gin Rummy gameplay
Each hand starts with 10 cards. Build melds by making sets or runs, reduce your deadwood, then knock or go Gin to end the hand.
Face cards are worth 10 points, aces are worth 1 point, and other cards are worth their number value. The lower your deadwood, the better your chance of winning the hand.
Built for comfortable play
Classic Gin Rummy is designed to be easy to read and quick to play, with flexible sorting, smooth card handling, optional fast play, optional four-color suits, and clear end-of-hand scoring.
Play offline anytime — no internet, no sign-up, just Gin Rummy.

bluejetty:00161774:ios.description:
DiversHub is a fan-made Helldivers 2 Companion app that helps players track the Galactic War and stay informed on Major Orders and key planet events!
Key Features:
— Live Galactic War Progress & Map
Monitor planet status, liberation progress, effects, and frontlines with up-to-date reports.
— Push Notifications
Get alerts when Major Orders change, or when a planet is liberated or lost — no more missing critical updates.
— Super Earth News & Updates
Stay informed with updates and summaries about ongoing war for Managed Democracy
— Community Planetary Voting
Vote together with other Divers inside the app on which planet should be prioritised next.
(This is a DiversHub community feature and does not affect in-game DSS voting or official results.)
— DSS Overview
See which system the DSS is currently in, what actions are active, and what effects they provide.
DiversHub is for players who want context, clarity, and faster awareness — without combing through external forums or maps. It doesn’t replace the game, it complements it.
Note: DiversHub is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Arrowhead Game Studios, Sony, or their publishing partners.
All trademarks belong to their respective owners. The app uses publicly available game data and community-reported events to generate status updates.

bluejetty:00173108:ios.description:
Bank Empire Idle is a thrilling iOS game that will take you on a journey of building and expanding your banking empire. As an idle game, it is designed to be played over an extended period, making it perfect for players who enjoy strategic, long-term gameplay. In this game, you play the role of a savvy investor who is building a financial empire from scratch.
Your goal is to grow your banking business by buying upgrades, improving your assets, and expanding your reach. You start with a modest sum of money, and it's up to you to invest wisely to build a successful business. As you progress, you can unlock new upgrades that will help you to streamline your operations and maximize your profits.
One of the key features of Bank Empire Idle is the ability to customize your banking experience. You can choose which upgrades to invest in, which assets to acquire, and how to allocate your resources. As your empire grows, you'll face new challenges and opportunities, requiring you to adapt and evolve your strategy.
The game's graphics are sleek and polished, with an intuitive interface that makes it easy to navigate. The sound effects and music add to the immersive experience, enhancing the gameplay and keeping you engaged. Bank Empire Idle is an addictive and challenging game that will test your strategic skills and keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of mobile gaming, this game is sure to captivate you.

First game mode is Flag Capture. Players choose a team to themselves. Defenders or Attackers. Otherwise attack to the castle and try to capture the flag. Moreover they can use common weapons like Catapult, ballista and fire arrows during the game. If blue team can take the red flag and bring it near blue flag before the time runs out, blue team wins.
Second mode is Team Deathmatch. Player choose a team first at the beginning first. Reds or Blues. The most enemy killer team wins at the en of the time.
Third game mode is Deatchmatch. In this game mode, every player fight for himself only. The most enemy killer player wins the game.
Fourth mode is World Exploration. Players explore battlefields and castles offline. Players are free to play and make strategies in the world as long as they desired. There is no winning or losing in this game mode. There is no any internet connection required in this mode.

bluejetty:00133664:ios.description:
Do you want to learn colors quickly and without difficulties?
Learning color games for kids are a perfect way for the youngest players to start to memorise color names, as well as having fun. Play educational toddler games for children ages 2-5. Learn colors, develop fine motor skills and train your visual memory. Our kids games will introduce your little one to the basic color palette and teach them how to mix colors quickly and correctly.
- 8 interesting learning mini-games to memorize colors;
- easy to learn the names of the colors;
- development of kids fine motor skills;
- simple gameplay and bright interface;
- the kid can use the app independently.
Our color memorization games are made in kids puzzles format!
Kids learning games for toddlers ages 2+ will be introduced to basic homework and will learn mixing and matching colors correctly to get a new color combination at the same time.
~~~ Features of color games for kids ~~~
~ Sort the clothes into sections
Play the sorting mini game and arrange the items of clothing by color. Look at the colors of the doors and objects. Correctly compare them with each other and collect bright sets of clothes in games for toddlers.
~ Explore shapes and colors with fabric patches
In this mini-game for boys and girls, your child has to fix the sofa. Play puzzles for kids, match patches by shape and name their colors. Collect magic stars and learn by playing paint and color learning games for kindergarten kids and babies.
~ Learn to mix colors
Want to see some magic in toddler learning games? Try to get a completely new color mixing by blending one paint with another. What color will be obtained from red and yellow paints? Increase your erudition and knowledge in the baby games world of bright colors!
~ Develop fine motor skills in preschool games
Color learning games for pre-k kids are great for training your little ones' fingers. Our infant games are designed in such a way that the child will have to press, drag, select, twist a lot. Children of 3+ years can enjoy their playtime in toddler color games for preschoolers!
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. mini-game "Wash";
2. mini-game "Items sorting";
3. mini-game "Colorful fabric patches";
4. mini-game "Guess the color";
5. mini-game "Sea shapes";
6. mini-game "Mixing paints";
7. mini-game "Colorful figures".

- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.

bluejetty:00174989:ios.description:
QuoteIQ is the field service management CRM built by contractors, for contractors. Whether you run a pressure washing company, HVAC business, plumbing operation, landscaping crew, roofing team, cleaning service, or any other home service trade — QuoteIQ gives you every tool you need to run your business from one app.
Created by service industry professionals with 2M+ followers across platforms and years of hands-on field experience, QuoteIQ was designed to solve the real problems contractors face every day: messy scheduling, slow invoicing, lost leads, and paying too much for software that does too little.
KEY FEATURES
CRM & Client Management
Organize every customer, lead, and job in one place. Track communication history, job notes, and follow-ups. Your entire client database lives in your pocket.
Estimates & Invoicing
Create professional estimates and invoices in seconds from your phone or desktop. Customers can view, approve, and pay online. Track what is paid, pending, and overdue.
Scheduling & Dispatch
Drag-and-drop scheduling. Assign jobs to your team, set recurring appointments, and view your entire week at a glance. Scheduling flows naturally from the quote.
InstaQuote
Let customers quote themselves. Embed a self-service quoting form on your website or send a direct link — customers select services, see pricing, and submit a request.
InstaSchedule
Customers see your real-time availability and book themselves 24/7. Live-syncs with your QuoteIQ calendar. Eliminates phone tag and reduces no-shows.
AI Estimator
Data-driven pricing suggestions based on service type, square footage, and market rates. Quote with confidence using real pricing intelligence.
MapMeasure Pro
Measure roofs, driveways, lawns, and properties remotely using satellite imagery. Get accurate square footage without leaving your truck.
Pre-Inspection Checklists
Document property conditions before every job. Create custom forms for any service. Export completed forms to the customer.
Job Costing & Expense Tracking
Track materials, labor, and expenses per job. Know your true profit margins on every project.
Business Insights & Reporting
See your revenue, close ratio, lead sources, and sales trends at a glance.
Route Optimization
Plan the most efficient routes for your crew. Save time, save fuel, and fit more jobs into every day.
Review Multiplier
Automatically request reviews from happy customers after job completion. Build your online reputation on autopilot.
In-App Texting
Text customers directly from the app. Send reminders, on-my-way notifications, and follow-ups. Every conversation is saved to the client record.
Client Portal
Customers can view estimates, approve quotes, pay invoices, and communicate with your team from one professional portal.
Website Builder
Build a professional website for your business directly inside QuoteIQ. No coding, no extra cost.
WHO USES QUOTEIQ
QuoteIQ serves thousands of service professionals across every home service trade including pressure washing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, lawn care, roofing, cleaning, painting, handyman, junk removal, pest control, tree service, gutter cleaning, concrete coating, and construction.
AFFORDABLE PLANS FOR EVERY STAGE
Plans start at $29.99/month with a 14-day free trial on every plan including our most advanced tier. QuoteIQ costs a fraction of the big-name field service platforms while delivering more features built specifically for service contractors.
Start your free trial today and see why thousands of contractors are switching to QuoteIQ.
Support: support@quoteiq.io
Terms of service (EULA)
https://myquoteiq.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00078112:ios.description:
Welcome to the iTECH Wearables App!
Set goals for health, fitness, and nutrition. Pair with an iTECH Smartwatch or Fitness Tracker to track steps, heart rate, calories burned, sleep, and so much more!
Compatible with the following iTECH Wearables devices:
iTECH Bold 3 - iTECH Active 3 - iTECH Fusion 3 - iTECH Elite 3 - iTECH Fusion R - iTECH Fusion S - iTECH Sport - iTECH Active 4 - iTECH Fusion 4 - iTECH Active 4 Pro
and MORE COMING SOON!
Connect to an iTECH device to enjoy the following features:
TRACK YOUR HEALTH
Steps
Water and Coffee Intake
Weight Changes
Calorie Tracking
Heart Rate* (Only for reference. Not intended for medical purposes)
Blood Oxygen* (Only for reference. Not intended for medical purposes)
* on available models
SET GOALS - Sometimes we are so busy taking care of work or family that we forget to take care of ourselves. Set daily goals for steps, sleep, calories burned, weight and more.
WATCH NOTIFICATIONS - See texts, calls, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and other notifications right on your watch. You decide what you want to see in the app settings.
ENHANCED CALORIE TRACKER - Monitor your calorie intake and calories burned. Check out our new food intake library, where you can easily view nutrition facts and add items to your calories consumed log.
SLEEP DETECTION - Have your watch track the quality of your sleep. It even knows if you get up for a (healthy) midnight snack!
CUSTOMIZE WATCH FACES - Access an extensive library of watch faces or create your own. Change your watch face to match your outfit, mood, or season! (available for select watches)
MOVEMENT REMINDER - Sitting in an office chair or the couch too long? Enable friendly reminders to stand up and get moving throughout the day.
CONNECTED GPS - Create a custom route or just keep track of where you've been and where you're going with this helpful feature.
OTA UPDATES - With Over-The-Air (OTA) support, your watch will receive the latest software updates with any firmware and feature improvements.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
Camera Remote, Vibrating Alarms, Music Remote (Available for Select Watches), Weather Forecast (Available for Select Watches), Find Your Watch, and SO MUCH MORE!
PERMISSIONS
For use of all app features, we require the following permissions:
CAMERA
CONTACTS
LOCATION
STORAGE
BLUETOOTH
CALL LOGS
READ PHONE STATE
PROCESS OUTGOING CALLS
*No information shared with third parties

- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices.

bluejetty:00120015:ios.description:
Solve thousands of clues in the biggest and best crossword puzzle ever! 
Now you can enjoy a new crossword challenge every day with this giant collection of hundreds of original puzzles.
There are over 100,000 unique clues to solve as well as dozens of quests to complete and trophies to collect!
Choose from TWELVE game modes:
 ■ DAILY THEMED PUZZLE
 Enjoy a new crossword each day, featuring clues linked to a trivia fact about today's date that's revealed on completion! 
 ■ WORLD'S BIGGEST Crossword
 Explore over 2,800 crossword puzzles. The classic puzzle enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.
 ■ WORLD'S TALLEST Crossword
 A collection of 1,100 extra-large puzzles - bigger grids, longer words, tougher clues! How high can you build the tower?
 ■ DAILY DIAMOND Crossword
 Earn extra rewards with a snack-sized bonus puzzle each day.
 ■ SEVEN WORDS Puzzle
 Solve the clues and use the scrambled letter blocks to find 7 hidden words.
 ■ CRYPTOGRAM Puzzle
 Break the code, reveal the quote!
 ■ CODEWORDS Puzzle
 Decipher the code to complete the crossword grid. Each square is marked with a number corresponding with one letter of the alphabet. Look for patterns and use your powers of deduction to crack the code!
 ■ WORD GRID Puzzle
 Slide the tiles from the edge of the grid into the blank squares to spell out words. Unlike a regular crossword, there are no clues so instead you'll have to use logic to choose between the available letters for each square.
 ■ QUOTE FALLS Puzzle
 Place the letter tiles from each column into the correct squares on the grid to spell out a famous quotation!
 ■ BRITISH CRYPTICS Crossword
 The ultimate challenge - cryptic crosswords use their own obscure rules to hide the answer in the clue, using anagrams, double meanings, and a host of other subtle tricks. If you get completely stumped on a clue, you can swap it out for an easier, non-cryptic alternative.
 ■ FACT OF THE DAY
 Curious facts to puzzle the mind!
 ■ MISSING LETTERS
 Solve the curious conundrum, reveal the word.
 Also look out for special timed events!
Complete all the core challenges to earn the title of Crossword Superstar!
 + Solve all 100,000+ clues
 + Complete all 11,000+ puzzles
 + Collect all 45 trophies
 + Complete all 57 quests
 + Unlock all 10 achievements
SUPPORT
Please select the [HELP] option from the Pause Menu (the gear icon at the top-right of the game screen) if you require assistance.
If you require further assistance or are unable to access the in-game help, you can contact us via email: support@puzzling.com
Crossword is free to play, but contains optional paid items to unlock content more quickly.

bluejetty:00021410:ios.description:
Yellow Taxi offers car transportation in Barcelona, Spain. With our app you can book a ride and travel the city.
PAY WITH CASH OR CARD
Yellow Taxi Barcelona provides high quality service. Book a cab and get ride anywhere in Catalunya and pay by card or cash. If you travel to airport, you can make a pre booking and pay with card easily.
MANY SERVICE TYPES
Yellow Taxi Barcelona allows you to book different types of taxi: car with 4 seats or one-person, or 5-seater, or 6-seater, or 7 and 8-seater transport for travel with children. Book a ride in advance or get trip in Catalunya at a hand.
BARCELONA AIRPORTS
Need an airport transfer to Barcelona airport, Girona airport, Reus airport, Sants station (Renfe train station) or any other station? Yellow Taxi Barcelona is ready to take you home or to the hotel. Our cabs make rides around Barcelona and Catalunya.
SAFE TAXI TRIPS FOR TOURISTS
If you want to travel taking an excursion ride around Barcelona - taxi ride might be an option. It's fast, safe, cheap and comfortable. Better than public transport. With Yellow Taxi Barcelona you can take ride with an entire group on a trip in Catalunya.
SAFE LOCAL TAXI DRIVERS
Yellow Taxi drivers know Barcelona very well. Need fast ride to Barcelona airport? Need a sightseeing tour around city or Catalunya? Looking for good restaurant or fashionable place? Our taxi drivers are always around to pick you up again return to the hotel, airport, train station or any other place.
Yellow Taxi: contact us
https://www.yellowtaxi.es/
Email: info@yellowtaxi.es
Phone: 34930268358

bluejetty:00185704:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
There’s no victory like one against your rivals! Feel the rush of competition in Command & Conquer: Rivals, an action-packed RTS with strategic tactics capable of turning the tide of any battle. Take control of your customized army and conquer your opponent in The War for Tiberium. Team up with friends to share resources in alliances. Create your combination of infantry, tanks, aircraft, and more to outsmart your opponent’s strategy in fast, fun PvP matches. 
THE THRILL OF VICTORY IS YOURS
In Command & Conquer: Rivals, the strategy behind your skills determines victory or defeat. Choose a Commander to lead your forces – each holds powerful abilities that can influence your approach. Customize your army with winning combinations of infantry, tanks, aircraft, and more. Then evolve it to align with your Commander’s unique abilities, before unleashing destructive weapons and vehicles in quick and exciting PvP battles!
REVEL IN RIVALRY
Test your strategy against your opponent’s strategy in live PvP as you battle to outwit your rivals in real time! Choose to fight for the Global Defense Initiative or Brotherhood of Nod. Restock your supplies and boost your army with valuable supply convoys. Join an alliance to team up with friends, share resources, and climb the leaderboards. Complete daily challenges for massive rewards that improve your Commanders, weapons, and abilities. Grow your army with every victory in this adrenaline-fueled RTS!
Important Consumer Information. Some images shown may contain in-app purchases. This app: Requires a persistent Internet connection (network fees may apply). Requires acceptance of EA's Privacy & Cookie Policy and User Agreement. Collects data through third party analytics technology (see Privacy & Cookie Policy for details). Allows to communicate via in-game Alliance chat feature. Contains direct links to the Internet and social networking sites intended for an audience over 13. The app uses Game Center. Log out of Game Center before installation if you don't want to share your game play with friends. 
User Agreement: http://terms.ea.com
Privacy and Cookie Policy: http://privacy.ea.com
Visit http://help.ea.com for assistance or inquiries
EA may retire online features after 30 days' notice posted on www.ea.com/service-updates.

- Earn milestone badges for achieving special goals
- Chat with other players in the app to strategize and work together

Are you looking for a way to host fun and challenging VIRTUAL EVENTS with your customers, clients, or business partners? EVENTZEE’s scavenger hunt app is the answer. If you're looking for a TEAM BUILDING exercise, or new ways to ENGAGE with your CUSTOMERS, or a fun family ACTIVITY, our Eventzee app is the most customizable scavenger hunt app available on the market.

If you’re interested in using Eventzee’s scavenger hunt app for your next event, visit our website and choose the right package for you. Eventzee is ideal for trade shows, conferences orientations, and more. Businesses can use the app to drive traffic to specific locations, promote vendors or products and increase social interactions. Some of our clients use Eventzee to hold contests and give away prizes to their most engaged customers. Achieve all of your business goals with Eventzee.

FEATURES:
- Eventzee offers the most challenge of any scavenger hunt app on the market: Photo, Video, Quiz, GPS, QR Code, Text and Information
- Climb the event leaderboard to reach the highest rank
- Earn milestone badges for achieving special goals
- Chat with other players in the app to strategize and work together
- Share photos and videos to social media to flex your accomplishments
- Post content to the in-game feed where others can view and "like" it
- Access admin features in-app to approve challenges on site without a computer

LEARN MORE at eventzeeapp.com

bluejetty:00136721:android.description:

Collect fragments to unlock more outstanding skins, providing a more enjoyable and relaxing gaming experience. Then, take on the incredibly challenging levels to reap rich rewards!
A simple yet enjoyable Tap Away puzzle game that keeps your brain active.

Superb Tap Away gameplay, deserving of the best Tap Away players.
A plethora of 3D pixel paintings that evoke a relaxed and joyful feeling.
Conquer extremely challenging levels and receive generous rewards.
An outstanding game suitable for all age groups! Children, adults, and the elderly. Let's play together!

bluejetty:00066400:android:1.summary:

bluejetty:00066400:android:1.description:
Join the millions of riders who trust Uber for their everyday travel needs. Whether you’re running an errand across town or exploring a city far from home, getting there should be easy.
FIND THE RIDE YOU WANT
Find the perfect ride right at your fingertips! Uber is here to make your journey stress-free and enjoyable.
Pick from a wide range of products that the Uber app has to offer including: 
- UberX: Affordable rides, all to yourself
- Electric: Eco-Friendly
- UberXL: Affordable rides for groups up to 6
- Comfort: Newer cars with extra legroom
- Comfort Electric: Premium zero-emission cars
- Uber Pet: Affordable rides for you and your pet
- Black: Luxury rides with professional drivers
- Taxi: You now have the option to request a cab or a taxi on demand using Uber in select cities
- 2-wheels: Find a scooter to start riding roday 
UPFRONT PRICING
With Uber, you no longer need to worry about hidden costs or unexpected surprises. As you enter your destination in the app, you get upfront pricing and the estimated time of arrival.
SAFETY TOGETHER
Safety is a top priority at Uber. We have established comprehensive safety features to help ensure every rider and driver feels secure and comfortable.
AFFORDABLE PRICING
We’re doing all we can to make our pricing as transparent as possible.
- UberX Share: UberX Share connects you to other riders headed in the same direction. 
- Group Rides: Share the journey with friends.
- Split Fare: Don’t worry about doing the math later—split the cost evenly while you’re still on the ride. 
JOIN UBER ONE FOR EXCLUSIVE PERKS
Benefit from $0 Delivery Fee and up to 10% off eligible delivery and pickup orders, 6% Uber Cash back on eligible rides and a $5 credit if our Latest Arrival Estimate on your order is off. Other fees & terms apply. For more details see uber.com/uberone.
RESERVE RIDES IN ADVANCE
Need a ride at a specific time? No problem! Uber allows you to reserve rides in advance, so you can plan your day with confidence. 
GO GREEN
Uber is committed to building a sustainable future for our cities. With a growing fleet of electric and hybrid vehicles, you can choose eco-friendly rides to reduce your carbon footprint.
RENT CARS 
Whether you need a car today or later, the online booking experience and vehicle selection will help you find the right vehicle for a family vacation, a weekend getaway, airport travel, errands and more.
MORE FEATURES
Delivery: Order food from your favorite restaurants through Uber Eats. Stock up on groceries, shop pharmacy, convenience and pet supplies and get them all delivered. 
Uber Connect: an easy, same-day, no-contact delivery solution that allows people to send items whether it’s a care package for a loved one or an item you sold online.
Transit: Say goodbye to complicated time schedules, hectic transfers, and unexpected waits while reducing your trip’s emissions.
Uber Charter: Book high-capacity group rides in vehicles seating 14-55 passengers, such as limo buses, luxury vans, and coach buses.
2-Wheels: Did you know you can also bike or ride a scooter with the Uber app?
Uber for Business: Manage and track business travel, meal programs, and more on one dashboard.
Uber Hourly: Keep a car and driver with you for hours. 
Uber Car Seat: Uber Car Seat provides one forward-facing car seat for a child who is at least 2 years old, 22 pounds, and 31 inches tall.
Get Started Now! Download the Uber app and create an account today. Uber is available in the following cities: Boston, DC, LA, New York, San Francisco, Vegas, Orlando, Chicago and more. Check if Uber is available in your city at https://www.uber.com/cities. Stay updated on the latest news, promotions, and offers by following us on Twitter at https://twitter.com/uber and liking us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/uber.

bluejetty:00160244:ios.description:
Descubra a palavra de Deus de uma maneira inovadora com "Bíblia NVI em Português", a aplicação essencial para o estudo bíblico no idioma português brasileiro. Esta aplicação única oferece uma experiência de leitura rica e personalizável para aprofundar a sua fé e conhecimento.
Características Principais:
Texto Completo da Bíblia NVI: A versão Nova Versão Internacional (NVI) em português brasileiro, reconhecida pela sua precisão e clareza.
Recursos Bíblicos Extras: "Bíblia NVI em Português" não é apenas uma Bíblia digital; inclui temas bíblicos para pregação, devocionais diários, estudos bíblicos detalhados e bosquejos de sermões que ajudarão tanto os novos crentes quanto os estudiosos experientes.
Bíblia em Áudio: Para aqueles que preferem ouvir, oferecemos a Bíblia em um formato de áudio imersivo. Perfeito para ouvir em trânsito ou durante o estudo.
Personalização do Texto: A "Bíblia NVI em Português" oferece a opção de ajustar o tamanho do texto para uma leitura confortável, além de um modo noturno para reduzir a tensão ocular em ambientes com pouca luz.
Interface Intuitiva: Uma interface de usuário fácil de navegar que torna o acesso aos livros, capítulos e versículos da Bíblia uma experiência suave e intuitiva.
Acesso Offline: Leia a Bíblia ou escute o áudio mesmo sem conexão com a internet.
Atualizações Regulares: "Bíblia NVI em Português" se compromete a melhorar continuamente, oferecendo atualizações regulares para enriquecer sua experiência de estudo.
Suporte Multidispositivo: Acesse a "Bíblia NVI em Português" em vários dispositivos, sincronizando suas notas e marcadores.
Compartilhamento Fácil: Compartilhe versículos e insights com amigos e familiares através das redes sociais ou email.
Funcionalidades Avançadas:
Por que escolher 'Bíblia NVI em Português'?
Esta aplicação não é apenas uma ferramenta para ler a Bíblia, mas um companheiro completo para seu crescimento espiritual. Os recursos adicionais como os devocionais diários e estudos bíblicos oferecem orientação e inspiração diária. O formato de áudio e as opções de personalização do texto garantem que a palavra de Deus esteja sempre acessível, independentemente de suas circunstâncias ou preferências de leitura.
Seja para estudo pessoal, preparação de sermões ou apenas para encontrar conforto nas escrituras, "Bíblia NVI em Português" é a escolha ideal para conectar-se à palavra de Deus no seu dia a dia. Baixe agora e comece a sua jornada de fé e conhecimento com esta aplicação extraordinária.

But first things first—you'r
bluejetty:00143912:ios.description:
Let the elegant sound of carefully sharpened metal on meticulously maintained ice ring through your ears as you manage your very own ice skating rink. Train up your eager staff and enter them into competitions.
But first things first—you're going to need a huge rink, a place where your customers can glide with glee. And you never know when a carefully placed object on the ice may lead to an impromptu photoshoot.
Make sure your skaters are warm and happy off the ice with a heated room and soup bar. Some people might even post their experiences on social media, too!
Keep customers coming back by listening to their requests, like increasing the food choices at your rink. And with the right combination, who knows what amazing dishes you may discover! You can't skate on an empty stomach, after all!
You're also going to need a capable instructor or two to teach skaters all kinds of amazing tricks and bring out their full potential! And once they master the basics, have them create a figure-skating program and enter competitions! Their success on the ice will mean more business for your rink!
Looks like even the mayor from the town over has heard about your rink and come to check it out for themselves! With this kind of popularity, it won't be long until you have people coming from all over the world!
Now, get ready to create countless wonderful memories with your skaters, and aim to turn your rink into an unforgettable, 5-star facility!
Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at https://kairopark.jp. Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and our paid games!

Note: Jobright currently lists U.S.-based roles only.
Streamline your job search with Jobright — the AI copilot that cuts job hunt time by up to 80% and helps land your next role faster.
With 400,000 new jobs added every day and smart filters that surface roles aligned with your resume, Jobright puts the right opportunities at your fingertips—whether you’re casually browsing or urgently applying.
Smart matches, faster offers
– One feed of fresh jobs pulled from major boards and company sites
– Personalized match scores to spotlight roles that fit your skills and goals
– Insider connection hints to unlock employee referrals and get noticed
– Instant job alerts so you stay ahead of the competition
– Application status tracker that keeps you organized
From recent graduates to seasoned professionals and career switchers, more than 500,000 U.S. job‑seekers already trust Jobright to accelerate their search.
Download Jobright today and let your next role find you.
FAQ:
Q: Is Jobright free to use?
A: Yes. Browsing jobs, receiving match scores, and tracking applications are free. Optional premium tools are clearly labeled inside the app.
Q: Where do the job postings come from?
A: We aggregate openings from leading boards, company career sites, and public listings, refreshing the feed every few minutes.
Q: Does Jobright include remote or hybrid roles?
A: Absolutely. Use the “location” filter to see on‑site, hybrid, or fully remote jobs in seconds.
Q: How is the match score calculated?
A: Our model compares the skills, experience, and salary range in your resume with each job’s requirements, then ranks the fit on a 0–100 scale. 
Q: Who can see my profile?
A: Only employers whose jobs you apply to—or companies you choose to share your resume with—can view your details.

It’s a scientific methodology that ensures a full-body workout targeting cardiovascular health, muscular ability, power development, and metabolic conditioning that directly transfers to strength outside the gym.
Our premium mobile app allows easy first-time registration, existing member class booking, and membership/retail purchasing!

bluejetty:00046115:ios.summary:
PlatoApp is used together with the PlatoWork neurostimulation headset from PlatoScience. The app gives access to the various programs available for your headset.
Triggered by the app, the wireless PlatoWork headset sends electrical micro-c
bluejetty:00046115:ios.description:
PlatoApp is used together with the PlatoWork neurostimulation headset from PlatoScience. The app gives access to the various programs available for your headset.
Triggered by the app, the wireless PlatoWork headset sends electrical micro-currents to stimulate your brain, prompting you into the right mindset for the task at hand. In the app you choose from a list of work mindsets, and the headset helps you get your best work done.
HOW A SESSION WORKS
• Pick a program on the Home screen and see its target current and duration
• Connect your headset over Bluetooth and see its battery level at a glance
• A short contact check makes sure the headset is fitted correctly before stimulation starts
• Follow the countdown and fine-tune the current within the program's range
• Rate the session when it ends — your history keeps track of every session
STAYS CONNECTED IN THE BACKGROUND
Once you start a session, PlatoApp stays connected to your headset over Bluetooth even when the app is in the background or your screen is locked, so your session keeps running and can end safely. A Live Activity on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island shows your session's progress the whole time and disappears when the session ends.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• History: all your past sessions, grouped by date
• Resources: instructions for use, the salt water recipe, maintenance tips and ordering sponges
• Help: support contact details and opening hours
PlatoWork is designed for professional knowledge work, and aims at helping you get into the right mindset for whatever task you are working on. In essence, we want to help you stop wasting time at work — by stimulating your brain in the right direction.
A PlatoWork headset and a PlatoScience account are required to use the app.
Join us at the forefront of science in exploring the amazing world of neurostimulation.

bluejetty:00031443:ios.description:
Enter the immersive and cruel Cyberpunk world full of criminal gangs and outlaws. Equip the best weapon, armor and drones in Night City and start fighting the endless hordes of enemies! Play Cyber Punk Hero and become a real cyber hunter!
Explore gang-ridden ghettoes, secret data centres, dark downtowns, and other dangerous warzones. Battle outlaws to survive on the streets of Night City!
Cybernetic gangsters and robots try to hunt you down to get a pretty price on your head. Upgrade your epic abilities, unlock new guns and skills to get better, faster, stronger, and much more dangerous to your enemies. Leave them no chance to defeat you!
The cyberpunk game controls are intuitive and easy-to-learn. Tap & hold to move, stop to shoot. Remember, you have only one life for each run, so watch out and master your self-defense to win the epic roguelike game.
Why you’ll love the action RPG game:
- CYBERPUNK world with immersive dungeons
- SIMPLE one-finger controls with auto shooting
- HUNDREDS of levels full of unique cybernetic enemies 
- ROGUELIKE game with endless replayability
- WELL-DESIGNED hero upgrade & customization system
- COOL guns armor & other cybernetic equipment
- CHALLENGING levels with hard enemies, armored tanks & and robot bosses
- OFFLINE rewards 
The time of archers and bow masters is over. Now it’s time for the real CYBERPUNK drive!
If you're a true fan of original action RPG games, modern combat shooters, sci-fi and cyberpunk worlds, archero-like gameplay and beautiful 3D graphics, download Cyber Punk Hero: Epic Roguelike now! Defeat cybernetic monsters and true criminals. This world needs a real hero like you!

Challenge your friends and family. Who knows more about food? Compare scores and see who is the ultimate food expert.
Available in 22 languages. Play in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Thai, and many more.
Download Chef Quiz now and see how many dishes you can guess!

bluejetty:00151511:ios.description:
Quer testar as cores de tintas de parede? Com o app Suvinil Teste Sua Cor, tá fácil, tá em casa! Aqui, você pode fazer simulação das cores online das Tintas Suvinil com poucos toques. Com esta ferramenta intuitiva e inspiradora, renovar o seu ambiente nunca foi tão fácil! Você terá uma excelente ideia de como seu espaço ficará depois de pintado antes mesmo de tocar no pincel ou no rolo. Este app é um ótimo ponto de partida para testar, trocar e, principalmente, confirmar qual será a próxima linda cor da sua casa. 
Principais Recursos: 
- Teste de Cores: Veja instantaneamente como suas paredes ficarão com as cores Suvinil escolhidas. O teste de cores no seu ambiente real permite que você visualize suas ideias com mais segurança antes de pintar de verdade. 
- Simulador de Cores: Transforme seu espaço virtualmente! É só abrir o app Suvinil Teste Sua Cor e você já pode utilizar o simulador de cores online, aplicando as cores das nossas tintas na parede da sua casa utilizando a câmera do seu celular. Basta tirar uma foto e começar o teste de cores. Você também pode simular as cores em uma foto já salva na sua galeria do celular. Você fica muito mais seguro ao comparar as cores de tintas para decorar sua casa. 
- Recursos Exclusivos para Simular Cores: utilize recursos exclusivos do simulador de cores online como zoom e visualização das cores em diferentes tipos de iluminação, mudando a temperatura da luz. Vá além com a borracha, para retocar a pintura online, e a fita crepe, que delimita áreas da simulação de cores. 
- Leque Digital das Tintas Suvinil: explore nosso catálogo de cores divididas pelos tons básicos, como laranjas, amarelos, vermelhos, azuis, verdes, cinzas e outros, ou navegue pelas sensações e cores da moda, abrindo novas possibilidade para pintura de parede. A Suvinil também facilita te inspirando com combinações de cores modeladas pelos nossos especialistas e arquitetos que já utilizaram o app Suvinil Teste Sua Cor. 
O que torna o Suvinil Teste Sua Cor único: 
- Tá Fácil, Tá em Casa: Suvinil Teste Sua Cor é o app oficial da Suvinil que vai se aprimorando todo dia com o seu uso e sua avaliação. Descomplique a sua escolha de cores fazendo o teste de cores em nosso simulador. É mais segurança pra você decidir como pintar a sua casa. 
- Interface simples e intuitiva: Estamos todos os dias pensando em como simplificar a sua seleção de cores. Seja você um entusiasta da pintura ou um profissional, aqui, todos podem criar e testar as cores com facilidade usando nossa solução e dando seu feedback para deixá-la cada vez melhor. 
- Identificador de Cores: Para os profissionais que possuem o COLORi, o app Suvinil Teste Sua Cor funciona em conjunto com este identificador de cores, fazendo a leitura de superfícies e encontrando os tons lidos no dispositivo dentro de nosso catálogo de cores. 
O que você vai adorar: 
- Combinações de Cores: você ainda encontra sugestões de combinações de cores escolhidas cuidadosamente pela equipe das Tintas Suvinil. Veja também as sugestões de combinações de cores de arquitetos profissionais e designers de interiores que já utilizaram o app Suvinil Teste Sua Cor. Aproveite estas inspirações pra simular online como estas combinações podem ficar aí na sua casa. 
- Sua Casa, Suas Cores: Crie ambientes que refletem sua personalidade única. O Suvinil Teste Sua Cor permite que você experimente quantas vezes quiser até encontrar a paleta perfeita que transforma sua casa em um verdadeiro lar. 
Resolva o problema: 
A escolha de cores é agora uma tarefa divertida e sem estresse. Descomplique e transforme sua casa com o Suvinil Teste Sua Cor. Dê vida às suas ideias, explore possibilidades infinitas e abrace a transformação sem medo. 
Divirta-se com uma experiência de simulação de cores e deixe sua avaliação. Baixe o Suvinil Teste Sua Cor agora e viva essa transformação. Com a Suvinil, tá fácil, tá em casa!

bluejetty:00133480:ios.description:
Join the Purrfect Adventure at Cat Mart: Your Cozy Grocery Shop!
Welcome to Cat Mart, a world of cuddly kitties and bustling aisles! Here, our feline friends aren't just customers, they're part of the family. 
Embark on an adventure in this unique grocery shop where every day is a joyous animal jam.
What Awaits You in Cat Mart:
- Kawaii World of Cuteness: Meet a variety of cats, from charming Siamese to fluffy Persians, and watch them play, shop, and relax in our cozy mart.
- Build Your Dream Mart: Expand from a mini mart to a mega supermarket. Manage departments, from fresh produce to snack aisles, and create the ultimate shopping paradise.
- Hire Cat Workers: From cashier cats to stocking kitties, your feline staff is ready to help! Managing a mart has never been so adorable.
- Idle Fun & Easy Gameplay: Perfect for players who enjoy casual, relaxing games. With simple, intuitive controls, your mart thrives even when you're away.
- Exciting Challenges & Mini-Games: Keep your customers purring with satisfaction in various mini-games, from burger flipping to pizza making!
Offline Play Available: Enjoy the fun anywhere, anytime. No WiFi? No problem!
In Cat Mart, every day is a satisfying blend of management and fun. 
Watch your mart transform from a humble corner store to a bustling supermarket Earn money, invest in upgrades, and become the boss of the most adorable mart ever!
Special Features:
- Cozy & Healing Atmosphere: A relaxing escape filled with cute animations and soothing gameplay.
- Engaging Collectibles: From rare cats to unique food items, there's always something to discover.
- Earn Rewards & Bonuses: Keep an eye out for special offers, events, and surprise bonuses.
- Are you ready to take on the delightful challenge of running Cat Mart? Whether you're a tycoon-in-the-making or just looking for a fun, relaxing game, Cat Mart is the purrfect choice!

- Terms of Service: https://termsofservice.treeplla.com/

bluejetty:00066342:ios.description:
* Required: A little Japanese.
With a total of 200,000 downloads worldwide! 
- Indie Games Festival 2019 In Japan, Finalist & Godzilla Award.
- Xiamen Game Development Contest 2018, Best Game Plan Award. 
"Sumo Roll" is a casual sumo game app with simple operation based on physics.
Long, long time ago...,
In the far east country Zipang, There was a fighting sport called SUMO...
Enjoy Japanese style! Sumo exclamation!
/// Game introduction ////
Let's aim to the Yokozuna! with somewhat strange movement wrestlers!
Even if it becomes pinch, aim for reversal by charge!
If you can not win, raise the level and challenge again!
You can also play with friends and family in the versus mode.
Let's listen first what "Frog Oyakata" says.
Look closely at the movement of the opponent!
Unnecessarily tapping become you will stun.
But If you do not operate, a cushion is thrown from the audience ;)
/// Rules ///
[Win]
1. Push the opponent out of the ring.
2. Make the opponent touch the ground.
『体』= Life Power
『魂』= Stamina Power
『雷』= Sumo jutsu Power
*『雷』If you accumulate this, power up (with time limit).
Sumo Roulette
-『魂』Bonus
-『雷』Bonus
/// Operation ///
Various action with four buttons.
- Top left Button: Sumo Push = Body Attack / Wrestle
- Top right Button: Sumo Chop = Hand Attack
- Bottom left or Bottom right Button: Sumo Step = Dodge / Body throw
- Long press: Sumo Charge =『雷』fast charge
/// Growing ///
 Only four elements.
『心』= Defense power
『技』= Attack power
『体』= Life power
『雷』= Sumo jutsu
/// Character collection ///
Sumo wrestlers can get 15 or more.
If you clear the conditions you can get a strong character!
/// Versus mode. ///
Let's play with friends and family.
1player on the left side and 2player on the right side.
/// Sound ///
- taron
- Wingless Seraph
- 効果音ラボ
Have a nice Sumo Soul!
Enjoy Japanese style! 
Sumo exclamation!
*This game is a fiction of Japan's traditional "sumo" which is sports and martial arts. It has nothing to do with real people or groups.

Will you be able to clear these simple-looking but actually difficult stages?

bluejetty:00156883:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00156883:ios.description:
** Start enjoying a free and fast IV calculator for your Little Monsters **
Calcy IV calculates the IV, DPS & PvP Ranks of your monsters and displays them conveniently in-game.
You can see possible IV even before catching a monster. Additionally, Calcy IV automatically generates nicknames in every possible format and assembles your perfect battle teams for Raids.
--------------
Calcy IV needs neither login nor manual screenshots. There is no need to leave the game while using Calcy IV.
--------------
** Overview & IV **
Every monster has hidden stats - the Individual Values (IV). They can be seen in the appraisal of your team leader and determine how strong a monster can get in terms of CP or when fighting other players.
Calcy IV records your screen and displays your monster's IV, DPS and PvP Ranks via a notification directly in-game. You can see the IV range before you even caught the monster.
When you see a good monster, you can expand the notification to see its full stats, including move rankings, the cost to level it up, and many more.
Are you a raider, a PvP player, a collector, or do you want to know *just everything* about a monster? Whatever your goals, you can set up Calcy IV to completely fit your needs.
** Renaming & Custom Keyboard **
Calcy automatically generates a nickname based on many adjustable blocks (containing e.g. IV, move types, DPS, and PvP stats). Then you can easily insert it in the game using Calcy's custom keyboard.
** Trainer Battles / PvP **
Whether you are a PvP veteran or you want to start diving into the battles with other trainers, Calcy helps you finding the right monster for it.
In fights against other players all attacks deal different damage then usually. Calcy calculates the damage per turn accordingly in these fights.
Moreover, due to the CP limit for PvP leagues, the optimal IV for PvP fights are very specific combinations that may be hard to find. Calcy calculates these optimal IV and tells you for every monster how close it is to perfection (the so called "PvP Rank" or "PvP IV").
** Battle Simulation & Raid Counters **
Calcy's battle simulator will calculate the perfect battle team from all of your monsters for every raid. It is accessible in-app or by simply scanning a raid boss in-game.
Calcy not only shows you how to beat the boss but also exactly how much damage you do. This allows you to decide whether you may need 2, 3 or 4 people for this raid. Of course, this calculation takes the different moves, weather and friendship buffs into account.
You can easily find the recommended monsters directly in the game with the help of a generated search string.
The battle simulator always works with high precision and includes the Breakpoints of your monsters (the next level where the damage of your attack-moves increases)

bluejetty:00171402:ios.description:

We help you reach your wellness goals with inspirational courses that will keep you engaged and motivated. Whatever life challenge you may be facing, you will most likely find a meditation for it in our 1,400+ video library. Try searching for ANYTHING and shift your mood at the click of a button.
We get to work with the best meditation teachers in the world who know how to keep meditation simple, modern and fun so that you will actually WANT to meditate. We film, produce and curate every video on the app inside of the world's first secular meditation studio, Unplug in Los Angeles.
Unplug is recommended by the top MD’s, the American Heart Association, psychologists, fertility doctors, therapists, and mental health experts.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT?
- We use video so you feel personally connected to our world famous teachers
- We film and produce inside the world’s first secular meditation studio: Unplug Meditation
- We are more than just a mindfulness app - we have sound baths, hypnosis, guided journeys, aromatherapy, yoga, fitness, and so much more
- We have a variety like you won’t believe with 130+ teachers, 40+ topics and countless techniques so you can find what works best for you
- Guided meditation for ANY situation (and we mean that)
- Fun and easy monthly meditation challenges with different themes
- We participated in Apple Entrepreneur Camp at Apple Park. Over the course of 9 days, Apple helped us design the app to be easy to use, beautiful to look at, and more accessible to all
- Our meditation experts keep things simple, modern and fun so you’ll be inspired to meditate daily
- We keep it short, powerful and effective with videos ranging from 1 to 45 minutes
- Meditation timer & ambient sounds for self-guided sessions
- 7-Day Intro to Meditation to kickstart your practice
- 30-Day Meditation Challenge to build a consistent practice you love
- Stay motivated by setting meditation reminders, goals & track your profile stats
- Learn to meditate with our course library and then grow and explore from there
- Save all your favorite meditations in custom playlists
- Gratitude journal to start and end your day positive
- Fresh, new content added regularly
- Great for adults & children
- Compatible with Dynamic Text
- Compatible with Siri Shortcuts to play the meditation of the day or night
- Sync your meditation stats with Apple Health
- Compatible with SharePlay during FaceTime calls
*Children should consult a parent before creating an account.

bluejetty:00160321:ios.name: Mirai Mobile
bluejetty:00160321:ios.summary: Mirai Mobile is THE destination for learning how to grow bonsai trees. As the FIRST and ONLY personalized bonsai guide, we use short-form videos and tutorials to walk you through fundamental bonsai care and the techniques that advance your
bluejetty:00160321:ios.description:
Mirai Mobile is THE destination for learning how to grow bonsai trees. As the FIRST and ONLY personalized bonsai guide, we use short-form videos and tutorials to walk you through fundamental bonsai care and the techniques that advance your bonsai practice. From first time bonsai beginners to the most advanced bonsai practitioners, Mirai Mobile customizes your experience to teach you what you need to know when you need to know it. Precisely timed notifications alert you to work you can perform on the bonsai trees in your collection with timing tailored to your growing region anywhere in the world. Species specific calendars provide step-by-step instructional videos telling you what to do with the bonsai in your collection throughout the year. Mirai Mobile’s robust gallery tracks your trees and documents their progress allowing you to review history and plan for the future. Detailed courses explain the why of bonsai care and cultivation, deepening your knowledge and enhancing your understanding. With Mirai Mobile we’ve taken the guesswork out of bonsai so you can focus on creating healthy, beautiful trees. 
Your on-the-go Mirai Mobile app compliments Bonsai Mirai’s cutting-edge online educational platform Mirai Live, an in-depth library of technical and artistic bonsai instruction. Try both for FREE when you register for the app and cancel at any time. Test your hand at the art of bonsai and experience the magic of this timeless pursuit. 
- My Trees allows you to track the progress of your garden's trees and show off your collection to friends and family with just a few taps. The Tree Detail Page displays what current and upcoming recommended work you can perform for each tree. The Activity History logs bonsai work you've accomplished so you know what actions were completed and when. The personalized gallery makes it easy to capture an image with your phone or upload images after each activity so you can store the progression of each of your bonsai in their own individualized gallery.
- Academy provides a library of courses that help you build your knowledge and understand “why” you perform each calendar activity for your trees. With recommended courses based on season, technique, species, and trees in your collection, Mirai Mobile’s Academy is an endless wealth of bonsai knowledge. Complete with a syllabus that details what to expect and how long it will take to complete; we’ve brought an academic approach to your fingertips that demystifies bonsai. At the end of each course, test your knowledge with a course evaluation to ensure you can apply the knowledge you learned to your bonsai practice. 
- Calendar is the culmination of Mirai’s 30+ years of knowledge outlining what actions you should perform on each species in your bonsai collection and when to perform them over the year. Whether viewing the actual calendar or the sequential timeline, Mirai Mobile’s calendar feature allows you to quickly understand the upcoming activities on your bonsai with a short description to help you better prepare for the season ahead. Click on any activity within the calendar, and you’ll find a brief description of the work followed by a short-form step-by-step video teaching you the pivotal points to improving your bonsai. All your gallery trees requiring this same scope of work are listed together to log this activity once completed.
Mirai Mobile is the newest installment to the greater Mirai Academy, our innovative, best-in-class online educational platform for bonsai practitioners. From beginning bonsai enthusiasts to the most serious and dedicated bonsai creators, anyone can learn bonsai in-depth and at their own pace. Join us with your 7-day free trial for all new users and treat yourself to discovering the art of bonsai and elevating your bonsai practice to the next level. Build your skills with Mirai! 
Privacy Policy: https://live.bonsaimirai.com/privacy

bluejetty:00021027:ios.name: Gin Rummy Legends
bluejetty:00021027:ios.summary: Test your wits in a quick, addictively fun, and easy-to-learn card game that will keep your mind deeply engaged thanks to a constant supply of thrilling tactical decisions! Play online, chat and meet new friends from all around the world or
bluejetty:00021027:ios.description:
Test your wits in a quick, addictively fun, and easy-to-learn card game that will keep your mind deeply engaged thanks to a constant supply of thrilling tactical decisions! Play online, chat and meet new friends from all around the world or invite your best buddies to join you. Experience the most social Gin Rummy app ever created!
Gin rummy is a timeless classic that owes its long-lived popularity to the phenomenal balance between simplicity of gameplay mechanics and a constant supply of thrilling and highly consequential choice-making. Game rounds are short and exciting which makes the game perfect for busy modern-day life while its underlying deep layer of poker-like mind-games and subtle strategy will definitely keep you engaged during longer sessions.
Features:
● Online multiplayer - fair and fast matchmaking for players of every skill level.
● Chat with friends - real-time chat with emotes, voice, and image sending.
● Responsive gameplay - designed to deliver the best experience and feedback.
● Fair card system - truly random card shuffling.
● Stunning looks and immersive sounds- beautifully crafted game tables and cards with full 3D animations and realistic sound fx.
● Tournaments and events - compete to win amazing rings, trophies, coins, and other cool rewards.
● Leaderboards - climb to the top of local and global rankings.
● Play on multiple devices - login with Facebook and always have access to your account, friends, coins, and game stats.
● Many supported languages - English, French, German, Spanish, Hebrew, Greek, Italian, Turkish, and many others.
● Coin logs - If you have any doubt about your account's coin activity you can access 'Coin Logs' and check your account history, just like you can do at a bank.
● Constant improvements - crafted by a passionate team that truly cares about delivering the most immersive and fun gaming experience. We listen to our players and update the game regularly with new features and improvements.
Our app offers the most polished and realistic experience of traditional gin rummy plus all the benefits of the social mobile ecosystem. Join our welcoming community of the best competitive players, learn their tricks and sharpen your skills. Become the brightest of all rummy stars and ascend to the status of a true Legend!
Want to get in touch with us?
Contact us at contact@ahoygames.com

Transform your iPhone and iPad into a powerful document scanner with AI-powered intelligence. Scan documents, IDs, receipts, contracts, and more — then analyze, extract, and sign them all in one app.

bluejetty:00021380:ios.description:
“In this world nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes.” - Benjamin Franklin
With Taxes Suck, you can easily estimate your taxes in seconds! NO degree required! Let’s face it, paying Taxes Sucks! It’s not your fault the tax code takes an advanced degree to be an expert in.
Taxes Suck is a simple but powerful United States income tax calculator intended to help you easily estimate your Federal and State income tax liability.
Take control of your Taxes Today! Taxes Suck helps estimate the correct amount of Federal and State taxes to withhold from your paycheck (Don’t trust your W-4 from your employer). If you are self-employed, it helps to estimate your estimated taxes. If you are employed, self-employed, have investment income, etc., it helps estimate income taxes for that too!
Taxes Suck is great for Tax Planning. Whether you are self-employed, weighing business reinvestment options, or you are simply trying to decide between Traditional vs. Roth retirement contributions, Taxes Suck can help make tax decisions easier by showing you current-year tax savings.
Taxes Suck is excellent for any Do-It-Yourself type of person and great for professionals assisting clients. Taxes Suck gives you the ability to run income tax projections in seconds. Learn with Taxes Suck about different types of income, deductions, & tax credits and how those affect your tax bill.
“Only on the App Store”
Tax Year 2026 is a One-Time charge of $3.99!
Prior Year is FREE to use!
Note - States are slow to update their tax brackets. If current-year state brackets are unavailable, prior-year brackets will be used until the state issues current-year brackets.
Federal calculations include:
- Ordinary federal income tax.
- Long-term capital gain tax.
- FICA tax.
- Self-employment tax.
- Self-employment tax deduction. 
- Additional Medicare (Self-employment only).
- Qualified business income deduction with threshold & phaseout.
- Net investment income tax.
- Taxable portion of Social Security Income.

欲知更多詳情請見中華郵政全球資訊網：https://www.post.gov.tw
行動郵局的五大特色：
一、 推播通知：推播通知好安心，為你提供個人化且即時的通知訊息。
二、 據點預約：服務預約好便利，線上先抽號碼牌和填單，臨櫃免等待。
三、 掃碼收付：掃碼收付好可靠，帳號不用記，出示收付款碼都沒問題。
四、 快速登入：一次設定好輕鬆，用生物辨識或圖形密碼，交易更方便。
五、 無卡提款：無卡提款好簡單，手機就是提款卡，不帶錢包也能領。
為維護網路交易安全，行動郵局採用TLS 1.1及TLS1.2加密協定作為資料傳輸保護機制，目前最低支援作業系統版本為iOS 15以上版本，非屬上述版本，建請先行升級作業系統或更換支援之行動裝置。
行動郵局APP使用權限說明：
一、位置：據點預約服務須使用該權限。
二、聯絡人：手機號碼轉帳須使用該權限。
三、照片：掃碼收付、記憶登入帳號、開啟APP之防毒提醒、截圖分享圖片及儲存裝置相關設定功能須使用該權限。
四、麥克風：語音輸入功能須使用該權限。
五、語音辨識：語音輸入功能須使用該權限。
六、相機：繳費(稅)、掃碼收付及郵件追蹤服務須使用該權限。
七、Face ID (生物辨識)：快速登入服務須使用該權限。
八、通知：推播通知服務須使用該權限。

bluejetty:00161201:ios.description:
LanGeek is a complete language learning app that helps you learn vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and reading through structured lessons and smart practice tools.
Learn English, Spanish, French, and German in one app. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced learner, LanGeek gives you clear content, organized wordlists, visual learning tools, and interactive exercises to make language learning easier and more effective.
LEARN VOCABULARY
Study thousands of words and expressions organized by level, topic, frequency, function, and learning goal.
Depending on the language and available content, you can explore:
• CEFR-based vocabulary from beginner to advanced levels
• Topic-based wordlists for daily life, work, travel, school, and more
• Common words and useful expressions
• Academic and test-preparation vocabulary
• Coursebook-based vocabulary lists
• Idioms, phrasal verbs, collocations, slang, and proverbs
Each vocabulary entry may include clear definitions, translations, natural examples, images, audio pronunciation, word forms, grammar details, usage notes, and related words.
PRACTICE WITH SMART TOOLS
LanGeek helps you review and remember what you learn with:
• Word Review
• Flashcards
• Spelling exercises
• Quizzes
• Pronunciation practice
• Grammar-form exercises
These tools help you practice meaning, spelling, pronunciation, grammar, and usage together.
VISUAL PICTURE DICTIONARY
Learn words faster with images, examples, pronunciation, translations, and study tools. LanGeek’s Picture Dictionary helps you connect words to meaning and remember vocabulary more easily.
GRAMMAR LESSONS
Study grammar with simple explanations, examples, visuals, and quizzes. Learn sentence structure, parts of speech, tenses, verb forms, word order, and other grammar topics depending on your target language.
PRONUNCIATION PRACTICE
Listen to audio pronunciation, practice saying words, and improve your speaking confidence. LanGeek helps you connect written words with spoken language through audio examples and pronunciation-focused exercises.
READING PRACTICE
Improve reading comprehension with texts organized by level and topic. Learn vocabulary in context, review grammar naturally, and check your understanding as you read.
DAILY WORDS AND REVIEW

* 100% ad-free
* No confusing menus or pop-ups
* Hints, undo, and eraser tools available
* Safe, educational, and screen time approved
Whether your child is a toddler learning shapes or a big kid ready for real Sudoku, Kidoku grows with them. It’s more than just a puzzle—it's a fun way to build early math, logic, and cognitive skills.
