bluejetty:00028163:ios.description:
Mobs Maker for Minecraft is a powerful Minecraft mob maker, addon creator, and entity editor built for players who want to create without coding.
Inspired by Minecraft Addons Maker (MAM), this app helps you build custom mobs, player models, textures, animations, and JSON behaviors for Minecraft Bedrock Edition.
With Mobs Maker for Minecraft, you can:
- Edit official mobs or design custom player models from community templates.
- Modify 2D/3D textures, skins, animations, and JSON behaviors.
- Export your creations directly into Minecraft Bedrock Edition.
- Explore a community library of rare mobs and share your own creations.
- Use Blockbench tools to create professional Minecraft mobs, entities, and addons.
FEATURES
- Create customizable player models
- Design unique animals and mobs with animation and JSON editing
- Edit skins and textures with Blockbench
- Professional 3D model editor and Blockbench support
- Import your custom mobs into Minecraft PE
- Explore a library of rare Minecraft mobs
- Get ideas to expand your Minecraft addons
- Become a better Minecraft mob maker, editor, and creator
- Download trending mods and addons such as Ender Dragon, Golem, Warden, and more
Turn into a true Minecraft addons maker with unique models shared by other players. Easily create, edit, and collect new mobs with Blockbench or the built-in 3D editor, then bundle them into addons and import them into Minecraft PE.
Are you ready to design professional mobs and animations with Blockbench? Mobs Maker for Minecraft gives you tools to customize models, format them, and add unique animation effects.
Mobs Maker for Minecraft makes mob creation easier than ever—whether or not you use Blockbench. Create and customize your own Minecraft addons today!

bluejetty:00159704:ios.description:
Break up with your smartphone at night.
Loftie is the alarm clock that gets your phone out of the bedroom. The app sets up your Loftie Clock or Lamp, then gets out of the way: alarms, sounds, the sunrise light and wind-down routines, from your phone when you want them and from the clock when you don't.
Meet Henry. Tell him what's on your mind, a to-do, a 2am idea, your frequent flyer number, and he keeps it, sorts it and reminds you when it matters, so it stops pulling you back to your phone. Henry runs on Claude, by Anthropic. He's free while we build him with you.
Less phone, built in:
• Drift. Your phone senses your Loftie Clock nearby and puts your chosen apps to sleep the moment you walk into the bedroom. Walk out in the morning and they wake up with you.
• Rest. Block distracting apps automatically around your sleep and wake times, in three phases: Relax, Sleep and Rise.
• The Loftie Card. A wallet-sized card that blocks your apps with one tap to your phone, wherever you are.
• A calmer home screen. The Loftie Clock + Henry widget, and Flip: a plain list of only the apps you need.
• Your rules. Choose exactly which apps and websites go quiet and which stay open, like calls, maps and music.
For your Loftie:
• Alarms, sounds, the sunrise light and red mode on your clock, set from anywhere in the house
• Hundreds of sounds, stories, meditations and breathwork for your clock's library
• Wind-down routines for the clock and the lamp
Works with a Loftie Clock or Loftie Lamp; Drift needs a Loftie Clock.

bluejetty:00155142:ios.description:
The indyreads™ app provides New South Wales Public Library members with free access to a large collection of eBook & Audiobook titles. The app lets you read and listen to eBook and Audio titles on your smartphone or tablet, browse the collection, borrow items and place them on hold, download and return titles, as well as make notes, place bookmarks and more. bluejetty:00145103:ios.name: Hearts - Expert AI
bluejetty:00145103:ios.summary:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Hearts for the first time, Hearts – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game.
Enjoy Classic Hearts, or challenge yourself with popular preset variants
bluejetty:00145103:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Hearts for the first time, Hearts – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master this classic trick-taking card game.
Enjoy Classic Hearts, or challenge yourself with popular preset variants like Omnibus (Ten or Jack of Diamonds), Team Hearts, Spot Hearts, Hooligan, Pip, Black Maria, and more!
Learn faster, play smarter, and improve your strategy with advanced AI partners and opponents, in-depth analysis tools, and extensive rule customization. Enjoy offline Hearts anytime — no internet required.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Hearts?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and improve your decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an expert?
Challenge yourself against six levels of advanced AI opponents designed to test your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game exciting, competitive, and rewarding.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay a deal to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore a wide variety of ways to play with customizable rule options, including:
• Number of players — Play with 3, 4, or 5 players.
• Passing Rules: Customize the passing rotation with left, right, across, hold (no pass), scatter, and shuffle.
• Pass Size: Pass 1–5 cards.
• Initial Lead: Select the Two of Clubs to be led or have the player left of the dealer start.
• Points on First Trick: Choose whether points can be played on the first trick.
• Breaking Hearts: Specify what breaks hearts and when hearts can be led.
• Scoring Twists: Reset scores at 50 or 100 points.
• Team Play: Partner with the player across from you.
• Shooting the Moon: Add points, subtract points, or disable.
• Shooting the Sun: Capture all tricks to earn a bonus.
• Double Points Card: Make a card double the captured points.
• Custom Point Values: Design your own unique Hearts game by assigning custom point values to cards.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Hearts – Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Hearts experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with smart AI opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

bluejetty:00121090:ios.name: Tic-Tac-Logic: X or O?
bluejetty:00121090:ios.summary: Fill all squares so there are no more than two adjacent X's or O's in a row or column! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing X's and O's in various places. The object is to place X or O in remaining squares so there are no more than two
bluejetty:00121090:ios.description:
Fill all squares so there are no more than two adjacent X's or O's in a row or column! Each puzzle consists of a grid containing X's and O's in various places. The object is to place X or O in remaining squares so there are no more than two consecutive X's or O's in a row or a column, the number of X's is the same as the number of O's in each row and each column, and all rows and all columns are unique.
Tic-Tac-Logic is a single-player puzzle based on Tic-Tac-Toe, a pencil-and-paper game many of us used to enjoy as children. Using pure logic and requiring no math to solve, these addictive puzzles offer endless fun and intellectual entertainment to puzzle fans of all skills and ages.
The game features a ruler to help viewing and comparing rows or columns, counters to show how many X and O there are in each row and column, and pencilmarks to place temporary X or O when solving very hard puzzles.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Tic-Tac-Logic contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 120 free Tic-Tac-Logic puzzles
• 30 extra-large puzzles bonus for iPad only
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Grid sizes up to 18x24
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Pencilmarks for solving hard puzzles
• Ruler for easy row/column viewing and comparing
• Row and column counter boxes
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Tic-Tac-Logic have also become popular under other names such as Binero, Binaire, Binairo, Binoxxo, Noughts and Crosses and Takuzu. Similar to Sudoku, Kakuro and Hashi, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

• Lost Followers — everyone who stopped following you

• Closed Accounts — followers who deactivated. If they come back,
 they reappear in your New Followers list.

• Viewers You Don't Follow

• Best time to post

bluejetty:00142892:ios.name: DreamMapper
bluejetty:00142892:ios.summary: Achieving a great night’s sleep with CPAP therapy happens when you take an active role in your own therapy. That means being in tune with how your therapy and equipment are performing – and how they should be performing – from night to nigh
bluejetty:00142892:ios.description:
Achieving a great night’s sleep with CPAP therapy happens when you take an active role in your own therapy. That means being in tune with how your therapy and equipment are performing – and how they should be performing – from night to night. DreamMapper is a mobile and web application that keeps you actively informed about your previous night’s therapy – with information like mask fit and therapy hours – so you know you are getting what’s needed for the great night’s sleep you deserve.
DreamMapper provides all of the following:
• Bluetooth® data transfer from your Philips PAP;
• Daily feedback about your treatment and your therapy results;
• Personalize your treatment management by setting alerts and personal goals;
• Find the answers to your questions through a rich content including informational videos and guides;
• Receive notifications about your therapy and your DreamMapper compatible equipment;
Learn more about DreamMapper and the Philips devices it supports at www.dreammapper.com.
Philips CPAP devices treat Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) so that you can sleep better at night and be more active during the day.
Philips DreamMapper has access to the following permissions:
Location
Approximate location (network-based): This is to set up Bluetooth communication. A location is required to acquire the pair.
Photos/Media/Files
Read the contents of your USB storage: This is needed to access the scanned and stored image that the camera takes of the Device Serial Number (DSN).
Camera
Take pictures and videos: Used to scan the DSN.
Other reasons
Receive data from Internet: DreamMapper needs to communicate with its Data Center.
View network connections: Wi-Fi setup as well as the need for DreamMapper to communicate with its Data Center.
Pair with Bluetooth devices: First-time connection to another Bluetooth device.
Access Bluetooth settings: First-time connection to another Bluetooth device.
Full network access: DreamMapper needs to communicate with its Data Center.
Prevent device from sleeping: Prevents the phone from “going to sleep” while playing videos.
DreamMapper is functional in countries where Philips therapy devices it supports have received the required regulatory approval. App is only intended for use in countries where associated Philips therapy devices are approved.
Available countries: 
United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Uruguay, Panama, Paraguay, Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Peru, Europe, Middle East & Africa, United Kingdom, Ireland, France, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, Czech Republic, Estonia, Slovakia, Denmark, Sweden, Saudi Arabia, Romania, South Africa, Norway, Hungary, Slovenia, Malta, Greece, Australia, New Zealand, India, Japan, Singapore, Philippines, South Korea, Thailand, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Myanmar, Malaysia
DreamMapper is an information tool only and not a substitute for professional medical attention. The app is not to be used for diagnosis of any condition and not intended for use in medical emergency. In addition to using this app, you should seek the advice of physician or healthcare provider with any questions regarding a medical condition.

bluejetty:00091001:ios.description:
Fast Formula 1 standings, race results, schedules, stats, and Home Screen widgets. No ads and built for race weekends.
FStandings helps you follow drivers and constructors throughout the season.
Independent Formula 1 app since 2009.
FEATURES
* HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
At-a-glance Home Screen widgets for the next Grand Prix, the full weekend schedule, and points leaders.
* STANDINGS
Current points standings for drivers and teams are updated after each race.
* COMPARE DRIVERS
Compare drivers to each other.
* HISTORICAL DATA
View points from previous seasons for drivers and constructors.
See historical information on all drivers and teams since the beginning of Formula 1.
* SEARCH
Search for your favorite Formula 1 drivers, constructors, and circuits.
* AI ASSISTANT
Ask conversational questions about drivers, races, standings, records, schedules, penalty points, and FIA steward decisions. Follow-up questions retain the context of your conversation.
* SPOILER MODE
Hide current standings and results until you choose to reveal them.
* IPHONE, IPAD, APPLE WATCH, AND SHORTCUTS
Use FStandings natively on iPhone and iPad, check essential information on Apple Watch, and ask Siri or use Shortcuts for the next race, current standings, the latest result, or a driver lookup.
* TRIVIA GAME
Challenge yourself with era-based Formula 1 trivia. Answer questions with hints and share your streak.
* DRIVER GUESSING GAME

Build the English vocabulary you actually use - words and phrases for work, interviews, emails, meetings, travel, and daily life.
Free access and subscription
Vocab is free to download. Free access has daily limits for vocabulary topics, quizzes, phrases, stories, and Word Challenge. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Vocab turns dull word lists into living language. Whether you're starting out or refreshing rusty skills, interactive word packs, vivid pictures, and native audio make every new word stick.
Why learners choose Vocab
 • Practical English vocabulary: learn the words and phrases that come up in real conversations, not random lists.
 • Phrases: ready-to-use lines for interviews, emails, meetings, small talk, and travel.
 • Real-life word packs: workplace English, job interviews, emails, daily life, and travel.
 • Weekly mini-stories: see new vocabulary in action and improve your reading.
 • Smart quizzes + spaced repetition: review each word at the right moment so it stays in memory.
 • Custom lists: save and study the words that matter to you.
 • Fresh topics every week: new vocabulary keeps your learning practical.
What you can learn
 • Workplace English: meetings, presentations, phone calls, and everyday office talk.
 • Job interviews: answer the most common questions with confidence.
 • Business emails: polite openings, clear requests, and professional closings.
 • Travel English: airports, hotels, directions, restaurants, and shopping.
 • Daily life: small talk, appointments, health, and getting things done.
How it works
 1. Pick a topic that matches your goal.
 2. Learn each word with a picture, a native-speaker recording, and a translation in your language.
 3. Take a quick quiz to check what stuck.
 4. Set a reminder and review a few days later, when repetition works best.
 5. Follow your progress: words learned, remembered words, and topics in progress.
Build your own vocabulary
 • Search any English word and see it with a translation.
 • Create your own topics and collect the words you want to learn.
 • Keep a personal phrase list for the situations you face most.
Who it's for
 • ESL and English learners who want useful vocabulary fast.
 • Professionals who need clear English at work.
 • Anyone preparing for a job, an interview, or a move abroad.
 • Busy people who want to learn English words in a few minutes a day.
Learn English vocabulary you can use today. Download Vocab free and start building your words now.

Lively® C
bluejetty:00168771:ios.description:
Meet Lively Cycle, the premier app for aligning with your cycle to enhance every day. Personalised daily tips are tailored to your menstrual phase and hormone levels, empowering you to navigate each day with confidence and ease. 
Lively® Cycle app offers guidance on nutrition, sports, and self-care, ensuring you feel supported and nurtured throughout your entire cycle.
Unlike men, who function on a 24-hour cycle, women experience a unique 28-day cycle that influences their mood, energy, and well-being.
Enjoy Lively with your partner using the "Partner Syncing" feature. Share cycle phases and moods in a private setting to deepen your connection. This unique app experience keeps you in tune with each other’s needs, enhancing understanding and closeness.
Your menstrual cycle has four phases, and we've got your back through them all:
MENSTRUAL: Time to shed the uterine lining and start anew! Focus on rest, self-care, and light exercise.
FOLLICULAR: Feel the energy and creativity boost! Let's set goals, plan, and enjoy nourishing foods.
OVULATORY: Embrace your peak fertility and energy. This is the perfect time for socializing, working out, and maintaining a balanced diet.
Lively also supports your Pregnancy and Postpartum journey. As your body changes, Lively provides expert-backed insights on nutrition, movement, and self-care tailored to each stage of pregnancy and postpartum recovery. Stay informed about your baby’s growth, track key milestones, and receive gentle reminders to support your well-being. With Partner Syncing, your partner can also access guidance on how to be there for you, making this journey smoother for both of you. LUTEAL: Time to unwind and reflect. Indulge in nurturing activities and satisfy cravings with healthy alternatives.
Perimenopause, Menopause Tracker - Discover patterns over time, and better understand what may be happening in your body.
When periods are no longer the center of your health journey, Lively continues to support you.
What sets Lively apart is not just its comprehensive cycle tracking but also its inclusion of a unique aesthetic period tracker and an ovulation tracker, designed with elegance and sophistication. Lively ensures your health data stays in sync with Apple Health, allowing for an integrated approach to managing your well-being.
With Livelyby your side, you'll stay in sync with your body's natural rhythm, optimizing your well-being, energy, and mood. We'll help you make the most of your 28-day cycle and enhance your daily life. From nourishing your body with the right foods to finding the best exercise routines and practicing self-care, Lively has you covered.
Ready to start your journey? Join the Lively® community today and let's begin syncing your cycle to transform your everyday life!
Join community:
IG: @livelycycle

Privacy policy: https://livelycycle.com/privacy/

If we receive a refund request for an in-app purchase, we may provide Apple with information about the user's in-app purchase activity. bluejetty:00036131:ios.description:
IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER
Cat Translator is created solely for entertainment and recreational purposes. The app does not provide real, scientifically validated, or linguistically accurate translation between cats and humans.
Cats do not use a human-style language that can be reliably translated into words or sentences. Any phrases, emotions, reactions, sounds, or interpretations shown in the app are fictional, randomly generated, or created for playful entertainment only.
The app must not be used to evaluate your cat’s health, emotional state, behavior, needs, or wellbeing. Always observe your pet’s real behavior and consult a qualified veterinarian or animal behavior specialist when professional advice is needed.
PLAYFUL MEOW INTERPRETATIONS
Record your cat’s sound and receive a fictional, entertainment-only phrase or reaction.
These results are not real translations and should not be treated as an accurate interpretation of your cat’s feelings, intentions, behavior, or needs. The same sound may produce different playful results.
VOICE-TO-MEOW EFFECTS
Record your voice and transform it into entertaining cat-inspired sound effects.
This feature does not convert human speech into a language understood by cats. It is a playful audio effect created only for fun.
CAT SOUND COLLECTION
Explore a library of pre-recorded cat sounds and reactions. Play different sounds during recreational interaction with your pet and save your favorites for quick access.
A cat’s response to any sound may vary. Stop playback if your pet appears uncomfortable, anxious, stressed, or frightened.
RECORDINGS AND HISTORY
Save your recordings and entertainment results in one place. Return to previous sessions whenever you want to replay or review them.
Saved results are provided for entertainment and do not represent an analysis of your cat’s communication patterns.
PET PROFILES
Create separate profiles for your pets and keep their basic information organized in the app.
CAT GAMES AND ACTIVITIES
Discover playful activities designed to make time with your cat more engaging and enjoyable.
ARTICLES FOR CAT OWNERS
Read general informational content about cats, everyday care, behavior, and spending time with your pet.
The articles are provided for general information only and are not a substitute for veterinary diagnosis, treatment, or professional advice.
PLEASE REMEMBER
• The app is an entertainment simulator, not a real animal-language translator.
• Generated phrases and reactions are fictional and should not be taken literally.
• Voice effects are not understood by cats as translated human speech.
• The app does not diagnose health, mood, stress, pain, hunger, or behavioral conditions.
• Never make health or safety decisions based on results generated by the app.
• Contact a veterinarian if you are concerned about your pet’s health or behavior.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
1. Weekly plan with a 3-day trial
2. Monthly plan
3. Annual plan
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at purchase confirmation.
- The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
- The renewal price is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends.
- Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renew in your App Store account settings.
- Any unused free-trial time is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- The weekly plan includes one 3-day trial, then renews at the stated price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
Privacy Policy: https://coincup-dev.com/policy.html
Terms of Service: https://coincup-dev.com/terms.html

Role play as a Doctor, Nurse, patient or any other character in our amazing My Town Hospital game for kids. Our doctor game for kids offers entertainment for hours! Explore a Hospital, a big playhouse full of doctors and nurses! Create clinic stories, cure, and treat your patients. Be creative and play as the best city doctor!

From the My Town Games collection, check out a NEW playhouse game: My Town Hospital game for kids, a fantastic doctor game that you must have on your phone!

BE A DOCTOR, NURSE, PATIENT OR MORE!

Hurry up, doctor! We have an emergency! Diagnose, cure and save lives in this hospital game for kids. Create stories, explore a big playhouse and check all the rooms: ambulance, X-Ray, surgery room and more. The city clinic is big!

MY TOWN HOSPITAL GAME FOR KIDS!

•	7+ locations to explore in this Hospital game
•	Visit the Doctor's office, Pregnancy room, Nurse floor, X-RAY room, Gift shop ...
•	Check all 2 floors in this city Clinic playhouse and create stories
•	Meet Nurses, Doctors, Patients, Shop workers and other characters
•	Mini-games for more fun!
•	PLAY AND LEARN - kids can develop basic medical knowledge
•	Operate, care and be the best Doctor in the city!  
•	Fun, engaging and cool Hospital games for kids!

100+ INTERACTIVE OBJECTS

Explore Hospital, a big playhouse, and move objects as you like. A new baby is born! Grab the flowers at the hospital Gift Shop and surprise the mom in a pregnancy room! Be a good doctor or a nurse and save lives! Call Nurse to assist you during the surgery. My Town Hospital – Doctor game for kids, will keep you entertained for hours!

DIAGNOSE AND CURE YOUR PATIENTS – DOCTOR GAME FOR KIDS

Real Hospital locations! Visit dr Office, Nurse room, X-RAY, and roleplay hospital stories! No competition! City Clinic is a big playhouse and each room offers extra fun! My Town Hospital game for kids of all ages!

Play Doctor games, treat patients as a nurse and explore a Hospital. The clinic center is a big playhouse where kids can role-play with many characters the way they like! Download My Town hospital games for kids today and be the best doctor in the city!

RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
My Town Doctor game for kids aged 4-12. All My Town playhouse games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.

ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games that promote creativity and open-ended play for kids & toddlers all over the world. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com.

bluejetty:00186914:ios.description:

Army Rangers specialize in airborne assault, raids, recovery of personnel and equipment, and airfield seizure, among other difficult and dangerous missions. Now with the latest April 2017 manual and full support for retina displays, this app covers deception, stealth, communications, escape and evasion, ambush operations, booby traps, demolitions perimeter defense, counterintelligence, and much more. This manual was designed so Rangers could easily carry it into the field.

+ Leadership
+ Operations
+ Fire Support
+ Communications
+ Demolitions
+ Movement
+ Patrols
+ Battle Drills
+ Military Mountaineering
+ Machine Gun Employment
+ Urban Operations
+ Waterborne Operations
+ Mounted Patrol Operations

Learn from the best soldiers in the world.

How It Works

- Perfect for Curious Minds – Students, professionals and deep thinkers alike.

bluejetty:00072980:ios.summary:
inCarDoc — OBD2 Car Scanner & Diagnostic Tool.
Turn your iPhone into a professional OBD2 scanner. Read fault codes, monitor real-time engine data, track fuel economy, and keep your car's full diagnostic history. Connect via Bluetooth or Wi-
bluejetty:00072980:ios.description:
inCarDoc — OBD2 Car Scanner & Diagnostic Tool.
Turn your iPhone into a professional OBD2 scanner. Read fault codes, monitor real-time engine data, track fuel economy, and keep your car's full diagnostic history. Connect via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi ELM327 adapters.
Requires ELM327 or compatible OBD2 adapter. Demo & GPS-only modes work without one. Check compatibility first with the free inCarDoc app.
SUPPORTED ADAPTERS:
V-Gate BLE, V-Gate B2, Kiwi 3 (BLE), Veepeak (BLE), Carista, Vinli, InCarDoc, Loanauto, and other Wi-Fi / Bluetooth (BLE) OBD-II scanners.
 PRO FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited real-time parameter recording
• Multiple parameters at once
• Background mode recording
• GPS traces + parameter history
• Cloud data upload
• Fuel economy & acceleration widgets
• Overlay data over any app screen
DIAGNOSTICS
Cars Scan and check engine with Ford, Honda, Toyota, Volkswagen, Chevrolet, Hyundai, Kia, Nissan, Renault, Peugeot, Škoda, Mazda etc. Read generic diagnostic trouble codes and some manufacturer-specific codes.
Read Check Engine (MIL) status, freeze-frame data, and Mode 06 info. Clear diagnostic trouble codes (DTC). Save and share reports for repair shops.
REAL-TIME PARAMETERS
Speed, RPM, coolant temp, pressure, O2 sensors, timing, and more. View PID - as charts or analog/digital widgets. Availability depends on car make, model, year.
FUEL ECONOMY (ECONOMIZER)
Instant & average MPG, per-trip and per-day stats. Requires MAF or MAP+IAT+RPM support. Enter engine displacement and volumetric efficiency (default 80%) for accuracy.
MORE
• Logbook: fuel, service, maintenance notes, diagnostics
• Console mode: raw OBD2/ELM327 commands
• Custom PID & protocol configs
ADAPTER & APP ISSUES
inCarDoc engine scanner supports OBDII standards.
If you experience any issues with the adapter or connection, you can email us the connection log. It helps us to solve the issue quickly.
For questions and support, please contact us by email at support@incardoc.com
With inCarDoc you know your car before the check engine light surprises you.

Scroll through organized timelines and a dedicated alert wall to keep informed of your baby’s situation throughout the day or revisit for your fondest moments and memories.
Intelligent features designed for baby’s Sleep, Safety & Memories
(1) Covered Face & Roll Over Detection
Safe Sleep for Babies. Peace of Mind for Parents! Developed with a pediatrician, CuboAi's face detection technology alerts you if it recognizes that your baby's mouth and nose are covered or if they're stuck when rolling over. Get alerted by our app in real-time!
(2) Sleep Monitoring and Soothing
Forget adding up your baby’s sleep hours on a manual log. While you do the parenting, we take care of the numbers so that every morning you can see a report with your baby’s sleep health in easy-to-navigate stats from last night. Play nature sounds white noise, and soothing music to create the perfect sleep environment for your little one to dream the night away.
(3) Danger Zone Detection: Protecting your little one from 0-5 years old!
CuboAi's Danger Zone Alert protects your baby beyond the crib and warns you if your little one is entering somewhere they shouldn't be! Use CuboAi with the mobile stand to transition from baby monitor to toddler cam.

Our AI can detect if your baby is smiling, crying, or making big moves and automatically snaps a photo for you to keep in your app- first time sitting up and first head lifts included! Organized by age on the Moments Wall , it’s like your baby’s very own digital scrapbook!
(5) HD Night Vision: Always Have the Best View of Baby
No more squinting or fumbling in the dark during late night check ups! CuboAi’s 1080p HD Night Vision.

4. Temperature & humidity detection - with Doctor-Recommended temperature ranges
5. Built-in night light - check in on your baby without disrupting their sleep
6. Adaptive stands that grow with your little one - Use CuboAi with most cribs, cradles, bassinets, or anywhere else. No tools required!
Bank-Level Security
2-Factor Authentication: Additional Security, you control who logs in
CTIA Cybersecurity Certified: AES-256 bit, Symmetric Encryption
Encrypted Data Protection: TLS/SSL Encrypted, no 3rd party can intercept
The Whole Family on One App
Up to 8 concurrent viewers
Manage family member permissions
Compatible with iOS and most tablets

bluejetty:00014245:ios.description:
Be your own boss, work when you want, and get paid weekly with GoShare. Earn money on a flexible schedule driving your pickup truck, cargo van, box truck, SUV, or car.
GoShare is the best marketplace app for vehicles owners to find local delivery and moving gigs. Our platform helps independent professionals earn extra income on their schedule, supplementing their own business with local moving and delivery gigs in their area.
Our innovative technology and crowd-sourced model connects independent delivery professionals with businesses and people who need same day moving or delivery help. Turn your vehicle from a liability that is costing you money every month into an asset that is earning you money.
GoShare is trusted by more than 70,000 delivery pros and over 150,000 customers nationwide. We also partner with top brands such as Costco, HomeGoods, Sherwin-Williams, Pepsi, United Rentals, Living Spaces, and World Market, helping them deliver items for their customers on demand.
Delivery pros on the GoShare platform earn some of the highest per hour earnings in the gig economy. Top delivery pros can earn thousands of dollars per month, plus 100% of your tips.
Joining our platform is easy, head to our website to sign up today. After signing up you'll need to submit a few documents, such as vehicle registration and insurance, and pass a background check. Once we verify your information and you complete a couple more steps, you'll be ready to start earning with your vehicle.
As an independent contractor, you control when you work. If you're looking to run your own delivery business, side hustle, or earn extra cash with hot shot gigs, GoShare may be a good fit for you. Our platform makes it easy for you to find local delivery work, moving gigs, and hot shot deliveries. We're here to support you so that you can focus on building your business and delivering to happy customers.
GoShare handles payments and collections. You typically get paid within 3-4 business days. Gain access to exclusive perks that include discounts on auto maintenance, access to healthcare options, and more.
All delivery professionals must be at least 18 years old and own or lease a vehicle with a model year of 2004 or newer. Must also be able to lift and carry at least 50 lbs.
Customers use GoShare for:
• Furniture Delivery
• Moving
• Last Mile Delivery
• Courier Services
• LTL Shipments
• Store Pickup and Delivery
Currently available in select cities within: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, and Wisconsin.
If GoShare is not in your area, sign up online and we’ll retain your info until we expand to your city. You’ll be notified once GoShare becomes available.

bluejetty:00021259:ios.description:
You are welcome to download this app at any time, however your airline Administration will notify when you may commence using it.
eCrew – AIMS Native Mobile app for Apple devices.
Specifications, Features, and Characteristics:
The official eCrew app from AIMS International, is offered free of charge to all crew from all airlines which are powered by the AIMS Airline software.
With great emphasis on speed, data security, and a brand new interface optimized for mobiles and tablets, the eCrew app will greatly speed up the process by which you will review your crew schedule.
Fresh and friendlier UI, in line with commonly used platforms, allowing for easy interaction and navigation.
Technical Specifications:
Minimum iOS version 11
Once downloaded, crew will be requested to enter the necessary details in order to register the device with his/her personal account.
Required info:
- eCrew site
- Crew ID
- Personal Password
Biometric authentication is now available
This eCrew app version is clearly laid out, efficient to use, aesthetically pleasing and includes the most widely used features. 
Check below few of the features available:
60% more functionality available than the previous app.
- Profile edit (i.e. contact details, Passport details, etc.)
- Security and preferences
- Change your passwords 
- Fit/Unfit for duty
- Days off requests
- Crew Schedule Statistics 
- Flight/Duty time Statistics
and more.
Push notification related:
• Real time push notifications for crew schedule changes, new messages and more on the pipeline
• Badge number with the number of pending crew schedule changes
• Acknowledgment of a single or all crew schedule change.
Crew Schedule related:
• Schedule in UTC or Local times.
• Ability to view previous and next month’s Crew Schedule.
• Check-in/out times for each duty.
• Duty details by swiping left 
• Memo indicators ( including actual memo text assigned to the flight/duty)
• Training Indicators
Other features:
• Improved Mobile/Calendar export 
• Import of duties to the mobile calendar. (UTC/LOCAL)
• Alerts/Reminders for each duty separately
• Enhanced off-line mode. Ability to download for offline use the published period or even to select any period (i.e. days, weeks or months with all the details under the duties)
• Ability to view your schedule even when there is no internet connection available.
• A wide range of flight info for each flight leg
• Citypair (i.e. Map, distance)
• Passengers on board and Load factor (on actual total passengers on board)
• List of crew on each flight leg or duty
• Operating Crew
• Dead-Heading Crew
• Jump-Seaters
• Instructors/Trainees on each duty
• Call/send message to any crewmember in the same flight directly from the app.
• Departure/arrival airport details
• Agents details (contact details, memos)
• Hotels (i.e. Check In/Out times, shuttle bus availability, memo). Ability to view/navigate to the hotel address accessing the map application
• Switch to the main eCrew web application (which provides access to all eCrew features), at a press of a button.
and more.

bluejetty:00146644:ios.description: وتر هو محمصة و متجر فهم احتياجك وجمع اهم المحامص السعودية في مكان واحد كأكبر متجر سعودي يختص بالقهوة المختصة، تحضير القهوة صار أسهل وأسرع مع تطبيق وتر تقدر تشتري من اكثر من محمصة بتكلفة وحدة. مع تلبية احتياجات العملاء بتوفير أنواع من اكسسوارات القهوة وأدواتها. نقدر نوصل لجميع المناطق بالسعودية والخليج. نقدم لك خصومات وعروض مستمرةيوفر لك تطبيق وتر أفضل تجربة تسوق في المملكة العربية السعودية. نوفر لك خيارات الدفع بالتقسيط والدفع لاحقاً وخيارات شحن مختلفة ومنتجات أصلية 100٪ وعمليات استرجاع سهلةيساعدك هذا التطبيق على تصفح جميع منتجاتنا بسهولة. يمكنك البحث عن اسم العلامة التجارية، أو اسم المنتج ، ستظهر لك قائمة بالعلامات التجارية والمنتجات التي نقدمها.عندنا مجموعة كبيرة من مختلف أنواع القهوة الفاخرة بدرجات تحميص مُختلفة، وطواحين القهوة، وآلات الإسبريسو، ومُحضرات القهوة الباردة، وأدوات التقديم، والإكسسوارات وأكثر من ذلك بكثير.استمتع بالطلب من خلال هاتفك الجوال كل ما ترغب به وسيصلك عند بابك. نشحن طلبك في أي مكان في المملكة العربية السعودية خلال 3 أيام عمل. ونقوم أيضاً بالشحن إلى دول الخليج اللي نوصل فيها الطلبات خلال 5 إلى 8 أيام عمل.لا تشيل هم الدفع، وفرنا لك طرق دفع آمنة؛ تقدر تدفع كاش عند الاستلام، أو الدفع بالبطاقة عبر الإنترنت أو التقسيط والدفع لاحقاً.

bluejetty:00018233:ios.description:
payme — moliya bilan bog'liq masalalarni hal qilishda yordam beradigan kundalik onlayn to'lov xizmatingiz.
• YHXBB jarimalari, kommunal to'lovlar, soliqlar — barchasi ortiqcha to'lovlarsiz bitta ilovada. Kartadan kartaga pul o'tkazmalari ham payme bilan tez va qulay.
• Doimiy mijozlarga bonuslar - To'lovlar va pul o'tkazmalari uchun payme sizga ballar beradi. Ularni “payme people” dasturi doirasida keshbek va chegirmalarga almashtirishingiz mumkin. Masalan, taom buyurganingizda yoki kurs uchun to'lov qilganingizda.
• Komissiyasiz to'lovlar - payme'da mobil aloqa va internetdan boshlab, davlat xizmatlari-yu jarimalargacha to'lov qilish mumkin. Ayniqsa xizmatlarni saqlab qo’yib, qarzga kirmaslik uchun ularning balansini kuzatib borish juda qulay.
• Kartangizni olib yurishingiz shart emas - ”payme go” servisi do'kon, kafe va restoranlarda kartasiz to’lash imkonini beradi. Shunchaki, ilovada "payme go" yoki "QR to'lov" bo'limini ochasiz va to'laysiz — bu hatto terminal orqali to'lashdan tezroq.
•Xarajatlaringiz nazoratingiz ostida - Ilova yordamida qachon, qayerda va qancha sarflaganingizni kuzatib borishingiz mumkin. Kirim va chiqimlar haqida batafsil ma'lumot, karta va toifalar bo’yicha tahlil, hech qachon yo’qolmaydigan cheklar — barchasi payme’da.
• Bitta obuna — ko'plab imkoniyatlar - payme plus obunasini yoqsangiz: limit doirasida kartadan kartaga komissiyasiz pul o’tkazasiz, Setanta Sports efirlarini bepul tomosha qilasiz va boshqa maxsus imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lasiz.
• Pul o’tkazishning sinalgan usuli - Visa debet kartasi bo’ladimi, virtual karta yoki Humo debet kartasi — payme’ga qo'shing va ulardan pul o’tkazish uchun foydalaning. Barcha tranzaksiyalar xalqaro standartlar va PCI DSS sertifikatlari bilan himoyalangan.
-----
Uzbekistan's leading payment service:
• Pay traffic fines, utility bills, taxes – pay everything without commission in one application. Manage your expenses and send money transfers from card to card in payme.
• Bonuses for regular customers - Transfer money to Humo and Uzcard cards, pay for services and get payme people points that can be exchanged for cashback or discounts.
• Payments without commission - For a multitude of services: from mobile and internet to government services and fines. Save services and set up autopayments to keep track of your balance and avoid missing a payment.
• You don't need your card anymore - Pay in stores, cafes and restaurants with payme go. Simply show the QR code at the checkout and the required amount will be deducted from any chosen card, debit or credit. 
• Control your spending - Track where, when and how much you spend. All detailed information about your income and expenses is available in payment monitoring, along with receipts and analytics.
• Save on fees with a subscription - Connect payme plus and enjoy all the features of the app: transfer money from card to card without commission within the limit, track your expenses and watch Setanta Sports.
• A secure way to transfer money - Send money risk-free from Visa, Uzcard and Humo debit cards. All transactions in payme are protected by international standards and PCI DSS certification.

bluejetty:00164962:ios.description:
The mail.com mail app for iPhone and iPad lets you take your email and cloud wherever you go. 
The mail.com mail app brings comprehensive functionality to your mobile device. Perfect for iPhone and iPad users, the email app from mail.com puts a wealth of productivity tools directly into your hand. Check all your email addresses and view your cloud documents from one centralized mailbox – wherever you go. Enable push notifications to ensure you never miss an important message again. Discover the many features of the mail.com email app and get your emails whenever you need them, wherever you are. 
What customers are saying:
"Everything you could wish for. Simply open, read, delete, done. No frills or 1000 options to subscribe or play. Thanks"
"Good stuff. The way email should work today!"
"Cool. I have been using this app for such a long time and I would not change."
"Best email account in the world. Thank you"
"Great app! Convenient, easy to navigate"
Reliable and secure e-mail
The mail.com email app is optimized for use with a mail.com email account by 1&1. With an mail.com email account you can select from our 100+ email domains, like @email.com and @usa.com. Ideal for business emails, our mail app lets you set personalized notifications and use many organizational features that our webmail solution provides. This means you can easily access your mail.com contacts and synchronize them with the contacts on your iPhone. The mail.com email client for iOS enabled devices also includes powerful security features to ensure your communications are never compromised. 
The email app for iOS is simple to install and intuitive to use. You can even make it the default mail app on your iPhone. This makes managing your mails a breeze – giving you the opportunity to write, reply and organize your mail wherever you go. Syncing your inbox between multiple devices is also possible, allowing you to move seamlessly from your iPhone to your iPad without breaking your concentration. 
Cloud storage and emails in one
With mail.com freemail you also get 2GB of reliable cloud storage. Store e-mail attachments, photos, documents and more in your mail.com Cloud and your online file manager is right at your fingertips in this combined e-mail and cloud app. The app will automatically sync not only every message in your inbox but all the files in your cloud storage, so you can access them whenever and wherever you are online. Just open the app and get started! You can even activate automatic photo backup from your iPhone or iPad to your mail.com Cloud and keep your precious memories safe in our secure online storage.
All you need to do is sign up for a freemail account from mail.com and download the app to enjoy these gr
eat features: 
• iPhone optimized
• Convenient push notifications
• Increased security through PIN or biometric authentication 
• Mobile access to your mail.com contacts
• Integrated cloud with automatic photo backups
• Customizable interface
• 100+ email domains available to create email address of your choice
• Sync automatically with mail.com web browser email client
• Set as default mail app on iPhone or iPad
• Convenient folder and file manager in Cloud
100+ email domains
One of the best things about using the mail.com app as your iPhone email app or iPad email app is creating unique email addresses. Customize your email address with our 100+ email domains. In addition to our @mail.com domain, here are just five of the available email domains that we offer:

ALWAYS ON, WORKS WITH THE PHONE YOU HAVE:
- Always on and tracking, no need to press start and stop buttons 
- Works anywhere on your body
- Works with any iPhone running iOS 14 or greater

bluejetty:00090879:ios.summary:
Scout is a bicycle alarm and finder, designed to seamlessly integrate into Apple’s FindMy network of products, allowing you to keep track of your beloved bikes whereabouts, even when you’re not riding. 
The lightweight, and low-profile SCO
bluejetty:00090879:ios.description:
Scout is a bicycle alarm and finder, designed to seamlessly integrate into Apple’s FindMy network of products, allowing you to keep track of your beloved bikes whereabouts, even when you’re not riding. 
The lightweight, and low-profile SCOUT discretely and securely mounts to any water bottle cage using the security screws provided. Once armed (via the app or on the unit itself) any movement of a bike fitted with Scout will trigger the motion sensitive 85 db alarm alerting the owner. 
If a Scout fitted bike is not where the owner last left it, then they can simply locate its position using Apple’s FindMy network.
The SCOUT is USB-C rechargeable and has a runtime of approximately 6 months with standard use. Riders can activate/deactivate the motion sensitive alarm, locate the device, and check the battery life, all through the Knog App. 
Scout is the future of bike security.

bluejetty:00160371:ios.description:
All-in-One Printer & PDF Management App
Simplify your printing and PDF management tasks with the ultimate iOS app designed for your convenience! From seamless document printing to advanced PDF tools, this app is your go-to solution for all your productivity needs.
Why Choose Our App?
Gone are the days of juggling multiple apps to print or edit documents. Our app combines a wide array of features in one user-friendly platform. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go, this app provides you with all the tools to manage your documents and printing effortlessly.
Key Features:
1. Versatile Printing Options
Scan & Print: Quickly scan documents and send them to print.
Photo to Print: Select photos directly from your gallery and print them in high quality.
Web to Print: Print webpages with a single tap—perfect for online articles or receipts.
Contact Print: Print your contact list for backups or sharing.
iCloud Print: Access and print files directly from your iCloud Drive.
Dropbox Print: Sync with Dropbox to print stored documents with ease.
Email Print: Open email attachments and send them directly to the printer.
2. Powerful PDF Tools
Our app isn’t just about printing—it’s also a complete PDF manager.
Merge PDFs: Combine multiple PDF files into one document.
Split PDFs: Extract specific pages or split a PDF into multiple files.
Lock/Unlock PDFs: Add or remove password protection for enhanced security.
Delete Pages: Remove unwanted pages from your PDF documents.
Reorder Pages: Rearrange pages to organize your PDF as needed.
Sign PDFs: Add your signature directly to any PDF file—ideal for contracts or forms.
3. Ready-to-Use Printables
Save time with a collection of pre-designed printable templates:
Calendars: Keep track of important dates with beautifully designed calendars.
Coloring Books: Print engaging coloring sheets for kids or adults.
Daily Journals: Organize your thoughts and plan your day with journal templates.
Expense Trackers: Stay on top of your finances with customizable trackers.
Daily Planners: Plan your day, week, or month with professional planner templates.
Birthday Cards: Create personalized birthday cards for your loved ones.
User-Friendly Interface
Designed with simplicity in mind, the app ensures a smooth and intuitive experience. No matter your level of expertise, you’ll find it easy to use and incredibly effective.
Perfect for Every Need
This app is perfect for students, professionals, and even families. Whether you’re printing school assignments, signing a business contract, or printing a fun coloring page for your child, we’ve got you covered!
Key Benefits:
Save time by managing all your printing and PDF tasks in one place.
Enhance productivity with easy-to-use tools.
Eliminate the need for bulky equipment or multiple apps.
Privacy & Security
We value your privacy and security. The app is designed to handle your documents safely, ensuring your data remains protected at all times.

bluejetty:00162219:ios.description:
Stellium: A Redesigned Astrology Experience!
Embark on a deeper journey into the world of astrology with the renewed, AI-powered Stellium. With rich visual content, enhanced features, and personal guidance, you’ll feel the influence of the stars in every moment of your life. Stellium provides you with personalized astrological insights to help align your daily life with the stars. Here are some of the key features offered by the new Stellium:
1. Enhanced Relationship Harmony Analysis (New Feature)
Stellium’s most popular feature just got even better! We’ve upgraded our Harmony feature with a hybrid solution combining Synastry and Composite Chart methods, delivering unparalleled precision and accuracy.
 -Romantic Compatibility: Dive deeper into love, communication, emotional support, and lifestyle alignment. Explore how planetary influences shape your relationship dynamics and get actionable insights to strengthen your connection.
 -Friendship Compatibility: Evaluate collaboration potential, shared interests, and compatibility for building a meaningful companionship or simply enjoying good times together. Could you and your friend make a fantastic team? Find out here!
2. Ask Stellium (New Feature)
Have questions about love, career, or finances? With the "Ask Stellium" feature, receive astrologically tailored answers based on your unique birth chart. Gain clarity and discover the cosmic guidance you need to make informed decisions in your life.
3. Lunar Calendar
Discover the best days for beauty treatments, self-care, and travel with the Lunar Calendar! Align with the Moon’s phases to make the most of your plans and enjoy cosmic harmony in your daily life.
4. Time Machine
Discover the astrological influences of any day, past or future! With the Time Machine, find the perfect time for weddings, engagements, career steps, financial opportunities, and new beginnings.
5. Annual Forecast Report
Curious about what’s in store for you this year? With the personalized Annual Forecast Report, uncover the key highlights and events of the year based on your unique birth chart. From major opportunities to transformative phases, see what the stars have planned for you. Tailored insights into love, career, health, and more will guide you through the upcoming months, helping you stay prepared and aligned with the universe. Whether you follow daily horoscopes or seek deeper astrological insights, this report brings everything together for a comprehensive view of your year ahead.
6. Now Happening
Don’t miss astrological events! Stay instantly informed about important celestial events and planetary transits in the sky. Synchronize every step of your life with the stars.
7. Effects of the Sky
Discover the influence of planets on your birth chart and the world! The effects of the stars on the planets are now more comprehensive and easier to understand. As you follow the cycles of the universe, bring the guidance of the heavens into your life.
8. Timeline Feature
Want to know how long personal astrological influences will last? With our new Timeline feature, you can see how many days astrological influences will impact your life and track how much time remains during this period. Plan each step with the stars guiding you!
Additional Key Features:
 - Personalized Notifications: Receive daily notifications tailored to your transit chart. Instantly access all notifications with a Premium subscription.
 - Natal Chart and In-Depth Analysis: Explore detailed analyses of love, career, health, and more through your birth chart. Discover the positions of signs, houses, planets, and asteroids.
 - Daily Insights: Understand the daily energies and opportunities. Focus on work, money, relationships, and health to help you make the best decisions.
Download the redesigned Stellium now and begin your astro journey with the stars!
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

✅ Serious Dating: For those who want honest and lasting relationships, no one-night stands here. That's not the purpose of this app.
✅ Proximity: Meet serious singles near you thanks to geolocation, or find your new love right in your neighborhood.

ONLINE PROFILES 👤
Find people online to connect, get to know each other, and make friends through our chat.
AROUND YOU 📍
View profiles nearby using geolocation, find men and women in your city, and engage in genuine and romantic conversations.
MATCH CAROUSEL 🔄
Discover profiles selected based on their photos and descriptions that seem like a good match for you on our dating app.
VISITS AND FLASHES 👀
See who's visited your profile or who's shown interest in you at a glance to start a conversation.
INTUITIVE MESSAGING 💬
Engage in authentic conversations and chats with serious users, all for free, unlike many competitors.
LOVE MODE 💫
Highlight your profile for 30 minutes, completely free, and become the center of attention for other users. More views = more conversations.
Safety and Trust
On our free dating app, Reciprocal Love, we ensure that every user respects others. No inappropriate content is tolerated, and fake profiles are banned. The safety of our members is our top priority when it comes to dating.
Join us today for a serious, no-nonsense dating experience focused on what matters most: finding sincere and reciprocal love, without complicated algorithms, just simple chat and getting to know each other.
Reciprocal Love dating is very easy to use, one of its major advantages. A simple but effective dating app.

1inch Wallet is a self-custodial crypto wallet that puts you in control of your onchain assets. Manage and secure crypto across chains from Ethereum and Solana to Base and beyond. 
Why use 1inch Wallet?
• Maximize security with scam protection, biometric access, Ledger integration and more features.
• Use your crypto wallet across 13 networks: Ethereum, Solana, Base, Sonic, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon and more
• Enjoy DeFi wallet support for USDT, USDC, ETH, BNB, Wrapped Bitcoin and other tokens, plus memecoins and RWAs
• Track your onchain asset performance with PnL statistics for every token, and explore Web3 with the built-in browser.
Protect your crypto with confidence
• Get scam protection for tokens, addresses, transactions and domains

• Stay secure with biometric access and passcode protection
• Get 24/7 help from our support team directly in the 1inch Wallet app

• Use built-in 1inch products to move your assets
• Track your activity with full-text search and filters
• Save time with reusable transaction templates
• Send, request and receive payments with ease
• Keep trusted contacts in your address book
• Add and manage multiple wallets in one app
• Hide balances for privacy and use dark mode
Explore Web3 your way
• Use the built-in browser to explore and access dApps through a trusted app.
• Connect with DeFi protocols and services easily via WalletConnect
Back up and recover anytime
• Back up with iCloud snapshots, saving your state in the app for fast and secure recovery.
• Use file backup for secure cross-platform export and import
Whatever you’re holding, 1inch Wallet is the blockchain wallet that adapts to your needs. With self-custody and reliable backups, your assets stay protected at all times. Whatever you do in DeFi, do it with 1inch Wallet, your secure crypto wallet app.

Collect a variety of authentic locomotives, craft resources, and establish train routes across multiple countries and epoches. Whether you're an experienced tycoon or new to management games, this game offers a perfect blend of strategy and creativity.
 Key Features:
 - Realistic Simulation: Dive into a detailed world of authentic locomotives with realistic designs that enrich your gameplay. From steam engines and diesel, to many more - you'll find a diverse collection to upgrade and enjoy.
 - Railroad Diorama: Construct breathtaking displays showcasing your trains and stations. Explore intricate designs and every facet of your railway network.
 - Strategic Gameplay: Manage resources wisely, craft and build your network, and progress through unique challenges across various countries. Make strategic decisions to grow your vehicle enterprise.
 - Management Experience: Step into the conductor's role and become the ultimate railroad manager. Navigate scenarios that test your skills as you grow from a tiny pocket network into a sprawling success.
 - Complete Episodes: Engage in episodes that deepen your experience with missions designed to challenge your strategy and elevate your transport management skills.
 In ""Train King Tycoon: Rail Empire,"" your journey includes:
 - Collecting a diverse range of locomotives to build an unmatched fleet.
 Crafting essential resources to expand your operations.
- Upgrading stations to enhance passenger and cargo efficiency.
- Experiencing historical simulations that celebrate the legacy of railroads.
- Challenge yourself as you construct your network and manage operations across stunning landscapes. The 3D graphics bring every locomotive and station to life, offering a visually immersive experience.
 Join a vibrant community of railroad enthusiasts and management gamers. Are you ready to lead the most authentic railroad simulation adventure? Step into ""Train King Tycoon: Empire Rail,"" where every choice shapes your success.
 Download now and rush building your railway legacy today
IGRS rating: 13+

bluejetty:00156087:ios.description:
Enhance your musical skills with Clefable – your essential guide for mastering note reading and clef recognition. Whether you're a budding musician or a seasoned artist, Clefable empowers you to grasp musical notations with precision and confidence.
Explore Key Features:
Diverse Clef Modes: Immerse yourself in 7 distinct clef modes – treble, bass, alto, tenor, soprano, mezzo-soprano, and baritone. This holistic approach deepens your understanding of musical notation across genres and instruments.
Guided Learning: Engage in interactive tutorials that systematically introduce you to each note. Whether you're taking your first steps or refining your skills, Clefable's guided learning accommodates all levels.
Customizable Practice: Tailor note pitches and quantities in our dynamic practice mode to align with your proficiency, ensuring focused and effective practice sessions.
Note Name Modes: Select between traditional notes notation or solfege.
Daily Reminders: Stay dedicated to your musical journey with daily notifications, fostering consistency and gradual progress.
Clefable offers an easy-to-use interface and well-designed features that can enhance your musical abilities. Regardless if you're a pianist, vocalist, or instrumentalist, Clefable is designed to refine your skillset. Start your journey with Clefable today – where note reading mastery meets your creative spirit.

bluejetty:00088026:ios.description:
Sve informacije potrebne vozačima na jednom mjestu uvijek su pri ruci uz mobilnu aplikaciju Hrvatskog autokluba - HAK!
Hrvatski autoklub nacionalna je udruga vozača i vlasnika vozila, a kroz svoju mobilnu aplikaciju nudi niz korisnih informacija, kao što su.
- trenutačno stanje na cestama, graničnim prijelazima i trajektnom prometu
- informacije o ograničenjima i zabranama prometovanja na cestama
- prognozu prometa za sutra
- slike uživo s preko 200 kamera na najbitnijim cestovnim pravcima u RH
- olakšano plaćanje parkiranja SMS-om uz uslugu mParking, uz automatsku detekciju grada i parkirne zone
- aktualne cijene goriva u Hrvatskoj i prosječne cijene goriva u Europi
- pregled TV emisije Promet info
- pregled velikog broja interesnih točaka (POI) raspoređenih u kategorije (autokampovi, autoškole, bankomati, bolnice, hosteli, hoteli, poštanski uredi i kovčežići, kiosci, ljekarne, nacionalni parkovi, parkovi prirode, poslovnice banaka, prodavaonice, stanice za tehnički pregled i dr.)
- popis autoklubova udruženih u HAK
- popis partnera u sustavima ušteda "HAK preporučuje" i "Show your Card!"
- pozivanje pomoći na cesti uz slanje Vaše točne lokacije Kontaktnom centru HAK-a
- izračun troškova tehničkog pregleda i registracije vozila
- pregled zauzeća pojedinih javnih garaža i parkirališta uživo
- Gdje mi je auto? - alat za pomoć pri pronalasku svog automobila parkiranog u nepoznatoj sredini
- pregled cestarina na kompletnoj mreži autocesta u Hrvatskoj
- olakšano kontaktiranje HAK-a i važnih službi (brzo biranje hitnih brojeva)
Preuzmite aplikaciju i istražite sve njezine mogućnosti!
Vaš Hrvatski autoklub

bluejetty:00073887:ios.description:
● "Rated 4 out of 4 ... the best of its kind at the crowded App Store" - USA TODAY ●
The top selling fitness app of all time has returned! Becoming and staying fit has never been easier with the help of Full Fitness! Hundreds of exercises are explained with clear pictures, videos and text instructions all within the palm of your hand! 
We understand personal trainers can be costly, but changing your workout routine is essential for keeping your body from growing accustomed to the same old exercises. If anything, adding some variety keeps things interesting and enjoyable - making it more likely that you will stick with the program. 
Full Fitness not only provides instructions for hundreds of exercises, but it sorts them by body region, muscle of target, and the equipment needed. Use our easy-to-use exercise builder to create your own custom exercise routine, and then track your progress as you perform each exercise. Full Fitness allows you to log your exercises, view progress graphs, and email or backup the results online.
Not sure which exercises to perform? Use one of our 30 pre-defined routines to reach a particular goal. All of our routines are developed by licensed fitness professionals and come with complete instructions.
If you have no equipment available, or are more interested in cardio or stretches, Full Fitness has you covered! Tracking of cardio exercises, over 40 stretches and exercises and routines that require no equipment are all included! Full Fitness does even more. Track your food intake and body weight, schedule workouts, setup profiles to track more than one user, and more. This is the intuitive and beautiful fitness app you have been looking for!
FEATURES
● hundreds of unique exercises (more than any other app)
● clear images of people doing every exercise with full text instructions
● hundreds of video instructions for many of the more complicated exercises
● calorie tracker with over 90,000 food items
● cleverly designed logging feature to record and track each exercise
● ability to add your own exercise and track your progress
● exercises ordered by target (abs, arms, back, etc), muscle they target (deltoids, biceps, etc) or equipment they require (swissball, kettlebells, nothing, etc)
● 30 routines to reach various goals (weight loss, strength, ab definition, golf program, etc)
● graph your workout results to give yourself the encouraging boost you need
● stop-watch timer to keep track of your rest times in between sets
● weight monitor/BMI calculator and measurements tracker to view your progress
● schedule your workouts ahead of time so you never forget your workout routine 
● iCloud support and the ability to import content from Full Fitness or original iFitness app
● workout sharing tool to share your workouts between other Full Fitness users
We are dedicated to providing regular free updates. The next update is under development. Write in and let us know what most interests you.
Subscription information:
* $49.99/year for unlimited VIP access to your personal program and full features
* Payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase
* Manage and cancel subscriptions in Account Settings. When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period.
* Auto-renews 24 hours before the current period ends
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription
* Please note: Always consult a physician before starting any fitness program. Results may vary
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/fullfitnesspolicies/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00200112:ios.description:
Undersong is an AUv3 audio effect that plays along with whatever audio you send it. It's technically an audio effect, but it acts more like an instrument.
It's based on an idea I had for a live performance that ended up taking on a life of its own. The short version is that everything Undersong plays comes from the audio coming in. It listens to your track for "action", like a pluck, a drum hit or a swell, and each of those can spawn a particle. A particle is one small synthesized note, often a pluck but not always, and it's always in key. Soft playing gets soft and lower responses, and digging in gets you brighter ones.
I feel like Undersong is something that wishes to be the main focus of a composition, but how you use it is totally up to you. I really enjoy using it as the centerpiece of ambient jams with a bit of percussion or a slow moving bassline alongside. If you're not sure where to start, send in a drum loop (even just a series of blips or clicks will work...), turn up the Mix to 100% and just experiment for a while. Twist some knobs and see what you find. You can't break it.
The particles can be one of 12 materials, mostly inspired by modular synthesis techniques. Each material can then be performed and shaped by one of 10 modes and 10 patterns. That makes for 1200 combinations before you turn a single dial. One of the modes, Aurora, stops making particles altogether and turns into a self-generating ambient pad that your playing strikes. It's one of my favorite things in the device.
I tried to build this like a playground for ambient performances. It's maybe a bit like sitting down at someone else's modular rig... it takes some exploration. I've set up an environment that I think is inspiring and I hope you can find your way around and enjoy it as well. There's various ideas and features hidden throughout (in plain sight) that work nicely together or on their own. Gravity, an idea I brought over from my Augur device, pulls the notes toward your root so the melodies sound like they're actually in your key. With Ear on, Undersong listens for the pitch you're playing and answers in unison, grain plays tiny pieces of your own audio back as notes, and Input lets little glimpses of your audio through, so you hear the thwack of your pick or your snare, but ringing at the particle's note.
Step puts everything on a steady rhythm, one note per step, with Density deciding how busy it is. Step plus the Loop pattern is a fun little corner to jam in. Freeze holds whatever's currently ringing out so you can play over it. There's a Drone dial that builds a bed under everything, and 35 scales plus your own custom ones. Plus a quick one-knob reverb, because I really like reverb and I think almost every one of my devices has received at least a little reverb, just in case you need it quickly.
To sum up, I'm proud of this and I have been consistently getting lost in it while building and testing. I feel it's the kind of device that you have to get to know a bit. It's pretty dense. It's maybe not for everyone, but for the people who it resonates with, I'm glad you're here and I hope it brings you some inspiration. 
If you run into any issues or have some feature requests for a later update, don't hesitate to reach out at ian@ijoaudio.com. I appreciate you very much. Cheers!
ian - ijo audio

bluejetty:00122114:ios.name: Stick Nodes - Animator
bluejetty:00122114:ios.summary: Stick Nodes is a powerful stickman animator app created with mobile devices in mind! Inspired from the popular Pivot stickfigure animator, Stick Nodes allows users to create their own stickfigure-based movies and even export them as animate
bluejetty:00122114:ios.description:
Stick Nodes is a powerful stickman animator app created with mobile devices in mind! Inspired from the popular Pivot stickfigure animator, Stick Nodes allows users to create their own stickfigure-based movies and even export them as animated GIFs and MP4 videos! It is one of the most popular animation apps among young animators!
■ Features ■
◆ Import and animate images as well!
◆ Automatic customizeable frame-tweening, make your animations smoother!
◆ A simple camera to pan/zoom/rotate around the scene, similar to the "v-cam" in Flash.
◆ Movieclips allow you to create and reuse/loop animation objects within your projects.
◆ A variety of shapes, color/scale on a per-segment basis, gradients - create any "stickfigure" you can imagine!
◆ Textfields allow for easy text and speech in your animations.
◆ Add all kinds of sounds effects to make your animations epic.
◆ Apply different filters to your stickfigures - transparency, blur, glow, and more.
◆ Join stickfigures together to easily simulate holding/wearing objects.
◆ A large community full of all kinds of interesting people and other animators.
◆ Over 30,000+ stickfigures (and counting) to download from the website.
◆ Export to GIF (or MP4 for Pro) to share your animation online.
◆ Compatibility with pre-3.0 Pivot stickfigure files.
◆ Save/open/share your projects, stickfigures, and movieclips.
◆ And all the other typical animation stuff - undo/redo, onion-skin, background images, and more!
* Please note, sounds, filters, and MP4-export are Pro-only features
■ Lanuages ■
◆ English
◆ Español
◆ Français
◆ Japanese
◆ Filipino
◆ Português
◆ Russian
◆ Türkçe
Stick Nodes has a thriving community where animators have a good time, help each other out, show off their work, and even create stickfigures for others to use! There are thousands of stickfigures (and more added daily!) over at the main website https://sticknodes.com/stickfigures/
As of one of the latest updates, Stick Nodes is also a Minecraft™ animator as it allows you to easily import Minecraft™ skins and animate them instantly!
Search for "stick nodes" on YouTube to see just a few of the thousands of animations users have made with this stickfigure animation app! If you're looking for an animation creator or an animation maker app, this is it!
■ Stay Updated ■
New updates have been never-ending for Stick Nodes since it's original 2014 release. Keep up-to-date with the latest news and updates about your favorite stick figure animation app and join in with the community!
◆ Website: https://sticknodes.com
◆ Facebook: http://facebook.com/sticknodes
◆ Reddit: http://reddit.com/r/sticknodes
◆ Twitter: http://twitter.com/FTLRalph
◆ Youtube: http://youtube.com/FTLRalph
Stick Nodes is *the best* simple animation app available on the iOS market! It's a great tool for learning animation, even in a school setting for students or newbies. At the same time, Stick Nodes is robust enough and powerful enough for even the most skilled animator to really showcase their skills!
Thank you for trying out Stick Nodes! Leave any questions/comments below or on the main Stick Nodes website! Common questions are already answered on the FAQ page here https://sticknodes.com/faqs/

bluejetty:00143320:android.description:
I am a schoolboy - the official mobile application for Tatarstan schoolchildren. The service will help you prepare for lessons and improve your performance through convenient access to digital services of Electronic Education of the Republic of Tatarstan (ms-edu.tatar.ru, My School).
In “I am a schoolboy” this is a super service where you get the opportunity to:
– keep track of the schedule and important information about lessons
– receive homework and plan to complete it
– study and complete additional materials for homework
– study video selections, tests and assignments for subjects
– monitor ratings and statistics
- keep in touch with the teacher
– track your ranking in the class
– receive answers to a variety of questions from the chatbot assistant
– receive personal tips and find out the dynamics of changes in academic performance
– receive useful information and announcements in stories
– take surveys and give feedback
– receive virtual rewards for success in studies and extracurricular activities and exchange them for points and real prizes
– participate in various competitions in the “Competitions” service
– receive psychological help in the “Psychologist Help” service
– participate in special projects: “Megabytes for grades”, “Kitapstan”, “Interactive competition-series on road safety” and many others.
And all this is free and without advertising!
That's not all! We are preparing a lot of interesting features for you that will turn the mobile application into your personal digital assistant in your studies and even extracurricular activities.

العربیة
ئەپڵیکەیشنی بازاڕی دۆلار :: بورصة العراقیة سعر الدولار
لە ڕێگەی ئەم ئەپەوە ڕۆژانە ئاگاداری نرخی زێڕ و نرخی دراوەکان و بە تایبەتی نرخی دۆلار بە لە بۆرسەکانی عێراق و کوردستان کە هەموو ڕۆژێک لە ڕێگەی ئاگادارییەوە پێت دەگات
تایبەتمەندییەکان:
١-نرخی ڕۆژانەی دراوەکان
٢-حاسیبەیەک بۆ ئاڵوگۆڕی دراوەکان
 ٣-هێڵکاری بەرز و نزمی دراوەکان لە بۆرسەکاندا
٤-نرخی فرۆشتن و وەرگرتنی زێڕ
٥-چاتێکی تێدایە کە سات بە سات نرخی دراوەکانی تێدا دا دەنرێت 
٦- ئاگاداری نرخی دۆلار بە سات بە سات لە بازاڕەاکنی کوردستاندا
٧- Iraq Borsa نرخی دراوەکان لە بۆرسە کاندا
(نرخی دۆلار ئێستا)
_________________________________________________________
من خلال هذا التطبيق، أنت على علم بسعر الذهب والعملات يوميا في بورصات العراق وكردستان التي تتلقاها كل يوم من خلال تنبيه
خصائص:
1- السعر اليومي الدولار و للعملات البورصة العراقیة
2- حساب لتبادل العملات
3- الرسم البياني المرتفع والمنخفض سعرالدولار و للعملات
4- سعر بيع واستلام الذهب
5- يحتوي على دردشة يتم فيها وضع سعر العملات في الوقت الحالي
6- البورصة العراقیة Iraq Borsa

bluejetty:00023051:ios.summary:
