Winner’s Soccer Evolution is a real 3D competitive football game. It includes the teams and the latest football players’ data of 2018 International Cup. There are various modes for you to select. It has up to 32 teams an
bluejetty:00023051:ios.description:
It's totally FREE.
Winner’s Soccer Evolution is a real 3D competitive football game. It includes the teams and the latest football players’ data of 2018 International Cup. There are various modes for you to select. It has up to 32 teams and 600 players. Smooth actions and playback function let you feel like you actually in the game. 
1．Game Modes
 This game has various modes, including Cup , Friendly Match and Penalty Shootout. It also has a training mode for you to train skills of your team, dividing into Primary, Medium and Advanced.
Friendly Match Mode: You can select 2 teams from 32 teams to compete or shoot penalty.
Cup Mode: You can select your favorite team from 32 national teams to participate the International Cup. 
Training Mode: You can select a team to perfect its operation skills.
2. Various Operation Skills
 This game provides two kinds of operation modes. You can choose the most suitable one. (You can change mode in Options under Menu or tap button || to activate Menu in game.)
You can read Control Method in Help of Options under Menu.
The operation adopts an international popular way, setting 5 pass ball keys: Short Pass /Press and Long Pass/Slide Tackle, Shoot, Through Pass/GK Rush Out, Long through Pass and Special Dribble /Focus Change.
Short Pass: It is short pass in offense. Let controller press opponent dribbler in defense.
Long Pass: Press Power Accumulate and pass the ball to a mate of appropriate distance after release. Let controller slide tackle when defend.
Shoot: Make different shooting actions according to Power Accumulate and the distance between player and ball.
Special Dribble: Including many special dribble actions: Marsille roulette, Step over, Step over and Pull back.
Automatic combination skills:
Through Pass: Pass ball to catcher according to Power Accumulate.
Long through Pass: Pass ball to catcher with Long Pass according to Power Accumulate.
Sprint: Rapid dribble, fasten speed of dribble but worsen control of ball.
Drive ball out: Stop ball far away from body and facilitate dribble starting acceleration.
Dribble with far distance: Double click in front when fast dribble can dribble farther and facilitate fast run.
Fake Shoot and Fake Long pass: Pressing Short Pass when (or after) Shoot or Power Accumulate will cancel shoot or long pass. They are used to dribble past opponent Defenders or GK.
One-Two pass: Two players cooperate to dribble past opponent Defenders.
Lob shoot: Press Special Dribble to shoot.
Control tracks of ball: Press direction keys to control the flying arc of ball.

bluejetty:00089256:ios.description:
BUDGET + BANKING in one easy app. It's banking 2.0
Forget the pen and paper, the spreadsheets, the physical cash and envelopes, the reconciliation, the manual entry, and the inaccurate transaction reporting.
Stop worrying about losing an envelope full of cash, losing your wallet, or having your card lost or stolen.
Qube Money is going where no other budgeting app has gone before—bringing a digital version of the cash envelope system to a proprietary banking platform.
It’s not just a budgeting app, but a full-suite banking and peer-to-peer payments app, too.
QUBE YOUR BUDGET
Qube Money is a mobile banking app that automatically splits your money into separate digital accounts, creating purpose behind every dollar.
SPEND WITH PURPOSE
Choose which qube you’re spending from before each purchase, automatically limiting your spending habits. Each qube controls the available funds ready to spend with your qube debit card.
REAL-TIME BUDGETING
Qube Money automatically keeps track of precisely what, when, and where you spent—no more trying to remember what goes where—it’s already organized in your qubes.
A WHOLE NEW LEVEL OF SECURITY
The Qube Card is engineered so that you're the only one who can use it. Default Zero technology requires a category to be opened from your phone before you can spend with your card. All the advanced security technologies on today’s smartphones make it virtually impossible for someone to get into your phone and your apps. This is a whole new level of security.
HOW QUBE MONEY WORKS
 1. Deposit money into your Qube Cloud
 2. Create and fund your personal qubes
 3. Spend with complete control and transparency
 4. Automate tracking
DOWNLOAD THE APP TODAY!
Qube Money bank account services are provided by Choice Financial Group Inc and are FDIC insured.
Opening a Qube Money account will not affect your credit score.
LOVE QUBE MONEY?
Your feedback is what keeps us going!
Please take a moment to rate our app.
Find a bug? Please send an email to support@qubemoney.com. We’re happy to help!
To learn how Qube Money protects your private data, please visit https://qubemoney.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00077358:ios.description:
Track Your Baby's Growth with Official WHO & CDC Charts
Easily monitor your baby or child’s growth using the official standards from the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). This app automatically calculates and graphs your child's growth, making it simple to track and compare progress over time.
Key Features:

- Preterm Baby Support: Automatically calculates gestational age using the due date and includes Fenton 2013 Preterm Growth Charts.
- WHO & CDC Chart Selection: Automatically selects the correct chart based on the exam date.
- Instant Growth Trends: View your child’s growth trends with an easy-to-read graph.
- Supports US & Metric Units: Choose between US (lb, oz, ft, in) and Metric (kg, cm) units.
- Official WHO & CDC Charts: Graph your child’s data on the most accurate growth charts.
- Easy Data Backup & Sharing: Store your data safely with iCloud, CSV backup, and easy sharing with friends and family.
- Print or Export Charts: Print official charts or export them as PDFs.
- Compare Multiple Children: View and compare the growth data of all your children on a single graph.
- Automatic BMI Calculation: Get BMI and percentiles for both WHO and CDC charts.
- Chinese Growth Chart support for global tracking.
- Adult Height Calculator: Predict your child’s adult height using the Mid-Parent Method or the Khamis-Roche Method.
Start tracking your child’s growth today! Download now and see your child’s growth data with official WHO and CDC charts.

bluejetty:00131198:ios.description:
This is Solvo—your AI homework helper and math solver for every subject.
Trusted by over a million students, parents, and tutors around the world, Solvo turns tough assignments into step-by-step learning moments. Got a homework problem, a big exam coming up, or a topic that just won’t click? The app breaks it all down so you can walk away with a solid understanding, not just a good grade.
With Solvo, you can:
- Scan and solve problems in math, chemistry, physics, and biology.
- Learn through detailed, step-by-step explanations that reveal the “why” behind every answer.
- Create AI flashcards from notes, textbooks, or research papers to study your way.
- Summarize documents, videos, and web pages so you can focus on what actually matters.
- Get instant, accurate answers—over 10 million problems solved and counting.
Here’s how Solvo helps you study:
● SNAP A PHOTO, GET THE ANSWER
Capture a photo of any problem, and Solvo will recognize it and walk you through a clear, detailed solution. From equations to essay prompts, one snap is all it takes.
● MASTER MATH STEP BY STEP
Solvo’s math solver handles everything from school-level algebra to university calculus. Algebra, trigonometry, geometry, linear algebra, logic, statistics, quadratic equations, linear functions—every answer is explained step by step so you can follow along and build real understanding.
● ACE EVERY SUBJECT AND TEST
Chemistry formulas, biology concepts, physics equations, multiple-choice quizzes: Solvo covers them all. Type or scan your question, and get a guided explanation that actually helps you learn.
● ASK ANYTHING, LEARN INSTANTLY
Type your question and get guided help from AI. Solve math problems, get science answers, write and rewrite essays, or chat through any subject you’re studying.
● BUILD FLASHCARDS FAST
Turn your notes, textbook pages, or even full research papers into interactive flashcards with a single snap. Prefer to build your own? Fill them in yourself for a more hands-on study session. Either way, you’re set for test day.
● SUMMARIZE WHAT MATTERS MOST
Paste a link, upload a document, or drop in a web page—Solvo pulls out the essentials so you can focus on key points without missing a thing.
Homework doesn’t have to be a struggle. Download Solvo and make studying easier. 
And if you'd really like to be unstoppable in class, consider Premium! A subscription gives you:

bluejetty:00026623:ios.description:
The new myPhonak comes with improved functionality and a new design to make your hearing experience as seamless and as tailored to your needs as possible. myPhonak provides you access to enhanced hearing controls and personalization options for your Phonak hearing aid(s) in addition to tracking your health data.*
The Remote Control enables you to easily make changes to your hearing aid(s) to suit your personal preferences for various listening situations. You can easily adjust the volume and various hearing aid features (e.g., noise reduction and microphone directionality) or select pre-defined programs according to the different listening situation you are in. Additionally, you can make quick adjustments to the pitch of the sound in the equalizer by using the presets (default, comfort, clarity, softer, etc.) or more personalized adjustments using the sliders (bass, middle, treble). 
The Remote Support allows you to meet with your hearing care professional through a live video call and have your hearing aids adjusted remotely. (by appointment) 
Numerous functions are available within the Health section such as Steps* and Wearing time*, including Optional goal setting*, Activity levels*, Heart rate tracking**, Distance walked and ran***.

bluejetty:00122432:ios.description:
First National Bank of Clarksdale is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with First National Bank of Clarksdale:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First National Bank of Clarksdale app, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank of Clarksdale Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00145719:ios.description:
Runcam Legacy, for easy control of your RunCam high definition cameras.
By connecting the camera via WiFi, you can:
* Capture videos/photos with a variety of shooting modes.
* Adjust the camera parameters and preview in real time.
* Play/Download videos/photos.
* Record in landscape and preview in full screen.
* Update firmware through App.
* Set all camera parameters.
----The main functions——
Real-time parameters settings
+ Full control of the camera: adjust the camera parameters, start/stop recording and switch mode.
+ Customize white balance, exposure value, FOV, metering mode, image flip etc.
+ Adjust the camera parameters and preview in real time according to the actual scene. 
+ Loop recording, automatic recording, WDR and more parameters.
Capture/Download
+ User-friendly shooting interface, easy to operate.
+ Linkage of the button: When the camera is connected to the App, you can also use the power button on the camera to start/stop shooting.
+ View, play back the captured video/photos and download to the local album.
+ Browse and delete files from your camera's memory card
Update your cameras
+ Update your camera anytime, anywhere to experience the latest features and best performance
--RunCam App applicable equipments -
+ RunCam2
+ RunCam3
--Instructions for use--
-Turn on the camera and open the camera WiFi.
-Use your mobile device to search the camera WiFi (Initial name is RUNCAM2_xxx / RUNCAM3_xxx, the initial password is 1234567890) and connect.
-Open the App, connect the camera and enter into preview.
--System Requirements--
iOS 12.0 and above
Details can be found at: http://www.runcam.com
If you have any comments or suggestions, please contact us at runcamapp@gmail.com

bluejetty:00131627:ios.description:
FitCoach - a fitness app for those who want to start a new active lifestyle, build healthy habits, lose weight, get fit, tone up, and feel amazing.
FEATURES:
► Personal training plans
► Step tracker
► Workout history
► Audio prompts during the workout
► Training reminders
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
The FitCoach app is developed specifically for people who care about their health and want to slim down and get in shape but don’t have enough time to go to the gym.
HOW TO START WITH FITCOACH?
Set your goals: weight loss, muscle gain, or being more active
Select the zone that you want to work on: belly, buttocks, legs, arms.
Enter your personal data such as age, height, weight, fitness level, etc.
HOW DOES IT WORK:
According to your goals and personal data, our intelligent algorithm will suggest a personalized workout plan – a combination of cardio, strength, recovery, and other exercises that will enable you to maximize your results. 
Each week the workout plan will be updated according to your progress and feedback (were the previous workouts too easy or too difficult for you).
FitCoach integrates with the Health app to import Steps data from HealthKit to FitCoach.
FitCoach also integrates with the Fitbit app to import data from Fitbit to FitCoach. 
____________ 
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
You can download the app for free. Further use requires a subscription. At our discretion, we may decide to offer you a free trial per the terms displayed in the app. Please note that:
When opting for a subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews and free trial automatically converts into subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
In addition to the purchased subscription, we may offer you add-on items (e.g. fitness guides, VIP customer support service) for an additional fee, either one-off or recurrent. This purchase is optional: your subscription is not conditional on such a purchase. All such offers will be displayed in the app.
For more information, see our:
Frequently Asked Questions: https://fitcoach.fit/faq-ios.html
Privacy Notice: https://legal.fit-coach.io/page/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://legal.fit-coach.io/page/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00177707:ios.description:
Athan Times – Your Ultimate Islamic Companion
Athan Times is a comprehensive and essential tool for Muslims, ensuring you stay on track with your daily Salah schedule during Ramadan and beyond. This all-in-one Islamic app offers powerful features, including Islamic Prayer Times, Qibla Compass, Hijri Calendar, Al Quran, Duas, Tasbih Counter, 99 Names of Allah, Mosque Finder, Ramadan Timings (Sehri & Iftar), Zakat Calculator, Kalimah and much more.
Key Features:
Accurate Islamic Prayer Times
 • Displays Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha prayer times, and Sunrise timing.
 • Set Azan alarms for each prayer.
 • View monthly prayer times for the entire Islamic calendar.
 • Supports multiple calculation methods, including Hanafi/Shafi and Coordinated Universal Time.
 • Daylight Savings Time adjustments for accurate Salah timings.
 • Apple Watch support for real-time prayer notifications.
 • Today Widget integration for quick access to prayer times.
Ramadan Sehri & Iftar Timings

bluejetty:00154149:ios.summary:
O Meu Controle de Ponto é um App de Registro de Ponto Online que entrega facilidade e

Com ele, as pessoas podem registrar sequencialmente suas entradas, saídas e interv
bluejetty:00154149:ios.description:
O Meu Controle de Ponto é um App de Registro de Ponto Online que entrega facilidade e
informação ao colaborador e garante tempo e segurança para os gestores.
Com ele, as pessoas podem registrar sequencialmente suas entradas, saídas e intervalos,
de maneira simples, rápida, segura e confiável. Afinal, nosso app conta com criptografia de
ponta a ponta na transferência de dados para o sistema de ponto em nuvem.
Entre os principais recursos, podemos destacar:
- Registro de Ponto Online e Offline
Se o seu dispositivo ficar sem internet, seus colaboradores poderão registrar o ponto
normalmente. Nosso app reconhece automaticamente o estado da sua conexão, e da sua
internet, para se adaptar e continuar funcionando.
- Registro de Ponto com Foto
Você poderá optar por exigir uma foto, ou não, no ato do registro de ponto.
- Sincronização automática dos registros Offline
A sincronização dos registros de ponto offline ocorre automaticamente. Você também
poderá acompanhar seu status em tempo real. Além disso, enquanto o app sincroniza, seus
colaboradores poderão registrar o ponto normalmente.
- 100% dentro da Lei
Nosso App está totalmente de acordo com as Portarias 1510 e 373, do Ministério do
Trabalho. Também já estamos com diversas implementações pertinentes à nova Portaria
671. Você está seguro para fazer o controle de ponto online, e a gestão da jornada, na sua
empresa.
- Automação com Solicitações
Seus colaboradores poderão criar solicitações de abonos e ajustes diretamente pelo App,
subindo documentos e automatizando a gestão do ponto, uma vez que aceita, a tratativa de
ponto é aplicada automaticamente de acordo com a sua ação.
Bem configurada, reduzirá a gestão do seu ponto há poucos minutos e pouquíssimos
cliques!
- Assinatura de cartão de ponto
Gere os cartões de ponto dos seus colaboradores pelo sistema web para que eles possam
assinar diretamente pelo aplicativo. Lá, será possível solicitar revisões e concluir o processo
com simplicidade e clareza. Economia de tempo, papel. Além de ser perfeito para o Home
Office.
- Banco de horas
Suporte ao banco de horas do colaborador com gráfico de evolução e extrato de operações.
- Faltas e ocorrências
Mostre ao seu colaborador suas faltas e ocorrências, estimulando a criação de solicitações
e a gestão automatizada do seu ponto. A ideia é que você tenha tempo para as pessoas.
- Visão 360
Com nosso conceito de Visão 360 da gestão da jornada de trabalho, você pode utilizar o
app junto com o Relógio de Ponto, tudo isso alimentando o seu sistema sem confusão.
É hora de transformar seu negócio com agilidade, segurança jurídica e inovação!

bluejetty:00139789:ios.summary:
A cozy idle clicker tycoon game set in old Korea!
Manage your own Joseon-era tavern: sell hotteok (Korean rice pancakes), hire staff, upgrade your facilities, and watch your business grow even when you're away. Whether you tap fast for qui
bluejetty:00139789:ios.description:
A cozy idle clicker tycoon game set in old Korea!
Manage your own Joseon-era tavern: sell hotteok (Korean rice pancakes), hire staff, upgrade your facilities, and watch your business grow even when you're away. Whether you tap fast for quick progress or let it idle while you sleep, this relaxing tavern tycoon keeps growing.
Ta-da! Just like that, you've become the manager of a Joseon-era tavern, a place to get food and drinks!
Jumo, the tavern proprietress, is struggling to revive the old, run-down tavern with limited manpower.
Only YOU can restore her tavern to its former glory, transforming it into the kingdom's #1 tavern!
Start by making some hotteok, serving your hungry customers, and then building your tavern!
▶ Me, the manager of a Joseon Dynasty tavern? ◀
You've been given a free hand in every aspect of tavern management.
Make hotteok (rice pancakes), purchase production facilities, and hire staff — it's all up to you!
What would you like to do first to grow your tavern?
▶ Faster, faster!! ◀
Tap the screen to make hotteok, then make even more using the ones you've already made!
In the beginning, you'll have to make them one at a time, but later you'll go from 1,000 to 10,000 in the blink of an eye.
Using the hotteok you've made, hire staff to do the work for you, and soon you'll be living the easy life!
▶ Unleash the godlike power at your fingertips. ◀
Make hotteok, purchase automated facilities, serve customers, hire and train staff… All this is only a tap away!
If we say it's an "easy, relaxing" game, you'll be skeptical, right?
Well, but this game really is!
Why don't you give it a try and find out?
▶ After everyone's fallen asleep... ◀
It happens. You fall asleep or something comes up and you can't check in on your tavern. 
Don't worry, your employees and facilities will keep up the hard work of making you rich. Just decide what to purchase and what to upgrade!
That's what the boss does, after all!
▶ The Snail Bride, selling hotteok in a tavern? ◀
 What's with the Korean children's stories, you ask?
 These are all potential coworkers, ready to be employed!
 Ever wonder why Dol, the Servant came to work at a tavern, or why Seondal, the Swindler is here selling hotteok?
 Start your tavern manager journey now and find out!
Oh, so you're ready to try your hand at managing a tavern?
Excellent choice! I just knew I had an eye for people.
Well then, I'll be waiting!

bluejetty:00131539:ios.description:
It’s like podcasts, but for reading.
NetNewsWire is a free and open source RSS reader. It shows you articles from your favorite blogs and news sites and keeps track of what you’ve read. It’s fast, stable, and accessible.
If you’ve been going from site to site in your browser looking for new articles to read — or counting on the unreliable algorithms of corporate social media — let NetNewsWire bring you the news you want.
It’s easy and fun. And it puts you, not billionaires, in control of your news.
Features:
* Direct feed downloading
* Syncing via iCloud, Feedbin, Feedly, BazQux, Inoreader, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, and FreshRSS
* Multiple accounts
* Custom article themes
* Reader view
* Share sheet
* Starred articles
* All Unread and Today smart feeds
* Folders
* Importing and exporting OPML feed lists
* Background refreshing
* Searching
* Hiding read articles
* Timeline customization
* Keyboard shortcuts
* Context menus
* Home screen widgets for today, unread, and starred articles
* Share extension

bluejetty:00165576:ios.description:
The Ministry of Discipline needs your help! A new burglar going by the name “Puss in Boots” is loose on the streets of Taleville. With citizens living in fear and few leads to go from, only a Fairy Godmother of your caliber can crack the case! But appearances can be deceiving in this mystical world, and it’ll take all of your skills and magical prowess to find who’s pulling all the strings. Do you have what it takes to save the city in time? Find out in this breathtaking Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!
· RESCUE THE LITTLE MERMAID ON HER WEDDING DAY IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play more exciting puzzles and hide and seek games after you finish the main story!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI-GAMES TO EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Never let your guard down - collectibles are hidden in every corner of our hidden object mystery games!
· DECORATE YOUR FAIRY ROOM!
Collect artifacts to decorate a room in the find hidden object games!
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, VIDEOS, CONCEPT ART, AND MORE!
Visit the extra menu and enjoy bonuses - art, music, hidden objects games for free, and more!
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Use a helpful Guide if you ever get stuck in our finding objects game!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Visit our website to play more brain teasers and puzzles: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

• Daily local news and stories from Boise and communities across the Treasure Valley.

LOCAL SPORTS
• Full coverage reporting on local, pro and college sports teams.
• Stay connected to your favorite teams and favorite sports writers.
PERSONALIZATION
• Stay informed on the topics and articles that matter to you.
• Favorite topics to get personalized feeds. 
• Search for news articles, videos, games and more.
• Bookmark news articles to read later.
• Read articles your way with full support for dark mode and light mode.

• Browse articles by category.
• Share articles on Facebook, X Twitter or by email.
• Comment on news articles.
• Access and download previous issues of our newspaper.
• Recharge and unwind with our puzzles and games.

Here's
bluejetty:00083633:ios.description:
Ever found yourself in a chat with friends discussing a topic you vaguely remember? Introducing iirc, short for "If I Recall Correctly." Harness the power of AI to boost your memory retention through a simple, step-by-step process.
Here's how it works:
* Share & Open: Simply share the website from your browser and tap to open iirc, kicking off your recall journey.
* 50% Recall Boost: Read a quick summary and challenge yourself with a brief quiz. Self-testing is key to enhancing your memory.
* 75% Mastery: Play it back and follow along. Everyone absorbs information differently—listening in addition to reading can make a significant difference.
* 90% Mnemonics Magic: Dive into mnemonics, a memory aid technique that leverages word association and visualization to reinforce your memory.
* 95% Personal Touch: Create and receive ratings on your own summary. It's not just about remembering; it's about understanding and retaining.
Key Features:
Summarization:
IIRC intelligently condenses lengthy information into concise and digestible summaries. Say goodbye to information overload and hello to a streamlined learning experience. Get the gist without losing the substance.
Self Test via Quiz:
Reinforce your understanding through interactive self-tests. IIRC generates customized quizzes based on the content you've learned, providing instant feedback and highlighting areas that may need further review. Learn actively and measure your progress effortlessly.
Play Back Information with Audio:
Immerse yourself in the learning process with IIRC's audio playback feature. Listen to key information on the go, turning idle moments into productive learning opportunities. Enhance your auditory memory and reinforce what you've learned through the power of sound.
Mnemonics:
Unleash the potential of mnemonics to boost your memory. IIRC incorporates mnemonic devices to help you create memorable associations, making it easier to recall complex information. Transform learning into a creative and engaging experience.
User-Generated Summaries and Ratings:
Empower the learning community by allowing users to contribute their own summaries. Share your insights and receive ratings, fostering collaboration and creating a diverse repository of high-quality user-generated content.
Personalized Learning Paths:
IIRC adapts to your unique learning style, offering personalized pathways that combine summarization, quizzes, audio playback, and mnemonics. Tailored to your preferences, the app ensures a customized learning experience that resonates with you.
Language support:
IIRC works in 85 languages, while the app UI (User Interface) is in English only, you can add content or share links in almost any language.
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00147229:ios.description:
Would you like to have a better relationship with food and your body? Make dietary changes for medical reasons? Overcome overeating or binge eating? Keep on track with a nutrition plan? Link with your dietitian or doctor for feedback? Then the Nourishly App is for you!
Nourishly was built with input from leading dietitians, psychologists and researchers to bring together “what works”, including:
* Cognitive-behavioral meal, activity, sleep, hunger and temptation tracking
* Simple and specialized meal plans
* Science backed micro-missions that tweak your habits to unlock breakthroughs
* Thought provoking and surprising rewards 
* Resilience strategies to help unstick you when needed
*Link with your care team to get feedback and precision treatment!
Oh, and we take your privacy and security super seriously. We comply with HIPAA and meet industry-standard security practices.
Please note: There is no calorie counting or advertising in this app. 
*** Why you should try it ***
Link with your care team. Turbo charge the care you receive by linking with your Dietitian, Nutritionist, Psychologist, Doctor, Social Worker, Health Coach, Nurse Practitioner, or Personal Trainer for insight-driven care and feedback in AND out of the session. 
Personalized meal, activity, mood and symptom trackers. You are multi-dimensional, and so should be your trusted tracker! Break free from stock-standard calorie counting with customizable and easy symptom, mood, thought, meal and activity tracking. 
400 science-backed missions to choose from. Gradually master proven habit-hacks that can help you to manage your symptom feel energetic in and feel happy and healthy.
Coping skills for when you get stuck. Take advantage of 200+ skills to unstick yourself when mental blockers, negative-self talk, lethargy and anxiety strike.
Meal planning that is flexible and stress free. Pick from expert curated symptom-specific meal plans, create your own, or link with your nutrition expert for a plan personalized for you. 
Celebrate wins with rewards. Be surprised and delighted by beautiful, funny and thought provoking reflection images and affirmations.
Nourishly may ask for access to your step count data if you are linked with a clinician who has requested it. Collection of this data is completely optional. We integrate with Apple's Health App to achieve this. The data will be handled and used in accordance with Nourishly's privacy policy and terms of service.

bluejetty:00099691:ios.description:
Anime City combines gameplay of a survival simulator and classic anime visual novels. You will have to study in a Japanese high school, engage in after school activities, and try to make new friends.
Features:
* Anime Culture: The game is focused on anime culture and aesthetics, authentically recreating building designs, clothes, food, activities, and other essential elements of anime and manga about school life.
* School and Clubs: In addition to attending regular school classes (history, physical education, Japanese language, cooking) you can join one of after school clubs (gardening, tennis, drama, science, music) and perform tasks assigned by club leaders.
* Friendship: You can improve your relationships with your classmates and other characters by spending time together and inviting them to club events.
* Skills: Your character's skills (fashion, cooking, science, sports, social, gardening, faith, arts) affect your personal stats, and your success of interactions with other characters. Improving these skills will require engaging in school activities or after-school clubs.
* Customization: You can start to play as a girl or a boy, with a range of parameters to customize, and 20+ equipment slots for clothes and accessories. You can also set up various furniture and decorations in your apartment.
* Survival Simulator: Your character has health, hunger, thirst, energy, and comfort stats. During the game, you'll have to balance limited resources and take care of your character's needs.

bluejetty:00040202:ios.description:
About Game 
~*~*~*~*~*~
Shopping! Shopping! Shopping!
Have you ever gone shopping at a supermarket and spent some time there?
How much shopping will you do in your limited time?
In a Goods Matching game, you have a lot of choices to make, like chocolate, snacks, drinks, groceries, toys, and many more, from the shelves.
You have an endless shopping experience with lots of unique levels and different game play.
Goods Master: Triple Match will completely change your shopping experience after playing this triple match 3D game.
How to play!
~*~*~*~*~*~
Place three identical 3D items on the supermarket counter.
Three of Same items will be cleared.
You have to shop continuously until all the closets are empty.
Use your strategic and logical abilities for fast shopping.
Complete the shopping before the time runs out and get some rewards.
Use a booster to pass the level before the time.
Change the theme at any time.
Mini Game - Arrow Puzzle
~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~
1000+ levels.
Guide arrows, clear the maze, and escape.
The game starts easy and gradually becomes more thoughtful as patterns grow more complex, it’s perfect for quick puzzle breaks or long, relaxing sessions. Enjoy a refreshing flow of puzzles designed to keep your mind sharp and your mood relaxed.
Mini Game - Hexa Puzzle 
~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~
Time to solve a creative hexa-sort merging puzzle.
There are almost 1,500 levels.
To merge, arrange hexa blocks by color on the board; the top of a hexa block with the same color will combine adjacent blocks.
Mini Game - Color Block Puzzle
~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~*~
Slide the colored blocks toward the relative doors to eliminate them. By strategically moving the blocks, you'll create combinations that trigger the door mechanisms.
Move the block in any direction.
Only the matching color block will be eliminated.
Features
~*~*~*~*~
1000+ levels.
Free-to-play!
Offline Game.
Classic game play is suitable for all ages.
Qualitative graphics and sound.
Simple and user-friendly controls.
Good particles and effects.
Best Animation

bluejetty:00026629:ios.description:

bluejetty:00060786:ios.description:
Shërbimet publike online në çdo moment, direkt në pajisjen tuaj
Aplikacioni e-Albania është porta e vetme digjitale, nëpërmjet së cilës qytetarët dhe bizneset mund të aksesojnë online, në çdo kohë dhe nga kudo, shërbime elektronike të ofruara nga institucionet publike në Shqiperi.
Platforma ofron një eksperiencë të shpejtë, të sigurt dhe të thjeshtë përdorimi, duke mundësuar marrjen e shërbimeve publike online përmes telefonit apo tabletit tuaj. 
Nëpërmjet Platformës Qeveritare të Ndërveprimit, institucionet publike shkëmbejnë të dhëna në kohë reale, duke reduktuar procedurat, kohën e marrjes së shërbimeve publike online dhe nevojën për paraqitje fizike.
e-Albania është pjesë e transformimit digjital të administratës publike dhe synon të ofrojë shërbime publike online përmes një pike të vetme kontakti, sipas standardeve moderne të aksesueshmërisë dhe sigurisë.
Karakteristikat kryesore:
Akses në shërbime publike online dhe pagesa elektronike të faturave dhe detyrimeve, verifikim i kundravajtjeve rrugore (gjobat), piket e drejtuesit të mjetit dhe taksave të automjeteve, të dhëna të gjendjes civile dhe certifikata elektronike, gjurmim i aplikimeve dhe çështjeve në kohë reale, shërbime për biznesin pranë Qendrës Kombëtare të Biznesit, informacion mbi shërbimet shëndetësore dhe dokumentacionin elektronik, ndërfaqe moderne dhe e optimizuar për pajisje mobile.
Shkarkoni aplikacionin e-Albania dhe aksesoni shërbimet publike online kudo që ndodheni.

bluejetty:00155801:ios.description:
Disabled, neurodivergent, or chronically ill? All of the above? Us too. Designed by folks with lived experience and in collaboration with accessibility experts, Spoony is a safe and supportive community platform. No stigma, no judgment. Just a place to be your ADHD, autistic, disabled, flaring and fabulous self.
Connect with people worldwide who get 'it' and get you.
From diagnosis questions and shared experiences to traveling tips, walking sticks and cat pics - Spoony makes it simple to share your thoughts publicly or chat privately.
Share your Spoon Status™
Some days you're full of spoons, other days not so much. Set your Spoon Status™ to let everybody know if you're seeking respite, revelry or somewhere in-between.
Track your symptoms over time 
Gain better insights into your symptoms with your Spoony journal. Log as much – or as little – as you like about your moods, thoughts, symptoms and what’s influencing them. 
Match with fellow Spoonies
Making friends just got easier. Get matched with people who just 'get it'

bluejetty:00177844:ios.name: Golf GPS++: Watch Tracker
bluejetty:00177844:ios.summary:
LEAVE YOUR PHONE IN THE BAG
Turn your Apple Watch into a powerful golf GPS, scorecard, and automatic shot tracker.
Get distances from your wrist, automatically record shots, keep score, and review your swing and putting performance—all wi
bluejetty:00177844:ios.description:
LEAVE YOUR PHONE IN THE BAG
Turn your Apple Watch into a powerful golf GPS, scorecard, and automatic shot tracker.
Get distances from your wrist, automatically record shots, keep score, and review your swing and putting performance—all without carrying your phone around the course.
BUILT FOR APPLE WATCH
With Golf GPS++, your Apple Watch becomes your on-course golf companion:
• See GPS distances to greens and hazards
• Automatically detect and record golf swings
• Save the GPS location of each detected shot
• Track club distance and accuracy
• Keep score directly from your wrist
• Automatically advance to the next hole
• Play without carrying your phone
• Sync round data between Apple Watch and iPhone
• Contribute workouts to Apple Health and your Activity rings
• Show maps on your watch (Internet needed for this feature)
UNDERSTAND EVERY SWING
Golf GPS++ does more than measure distance. Built-in motion analysis helps you understand how you swing and putt during an actual round.
Swing analysis can include:
• Swing tempo
• Hand speed
• Swing plane
• Impact angle
Putt analysis can include:
• Tempo
• Take-back angle
• Take-back time
• Follow-through angle
• Follow-through time
TRACK YOUR GAME AUTOMATICALLY
Golf GPS++ uses motion recognition and GPS to detect swings and build a record of your round.
Review useful golf statistics, including:
• Club distances
• Club accuracy
• Fairways hit
• Greens in regulation
• Putts per hole
• Shot locations
• Round history
Prefer a simpler experience? Use Simple Mode to record your total score without tracking every individual shot.
PLAN EVERY HOLE
Explore more than 35,000 golf courses around the world.
• Measure distances to greens and hazards
• Zoom in on detailed satellite imagery
• View holes using 2D or 3D maps
• Preview each hole with a 3D flyover
• Check real-time wind direction
• Download and cache courses before playing
Once a course has been loaded, it remains available offline, so you don’t need a reliable internet connection on the course.
USE IT YOUR WAY
Use Golf GPS++ on your iPhone, your Apple Watch, or both together. Round information syncs between your phone and Watch in real time.
The iPhone experience includes free GPS and course-mapping features. Apple Watch functionality, custom clubs, and certain advanced features require Golf GPS++ Premium.
Monthly, annual, and lifetime purchase options may be available.
RECOGNIZED GOLF TECHNOLOGY
Golf GPS++ was featured in Golf Digest, and our motion-recognition technology has been covered by Google I/O, Mashable, IGN, Golf News, and other publications.
Download Golf GPS++ and discover a simpler, smarter way to play from your wrist.
Privacy Policy:
http://vimo.co/privacy
Terms of Use:
http://vimo.co/termsofuse/
IMPORTANT
Continued use of GPS in the background can significantly reduce battery life. Feature availability may depend on your Apple Watch model, software version, location, and Premium plan.

• Reclaim your first safehouse and restart production.
• Hire Dealers & Lieutenants — every recruit brings unique perks.
• Inspire loyalty or rule by fear: each decision shapes your legend.
Build a Mafia Tycoon Empire
• Labs & Farms — produce illicit goods to bankroll expansion.
• Smuggling Networks — upgrade airstrips, boats, armored trucks.
• Dirty Businesses — casinos, extortion rackets, crypto vaults.

• Crush rival bosses, climb the global cartel wars leaderboard.

Events & Progression
• Weekly challenges unlock new kingpins, vehicles, weapons, skins.
• Develop Gangster Tycoon skills to multiply profits up to ×5.
• Alliance raids—team up for co-op heists or betray partners for extra turf.
Play Your Way
Tap for quick gains, craft long-term strategy, or let profits pile up while you sleep—the path from street hustler to legendary kingpin is yours to create.

bluejetty:00099133:ios.name: Duster - Phone Storage Cleaner
bluejetty:00099133:ios.summary:
Clean Smarter. Store Better.
Is your iPhone running out of space? Struggling with cluttered media, duplicate files, or slow performance?
Duster helps you organize, clean, and manage your photos, videos, contacts, and files efficiently. Bui
bluejetty:00099133:ios.description:
Clean Smarter. Store Better.
Is your iPhone running out of space? Struggling with cluttered media, duplicate files, or slow performance?
Duster helps you organize, clean, and manage your photos, videos, contacts, and files efficiently. Built with advanced AI algorithms, it accurately identifies what you no longer need and guides you through safe removal — all while keeping your data secure and under your control.
Key Features:
AI Photo and Video Organizer
• Free up space by cleaning your photo and video libraries intelligently.
• Detect and remove duplicate or similar photos
• Identify blurry, low-quality, or unwanted images
• Compress videos to reduce file sizes while maintaining resolution
• Trim long videos automatically based on smart suggestions
• Remove sensitive metadata from images before sharing
Contact Management
• Keep your address book accurate and streamlined.
• Detect and merge duplicate contacts
• Eliminate incomplete, empty, or unused entries
Secure Private Vault
• Store your sensitive files in a secure, encrypted location.
• Lock access with Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode
• Hide personal photos, videos, contacts, files and notes
• No data stored in the cloud — 100% on-device privacy
Visual Storage Analytics
• Understand your storage at a glance with powerful visual tools.
• View real-time charts and graphs of file distribution
• Monitor usage across media, documents, system files, and apps
• Receive personalised tips on how to optimize storage space
Recycle Bin and Recovery
• Accidentally deleted something important?
• Restore deleted photos, videos, contacts, and other files
• Items remain recoverable for up to 30 days
• Built-in safeguards ensure you never lose data unintentionally
Why Duster?
• AI-Powered Efficiency: Duster analyses your device content intelligently so you don’t have to scroll through every file.
• Complete Privacy: All operations are performed on-device. Nothing is uploaded or shared without your permission.
• Fast and Simple: Clean up storage, organize files — all in a clean and user-friendly interface.
• No Technical Knowledge Needed: Whether you're a casual user or a power user, Duster works for everyone.
Your iPhone, Reimagined
Duster gives you the tools to take control of your iPhone’s storage without stress.
From cleaning and organising to privacy

bluejetty:00177649:ios.name: Fly Corp: Airline Manager
bluejetty:00177649:ios.summary:
Develop your own transport network in various countries and cities. Open new routes, buy new planes and upgrade them, increase the capacity of the airports. Play Fly Corp and become the richest airline tycoon in the world of airports!
CONN
bluejetty:00177649:ios.description:
Develop your own transport network in various countries and cities. Open new routes, buy new planes and upgrade them, increase the capacity of the airports. Play Fly Corp and become the richest airline tycoon in the world of airports!
CONNECT THE WORLD
In this airline commander game, the whole world is your playing field! Almost 200 countries and thousands of cities all around the globe are available to build airports and expand your airline! Become the founder of the biggest and most profitable airline empire in history! 
DEVELOP AIR TRANSPORT ROUTES
Different locations require good airline management skills as you’ll have to adapt to different conditions. For instance, European distances are short, and it’s very easy to manage the passenger flow here, while popular transatlantic routes will make you think more about travel time and expenses. 
CONTROL THE PASSENGER FLOW
The airport game features an advanced passenger flow system. All the cities are designed according to their real analogs, and the population numbers are true. The more population figures are, the more people would like to fly by your airplanes. Each passenger has their own destination, and they’ll fly with transfers if there are no direct routes. 
UPGRADE AIRPORTS & AIRCRAFTS
Since you don’t have enough money to connect each city to all the other cities, you should analyze the situation and make important decisions about where the transport hub is going to be situated. Planes, as well as airports, have their maximum capacity. You’ll lose profit even if one of them gets overloaded. So, you should learn to run your airline business as fast as you can!
PLAY VARIOUS GAME MODES
The idle tycoon airplane game includes 3 addictive game modes: Unlock All Countries, Scenarios and Free Play!
- In the Unlock All Countries mode, your goal is to open every country in the world and cover the whole game map with your airline network. It’s necessary to unlock a new country every 6 minutes, or you’ll lose.
- Scenarios are various cases with certain pre-set conditions and goals to reach. For example, your airline should survive for some period of time or generate a specific amount of money. Each scenario is unique: for instance, you should quickly connect constantly unlocking airports or rebuild your air transport network due to virus outbreaks in a country.
- If you like idle tycoon games, Free Play is a perfect choice for you! Develop your own airplane network in various countries as long as you can without any limits. Could you become the one & only airplane tycoon in the world of airports?
MEET REGULAR CHALLENGES
Random events won’t let you get bored! Your daily airline management routine will be followed by positive (e.g. investments into your company), negative (disasters blocking flights to some countries or departure), or even ridiculous (a businessman sued you because of spilled coffee in turbulence zone) events. You’ll never know what to expect in this manager game!
COMPETE WITH OTHERS
Conquer the players’ leaderboard! Get additional game points for transporting passengers, complete scenarios, earn money to buy more advanced airport infrastructure. Climb the ladder of success and become the best airline manager!
Are you ready to become a real airline tycoon? Play Fly Corp and develop the biggest air transport network in the world! Download the airline simulator tycoon game now for free! 
Privacy policy: https://aigames.ae/policy

listings.description:
Develop your own transport network in various countries and cities. Open new routes, buy new planes and upgrade them, increase the capacity of the airports. Play Fly Corp and become the richest airline tycoon in the world of airports!

CONNECT THE WORLD

In this airline commander game, the whole world is your playing field! Almost 200 countries and thousands of cities all around the globe are available to build airports and expand your airline! Become the founder of the biggest and most profitable airline empire in history! 

DEVELOP AIR TRANSPORT ROUTES

Different locations require good airline management skills as you’ll have to adapt to different conditions. For instance, European distances are short, and it’s very easy to manage the passenger flow here, while popular transatlantic routes will make you think more about travel time and expenses. 

CONTROL THE PASSENGER FLOW

The airport game features an advanced passenger flow system. All the cities are designed according to their real analogs, and the population numbers are true. The more population figures are, the more people would like to fly by your airplanes. Each passenger has their own destination, and they’ll fly with transfers if there are no direct routes. 

UPGRADE AIRPORTS & AIRCRAFTS

Since you don’t have enough money to connect each city to all the other cities, you should analyze the situation and make important decisions about where the transport hub is going to be situated. Planes, as well as airports, have their maximum capacity. You’ll lose profit even if one of them gets overloaded. So, you should learn to run your airline business as fast as you can!

PLAY VARIOUS GAME MODES

The idle tycoon airplane game includes 3 addictive game modes: Unlock All Countries, Scenarios and Free Play!

- In the Unlock All Countries mode, your goal is to open every country in the world and cover the whole game map with your airline network. It’s necessary to unlock a new country every 6 minutes, or you’ll lose.

- Scenarios are various cases with certain pre-set conditions and goals to reach. For example, your airline should survive for some period of time or generate a specific amount of money. Each scenario is unique: for instance, you should quickly connect constantly unlocking airports or rebuild your air transport network due to virus outbreaks in a country.

- If you like idle tycoon games, Free Play is a perfect choice for you! Develop your own airplane network in various countries as long as you can without any limits. Could you become the one & only airplane tycoon in the world of airports?

MEET REGULAR CHALLENGES

Random events won’t let you get bored! Your daily airline management routine will be followed by positive (e.g. investments into your company), negative (disasters blocking flights to some countries or departure), or even ridiculous (a businessman sued you because of spilled coffee in turbulence zone) events. You’ll never know what to expect in this manager game!

COMPETE WITH OTHERS

Conquer the players’ leaderboard! Get additional game points for transporting passengers, complete scenarios, earn money to buy more advanced airport infrastructure. Climb the ladder of success and become the best airline manager!

Are you ready to become a real airline tycoon? Play Fly Corp and develop the biggest air transport network in the world! Download the airline simulator tycoon game now for free! 

Privacy policy: https://aigames.ae/policy

- Troubleshoot or verify the speed you were promised

- Easily share your results

VARIETY OF INTERESTING GAME EVENTS!
🎣🥕 We will update different game events from time to time, such as Fishing Master, Captain's Fortune, Drift Race, Team Battle, Carrot Fever, etc.
COMPETE WITH WORLDWIDE PLAYERS!
🏆🥇 Join a team, then you can participate in the team battle, communicate with your team members and help each other.

bluejetty:00084767:ios.name: Pregnancy Tracker - Lifeing
bluejetty:00084767:ios.summary:
Lifeing – your trusted companion on the journey to motherhood! Track ovulation, symptoms, and your baby’s development from conception to birth with the #1 pregnancy app, according to Stories.
BABY DEVELOPMENT MONITORING
Lifeing – Pregnancy
bluejetty:00084767:ios.description:
Lifeing – your trusted companion on the journey to motherhood! Track ovulation, symptoms, and your baby’s development from conception to birth with the #1 pregnancy app, according to Stories.
BABY DEVELOPMENT MONITORING
Lifeing – Pregnancy Tracker automatically calculates your estimated due date and builds a clear, week-by-week calendar of your baby’s growth. See your little one’s size and weight, plus beautiful illustrations of key fetal development milestones. Get helpful tips on taking care of yourself and your growing baby.
EASY-TO-USE TRACKERS
— Symptom Tracker: Log fatigue, nausea, Braxton Hicks contractions, and other sensations.
— Kick Counter: Monitor your baby’s movements.
— Contraction Timer: Track timing and distinguish between practice contractions and real ones.
PLAN AND STAY ON TOP OF EVERYTHING
No need to keep everything in your head—create reminders for doctor visits, ultrasounds, and lab tests. Use built-in checklists to prepare for delivery. They include essentials like packing your hospital bag, shopping for baby items, and getting your home ready.
PREGNANCY JOURNAL
Capture every special moment of your pregnancy—add photos, record baby’s first kicks, jot down your thoughts, and share personal notes with loved ones. All entries are stored in chronological order, so you can easily revisit your memories anytime. 
USEFUL TIPS & GUIDANCE
— Nutrition, fitness, and prenatal care advice.
— Guided Kegel exercises, breathing techniques, and healthy lifestyle tips.
— Expert articles on women’s health, pregnancy, and newborn care.
FERTILITY TRACKER
Trying to conceive? Use the built-in ovulation and menstrual cycle tracker to identify your most fertile days and understand hormonal changes.
Lifeing is here to help you feel confident through every stage of pregnancy. Enjoy the journey with Lifeing – Pregnancy Tracker!
PLEASE NOTE
Lifeing is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Use it to stay informed and organized, but always consult your doctor with any concerns.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

EVEN BETTER TOGETHER
Sign in with Aeroplan to unlock access to loyalty program benefits. Che
bluejetty:00068187:ios.description:
With the Air Canada + Aeroplan app, seamlessly book flights, manage travel and get the most of your Aeroplan loyalty benefits — all in one place.
EVEN BETTER TOGETHER
Sign in with Aeroplan to unlock access to loyalty program benefits. Check your points balance, track Elite status progress, view recent transactions, and access popular features like the Aeroplan eStore, car rentals, and hotel bookings — all from the app.
BOOK YOUR WAY
Book your next trip using cash, redeem Aeroplan points, or use a combination of Points + Cash. You can even cover taxes, fees, and charges entirely with points for a seamless booking experience.
REAL-TIME UPDATES WITH LIVE ACTIVITIES
Stay informed throughout your trip with real-time updates, now available on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Whether it's boarding, gate changes, or flight status updates - get details at a glance without opening the app.
BAG TRACKING
Track your checked bags from drop-off to carousel. Real-time notifications keep you informed at every step, letting you know if you need to collect your bag at a connecting airport or when your bag is ready at the carousel after arrival.
JOURNEY
Effortlessly navigate your day of travel with the Journey, which offers step-by-step guidance with personalized details tailored to your booking, including pre-travel tips, airport arrival and bag drop information, important connection and layover details, and more.
DYNAMIC BOARDING PASS

Piggy Goals: Money Saving is an app designed to motivate you and help you save money, by either having a piggy bank where you can save cash any time you want, or create daily, weekly, or monthly goals. The app will track your progress and remind you with push notifications about your money saving objectives, and the coolest feature is that the app is completely FREE!
The app includes two different modes that will help you save some cash:
1. Piggy Bank Mode: Deposit or withdraw money from your piggy bank any time you’d like and keep a history of all your transactions.
2. Piggy Goal Mode: Planning on buying something? Create a goal and set the amount you want to raise with the time frame you decide: daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly. Then just let our app track and help you reach your target budget.
Full Feature List:
• Visualize your progress with graphs and animations
• Notifications and reminders are included so you never forget to save up money
• Create as many goals as you need
• The app is multi-language
• No internet connection is required to use the app, and it’s designed to work for every device with any software version
• We made it so fast and simple to use that you’ll be able to start saving money in a matter of seconds!
• We will constantly update our App to support a wider range of features
Download Now! Piggy Goals: Money Savings App for FREE in App Store!

bluejetty:00071463:ios.name: Tacx Training™
bluejetty:00071463:ios.summary:
RIDE INDOORS, FEEL OUTDOORS
Connect your Tacx™ smart trainer with the Tacx Training app to turn indoor sessions into immersive rides. Tackle steep Alpine and Pyrenean climbs or conquer the cobblestones of Roubaix right from your living room
bluejetty:00071463:ios.description:
RIDE INDOORS, FEEL OUTDOORS
Connect your Tacx™ smart trainer with the Tacx Training app to turn indoor sessions into immersive rides. Tackle steep Alpine and Pyrenean climbs or conquer the cobblestones of Roubaix right from your living room. New routes around the world are added every month.
TRAIN WITH REAL DATA, IN REAL TIME
When paired with a compatible Tacx smart trainer and other accessories, you can see speed, power, cadence, and heart rate data on screen while your trainer resistance auto-adjusts for realistic climbs and descents. Connect with a Tacx Alpine gradient simulator for an even more immersive climbing and descending experience.
INTEGRATE WITH OTHER GARMIN PRODUCTS
When you finish a workout in the app, the data automatically uploads to the Garmin Connect™ app to update performance stats, inform training plan workout recommendations, and more. Your Garmin Connect workouts are automatically synced with the Tacx Training app.
MOTIVATION THAT LASTS
Earn badges by completing challenges, ride with others in real time, or organize virtual GroupRides with your Tacx friends.
Download and use the app for free, or upgrade to premium at any time.
Free:
• Create and perform workouts based on slope, power, or FTP
• View and complete your scheduled workouts from Garmin Connect and Garmin Coach
• Your rides and workouts automatically sync to Garmin Connect for analysis
• View your data across phone, tablet, and desktop
Premium:
• Gain access to more than 500 high-quality video routes
• Download your favorite videos and ride offline
• See other live riders and ride with others in real time
• Participate in multi-stage challenges
• Plan virtual GroupRides with friends
Requirements:
• Bluetooth 4.0 or later for Tacx Smart trainer connections
• Internet is required for video streaming and live features
Don’t forget to contact our support team if you have any questions, concerns, or feature requests.
Official Garmin app.

bluejetty:00185516:ios.description:
Flow Free® is a simple yet addictive puzzle game.
Connect matching colors with pipe to create a Flow®. Pair all colors, and cover the entire board to solve each puzzle. But watch out, pipes will break if they cross or overlap!
Free play through hundreds of levels, or race against the clock in Time Trial mode. Gameplay ranges from simple and relaxed, to challenging and frenetic, and everywhere in between. How you play is up to you. So, give Flow Free a try, and experience "mind like water"!
*** Flow Free features ***
* Content
- Over 2,500 free levels available in Free Play mode, and new Daily Puzzles every day!
- 10 different board sizes
- Free Classic, Bonus, Bridges, Mania, Extreme, and Jumbo level packs
- Additional level packs available for purchase
* Challenge
- Game Center achievements as you solve levels and complete packs
- Track your completion of each level in Free Play mode
- Strive for accuracy in Free Play using the fewest, most efficient moves
- Strive for speed in Time Trial for the most and fastest solves
- 20 scored Time Trial variants to choose from by board size and duration
* Look & Feel
- Smooth, polished touch interaction
- Colorful UI
- Fun sound effects
- Clean vector graphics and animations
- Labels available for color impaired players
Enjoy.

bluejetty:00043344:ios.description:
Sky Words is a calming word game for adults and seniors designed for a peaceful journey through the world of crossword puzzles. Step away from daily stress and immerse yourself in meditative word puzzle games. It's a perfect way to unwind while keeping your mind sharp.
Your goal is simple: find words from a set of letters. It starts as a relaxing experience, but the puzzles offer plenty of surprises as you progress. Are you ready for a rewarding mental workout?
This game is specially crafted for those who enjoy high-quality brain training and a tranquil atmosphere. It's an ideal word game for seniors who want to maintain cognitive health through a stress-free interface.
SPECIAL FEATURES
- Improve your vocabulary and memory by playing just 10 minutes a day.
- The difficulty increases with every new puzzle, ensuring your brain stays active.
- This is an immersive experience with a clean, easy-to-read design.
- Travel across different backgrounds and admire beautiful landscapes.
- Enjoy 5000+ offline crossword levels you can play anytime.
- It serves as an effective tool for daily brain training and language skills.
- Every anagram you solve brings you closer to new rewards and achievements.
- Explore a fascinating world as you progress through each level.
WHY CHOOSE SKY WORDS?
- It is both educational and relaxing – play scramble games to quiet your mind.
- Discover colorful locations filled with hundreds of exciting crossword levels.
- Sharpen your verbal skills while playing elegant word puzzles.
- Earn extra coins and special hints through daily bonuses.
- Enjoy word games offline without the need for an internet connection.
Sky Words is an engaging word game that brings positive energy and cognitive benefits to your daily routine.
Whether you are traveling, resting at home, or looking for a way to expand your vocabulary – this game is made for you. Love solving crossword puzzles and anagram games for adults? You will find exactly what you need here.
Play offline, enjoy every crossword, and feel a true sense of achievement. Each level you conquer brings a little spark of joy. Whether you are a lifelong puzzle enthusiast or a beginner – there is a world of fun waiting for everyone.
Start your journey today and see how both calming and challenging a word game can be!

I welcome you to Fit Brutal: an APP whose main mission is to transform your mindset and your body in the same place.

Training challenges: Unlimited access to all our fitness challenges, which are routines accompanied by me from the beginning to the end, you can do it from home or the gym

Let's gooo

Your people. Your videos.
Scoopz is the short-video app where your feed is built from communities you choose — so every video feels like it belongs.
Join Circles (video communities) around your passions, your place, and real life.
Whether it’s authentic moments or content about what you care most about, Scoopz keeps your feed relevant and meaningful.
Why Scoopz feels different:
- Communities, not chaos: Follow Circles to keep your feed focused on what you love.
- Real stories matter: Authentic, everyday moments are still our most celebrated videos.
- The right audience: Post directly into your Circle so the right people see it first.
- Easy creation: No studio, no script — just open your phone and share.
What you can do in Scoopz:
- Capture life as it happens — moments big or small.
- Join or start Circles for passions, local stories, or niche topics.
- Find your audience and grow without chasing random trends.
- Discover new communities and fresh voices beyond your feed.
A community built on what’s real
On Scoopz, you won’t be lost in a sea of irrelevant trends. You’ll be part of the conversations and moments that matter most to you. Your feed is yours — and your voice has a place here.
Start now. Find your people, share your story, and see the difference.
Official Website: https://thescoopz.com/

Wormie is an educational word game where children encounter new letters, words and their pronunciation. Wormie will cheer you along with expressions, sensations and sounds.
This game is entertaining for the whole family!
Wormie Word Searc
bluejetty:00044171:ios.description:
Wormie is an educational word game where children encounter new letters, words and their pronunciation. Wormie will cheer you along with expressions, sensations and sounds.
This game is entertaining for the whole family!
Wormie Word Search is developed for children of early school age, in collaboration with a teacher with years of experience in Norwegian primary schools. The pedagogue has expertise in didactics and specialization in Norwegian and English.
The aim of this game is to help strengthen the children’s ability to decode and search for words. Word searching is an important skill in the development of becoming an efficient reader. The graphics in Wormie Word Search are colorful and simple, with the purpose of a user-friendly and appealing in-game experience. The aim of the charismatic animations is to engage and motivate children in their search for new words. Every time a word is discovered, it is read out loud. This is to help strengthen the phonological and orthographic awareness.

bluejetty:00040410:ios.name: AtomicClock: NTP Time
bluejetty:00040410:ios.summary:
Check precise NTP reference time at a glance. AtomicClock helps you set watches, wall clocks, cameras, and other devices, compare local time with UTC, and follow moments when every second matters.
Clear analog and digital time
AtomicClock
bluejetty:00040410:ios.description:
Check precise NTP reference time at a glance. AtomicClock helps you set watches, wall clocks, cameras, and other devices, compare local time with UTC, and follow moments when every second matters.
Clear analog and digital time
AtomicClock displays current time from NTP servers that reference atomic clocks. Choose a predefined server or add your own, then view local or UTC time in a clean analog or digital clock.
Customize your reference clock
• Switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time
• Customize the time format
• Choose from multiple clock faces and hands
• Use a smooth, fluid second hand
• Add acoustic ticking or the Greenwich Time Signal
• Tap the screen to hide information and controls, freeze the display, or mute ticking
Details for precise time checks
View technical NTP information, including round-trip time and server stratum. Whether you are checking a timestamp, preparing a camera, aligning a wall clock, or setting a watch by hand, the seconds remain clear and easy to follow.
AtomicClock is free to use. AtomicClock Pro is available as a one-time purchase with no subscription. It unlocks your preferred clock face, hands, and font, removes ads, and includes upcoming Pro features.
AtomicClock displays NTP reference time for comparison and does not change your device’s system time. Results can vary with the selected server, network conditions, and device behavior.

bluejetty:00144196:ios.description:
eAlert (єТривога) is a volunteer-based application that sends push notifications to your phone about threats in your chosen area or city in Ukraine. You will receive an audible siren alert from the app when an air raid, missile strike threat, or artillery shelling is declared in your city or region. The app also notifies about explosions and planned explosive works, as well as other critically important information.
The project operates around the clock thanks to the support of over 30 volunteers who work on a voluntary basis. We closely monitor hundreds of information sources to ensure prompt and accurate notifications. All alerts are sent manually.
eAlert (єТривога) was developed by Ukrainian IT volunteers in Poland and is not affiliated with any Ukrainian government institutions, including the Ministry of Digital Transformation or the "Diia" platform.
For the latest news and updates, follow us on social media Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram — @eTryvoga, and on Telegram — https://t.me/UkraineAlarmSignal.

bluejetty:00018765:ios.name: Real Plans - Meal Planner
bluejetty:00018765:ios.summary:
Real Plans is a meal planning app that helps you and your family consistently enjoy healthy, home-cooked food.
Our award-winning meal planner is brimming with delicious recipes and is easily personalized for your unique tastes and lifestyl
bluejetty:00018765:ios.description:
Real Plans is a meal planning app that helps you and your family consistently enjoy healthy, home-cooked food.
Our award-winning meal planner is brimming with delicious recipes and is easily personalized for your unique tastes and lifestyle. We make it super simple to create a plan in minutes and shop efficiently (in the grocery store or order from home).
Whether your goals are to rock a Whole30, lose weight with low carb, stick with a special gut-healing diet, navigate food restrictions, feed picky eaters, or just eat better overall, Real Plans sets you up for success.
REAL PLANS APP FEATURES YOU’RE GOING TO LOVE:
OVER 2000 DELICIOUS RECIPES
Let us inspire you with dishes that are easy-to-cook favorites, tested by our own families.
FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE TO HOW YOU WANT TO EAT
No matter your diet or lifestyle, we have simple but powerful filters (down to the ingredient) so you don’t waste your time sifting through recipes that aren’t right for you. You can choose all your own meals or have us do it for you. You can adjust portion size for leftovers, guests, or family size too.
SUPER FAST SHOPPING LIST & EASY GROCERY DELIVERY
When you build a new meal plan, a grocery list of all the ingredients you’ll need for the week is automatically created, and you can add extra things (like snacks or paper towels too!). Then simply grab your iPhone, check off what you already have, and efficiently zoom through the store - OR order your ingredients online via Amazon or Instacart and have your groceries appear at your door.
FULL NUTRITIONAL INFO FOR EVERY RECIPE
Got food goals? Every Real Plans recipe lists comprehensive nutritional information based on the USDA database so you can easily see what you’re eating whether you’re counting macros, calories, or just curious about what’s in your meal.
SAVE MONEY WITH MINIMAL FOOD WASTE
We’ve all been there. Brought home a bunch of beautiful produce with grand aspirations, only to open the fridge a week later to spoiled fruit and wilted veggies.
With Real Plans, you can say goodbye to excess wasted food. Our planner helps you plan and shop for only what you need to whip up delicious meals. You eat better and reduce wasted food, all the while saving you hundreds of dollars per year.
For terms of use, visit https://realplans.com/terms-of-use/
For privacy policy, visit https://realplans.com/privacy-policy/

At its core, "Cube Master 3D" is a
bluejetty:00181115:ios.description:
“Cube Master 3D” is a stylish matching puzzle game. You can swipe to rotate the cube match identical tiles to clear levels and use power props to help you clear all tiles even more quickly, MEGA victory!
At its core, "Cube Master 3D" is a masterful sort puzzle and a match-3 game that challenges players to sort and clear tiles by matching 3 identical pieces. Unlike conventional titles in this category, it introduces a mesmerizing 3D cube sort, adding layers of complexity and intrigue that compel players to think spatially as they rotate the cube to find matches and sort them all effectively.It stands as a remarkable testament to the evolution of classic match-3 games, enhancing the traditional experience with a unique 3D twist that breathes life into the genre.
Gameplay :
▶ Swipe to rotate the 3D cube.
▶ Choose 3 same 3D tiles.
▶ DON'T fill up the collection bar.
▶ Clear all tiles within a limited time.
▶ Mega victory!
WHY CHOOSE US :
▶ Find and pair matching tiles. Addictive and sometimes needs a strategy.
▶ Full angle rotation with the cube.
▶ Hundreds of 3D tiles and shapes. such as cake, Toys, Fruits 
▶ More stars? Win champion rewards.
▶ Train Brain and finger by matching 3 tiles.
▶ More fun matching levels waiting for your challenge.
▶ Ranking championship, team battle, Are you ready to play? 
The beauty of this sorting game lies in its ability to seamlessly merge the familiarity of cube matching gameplay with the innovative concept of cube sort. Players are invited to embark on a journey through various levels, with each staging a distinct challenge requiring them to strategize and organize games of triple matches. This triple matching dynamic enriches the gameplay, demanding not just quick thinking but also a meticulous approach to organizing games and uncovering the perfect triple cubes.
As a match puzzle game, "Cube Master 3D" excels in delivering a casual matching experience that's both engaging and soothing. It's one of those rare matching games for adults that manage to offer a therapeutic escape while simultaneously stimulating the brain with puzzles that range from straightforward to devilishly intricate.
Despite its sophisticated 3D gameplay, "Cube Master 3D" remains an accessible master game that players of all skill levels can enjoy. Whether you're a seasoned fan of match 3 games seeking a fresh challenge or a newcomer eager to dip your toes into the world of casual matching and sorting games, this title is poised to become your next addiction.
The game not only stands as a tiles matching masterpiece but also as a beacon in the genre of organizing games. It transcends the traditional boundaries of match 3, cube sort, and puzzle games, offering a holistic and immersive experience that's both relaxing and mentally stimulating. As players progress, they collect games of triple match combinations, an endeavor that's as satisfying as it is challenging.
In essence, "Cube Master 3D" epitomizes the best of match games, puzzle games, and 3D games, all rolled into one. Its perfect blend of classic match, sorting games, and tile puzzles make it an indispensable addition to the library of any puzzle enthusiast. With every level, players find themselves more deeply engrossed in the game's triple match, sorting, and matching world, proving "Cube Master 3D" to be a true master 3d, both in name and gameplay. This game isn't just about sorting and matching; it's about embarking on an unforgettable adventure into the depths of fun, puzzles, and organization games—a journey where every sort, match, and tile brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Cube Master.
Don't be hesitated! Try the free triple matching puzzle -- "Cube Master 3D" now! Match cubes quickly before the time runs out!

bluejetty:00022581:ios.description:
Want to build stronger bones and improve your posture?
Want to make exercise a habit and get a healthy lifestyle? 
This app can help you! 
First, you need to know what are important factors affecting height and health.
1. Gene. 60% of height is determined by genes inherited from parents; however, you can reach your maximum potential height with external factors.
2. Nutrition. A proper diet provides the nutrients needed for bone growth. 
3. Exercise. Exercise stimulates the nerve ends which are directly associated with the pituitary gland to increase the production of growth hormones. Regular exercise also helps improve your health.
4. Sleep. Adequate sleep promotes the secretion of growth hormones. 
With effective exercises, diet plans and height tips, this science-based app can increase your metabolism and help you build stronger bones at home. 
For Everyone
- Male & Female 
- Teens & Adults 
- Before 18 years old & After 18 years old 
Professional Training Plans
- All workouts are designed by professionals 
- Easy-to-understand animation and video guidance 
- Effective stretching exercise, yoga, aerobic exercise, etc 
- 8-14 minutes a day at home to help you get a better body shape 
Science-based Diet Plan 
- Different food suggestions every day, which are rich in essential nutrients for growth.
• Calcium. It contributes to bone growth.
• Protein. It helps grow muscles.
• Vitamins. It helps with the absorption of calcium.
Sleep Tracker 
- Set target sleep duration to get enough sleep 
- Record your daily sleep time
- Track your sleep in graph 
Features
- For all ages, kids and adults, men and women
- Science-based nutrition suggestion
- Exercises designed by professionals
- Height tips on dressing, posture, food, exercise, etc.
- Easy-to-understand animation and video guidance
- Effective stretching exercise, yoga, aerobic exercise, etc 
- Sleep tracker
- Customize your own workout plan
- Easily start workouts at home or anywhere, anytime
- Set a daily reminder to motivate you to exercise
- Help you make exercise a habit
- Sync data to Apple health
