bluejetty:00032180:ios.name: NetSpot WiFi Analyzer
bluejetty:00032180:ios.summary: NetSpot 3 delivers powerful WiFi site surveys with internet speed, ping tests and device discovery to iPhone and iPad users. Build realistic WiFi heatmaps right on your iPhone or iPad in minutes, without additional expensive hardware! Analy
bluejetty:00032180:ios.description:
NetSpot 3 delivers powerful WiFi site surveys with internet speed, ping tests and device discovery to iPhone and iPad users. Build realistic WiFi heatmaps right on your iPhone or iPad in minutes, without additional expensive hardware! Analyze and troubleshoot your wireless networks with color-coded interactive heatmaps, very simple to create and interpret.
NetSpot, famous for its versatile network tools with millions of business and home users across all platforms, is the only WiFi scanner app with heatmap visualizations on the App Store. Effortlessly manage your Wi-Fi survey projects by organizing them into multiple zones and snapshots for each surveyed area. Flexible configuration settings let you customize the look and feel of your WiFi map and choose the desired gradient to properly highlight areas with high WiFi speed and stable connection, as well as the areas with low WiFi signal that may need improvements.
NetSpot’s WiFi speedtest is a great one-tap solution to verify and track performance of your wireless setups over time.
NetSpot also offers Ping Tests. A ping test is a great way to check network connectivity for any underlying network issues and measure the latency. High latency may indicate slow or laggy internet, which affects gaming or video calls quality.
NetSpot offers a handy Device Discovery mode, which basically turns the app into a network scanner collecting information on all devices connected to your network. It depends on devices, which information can be collected, but in general you can see such data as MAC address, IP address, device names, software and firmware versions, a class of device (e.g. smartphone, smart device or a laptop.), etc.
The free version of NetSpot for iOS lets you use Device Discovery mode, as well as test the ping and Internet speed. WiFi Survey mode with heatmaps is available in NetSpot Plus - a one-time in-app purchase.
USE NETSPOT AS...
* WiFi analyzer - diagnose your wireless network connection speed and latency
* WiFi scanner - collect and visualize your WiFi data
* Speed tester - check your internet, WiFi or mobile download and upload speed, record historical results
* WiFi mapper - conduct active WiFi site surveys for connected networks
* Ping tester - verify your WiFi or mobile connection latency to major or custom websites
* Network scanner – find and collect information about devices currently connected to your wireless network
* WiFi troubleshooting app
NetSpot WiFi heat mapper is fast, accurate and extremely simple. It helps you see the true coverage of your WiFi like never before, regardless of your mesh or no-mesh configuration, security settings, interfering networks or other factors. Every time you use NetSpot internet speed meter for WiFi site surveys, it delivers reliable interactive heatmaps that are easy to analyze.
NETSPOT IS INCREDIBLY HELPFUL FOR...
* WiFi network setup verification
* WiFi signal, speed and ping test
* Creating WiFi heat map to detect areas of weak signal (part of NetSpot Plus)
* Find out who is on your Wi-Fi
* Extending WiFi coverage and more

bluejetty:00156203:ios.description:
The official app to control, customize, and personalize Sactionals StealthTech Sound + Charge.
StealthTech Sound + Charge is comprised of premium surround sound audio by Harman Kardon and integrated wireless charging, all completely hidden from view inside Lovesac products. The unique proximity and placement of the speakers and subwoofer, combined with the patented technology of sound frequency traveling through the fabric, delivers an unparalleled, immersive audio experience.
Optimize Based on Configuration Shape.
Patented, enhanced tuning technology adjusts and calibrates the sound properties to the layout of your Sactionals setup, providing immersive surround sound from every seat.
Tune to Your Specific Sactionals Covers.
This patented technology adjusts audio frequencies based on the precise characteristics, density, and color of your specific Sactionals Covers for the superior sound quality and immaculate clarity only the Sound + Charge System with sound by Harman Kardon can provide.
Adjust Sound Properties.
Use the app interface to control bass, treble, volume, and speaker balance via smartphone or tablet.
Select, Create, and Save Tuning Presets.
Choose from Harman Kardon defined tuning presets to pair with Movie, Music, TV, or News. Plus, adjust sound properties on your own to create and save custom presets.
Enable/Disable Quiet Couch Mode.
Use this mode to limit the sound and bass coming from your couch, for those moments that don’t call for immersive surround sound.

bluejetty:00042332:ios.summary: Discover the world of cycling Trails with Bike Tracker, the ultimate app designed to bring your mountain biking experience to life. Are you ready to immerse yourself in over 150,000 meticulously cataloged mountain bike trails across the vas
bluejetty:00042332:ios.description:
Discover the world of cycling Trails with Bike Tracker, the ultimate app designed to bring your mountain biking experience to life. Are you ready to immerse yourself in over 150,000 meticulously cataloged mountain bike trails across the vast expanse of the USA? Brace yourself for a journey that spans an astonishing 170,000 miles in total length.
Delve into the heart of your cycling adventure with our intricately detailed 3D maps, which reveal the contours of the terrain and elevations that await you on each trail. Need to prepare for what's ahead? Get a sneak peek of trail statistics before you even set out, so you can tackle the challenge with confidence and vigor.

bluejetty:00120994:ios.description:
Bring some color into your life with this rainbow birthday cake cooking game. Cook your rainbow cake by mixing the ingredients, adding the food coloring, cooking your cakes in the oven along with decorating them with yummy sweets. So much color to be found upon eating, why not surprise your guests at your next birthday party and bake a rainbow birthday cake! 
Candy cake anyone? We all love cake, but we don't like the mess that it makes, why not get all the fun of making the cake with out having to clean afterward. In Candy Cake Maker you'll first have to make the dough, by adding all the ingredients in the right order like in a real recipe. Drag and drop all of them on the pot to cook. Remember to keep stirring that mixture, you don't want your dough to burn. Next you'll need to pour it into a cake pan 
To create the undercover first mix dark and white chocolate in a bowl, put it in the microwave and melt it so that it'll go sweet and lush over your cake. Candy Cake Maker lets you decorate the cake by adding the dark and white chocolate undercover with a vanilla butter and milk icing on top! Now you are ready to invite all your friends, wait... you'll have to set up balloons for your party! 
Let's eat! We don't even have to fight over who gets to do the dishes!
Features
Mix your ingredients and separate it into a different pans. 
Add different colors to your cakes and place them in the oven for cooking. 
Layer your colored cakes on top of each other and cover with yummy icing. 
Decorate it with pretty butterflies and spots that really make it stand out. 
Cut into your cake and see the lovely rainbow colors before eating it all up.

bluejetty:00137631:ios.name: HuntFishNY
bluejetty:00137631:ios.summary: HuntFishNY is the official New York State Department of Environmental Conservation mobile app that provides our sportsmen/women a simple way to display their licenses and privileges and view important hunting and fishing related information
bluejetty:00137631:ios.description:
HuntFishNY is the official New York State Department of Environmental Conservation mobile app that provides our sportsmen/women a simple way to display their licenses and privileges and view important hunting and fishing related information. In addition to the many resources DEC's website offers for hunters, trappers and anglers across the state, our HuntFishNY mobile app offers instant mobile access to electronic versions of your sporting licenses, privileges and permits; the ease of reporting your game harvests immediately; and links to useful information like season date summaries, fishing information, a DEC Contact list, and much more.  It also includes a feature called the Tackle Box that provides anglers with one stop shopping for waterbody-specific information on fishing regulations, stocking, and fishing/boating access sites.  Tackle Box is part of DEC’s continued efforts to make fishing easier, more enjoyable and more accessible to all!  
HuntFishNY features include:
 • Instant, mobile access to a customer's sporting license, privileges and permits
 • Quick and easy submission of Game Harvest Reports
 • Smart filtering for collecting town, county and WMU of harvest data, as well as season and method of take info
 • Ability to view current and past harvest reports 
 • Links to current year Hunting & Trapping and Freshwater Fishing Regulations Guides
 • Sunrise/Sunset Information
 • Ability to search waterbodies by name or zooming/panning a NYS map
 • Waterbody-specific fishing regulations
 • Fish species and stocking information 
 • Fishing access information, including boat launches and parking areas
 • Navigation feature for driving directions to fishing access sites

bluejetty:00091677:ios.description:
Enhance, restore, upscale, and transform your photos with Pictura, an AI photo editor.
Pictura helps you turn blurry selfies, old family pictures, low-resolution images, anime art, and social media photos into sharper, cleaner, high-quality results in just a few taps. Choose a photo from your library or camera, apply a powerful AI tool or creative filter, then save or share the finished image directly from your iPhone.
AI Photo Tools
- Enhance blurry photos and improve image clarity
- Restore old or damaged-looking pictures
- Colorize black-and-white photos
- Upscale images up to 4x
- Remove backgrounds from photos
- Reduce noise and grain
- Apply creative AI portrait filters and styles
- Save, share, and manage your edited photos in your history
Perfect For
- Fixing blurry selfies and portraits
- Restoring vintage family photos
- Colorizing old black-and-white memories
- Upscaling anime, artwork, and low-resolution images
- Creating profile pictures and social media content
- Removing photo backgrounds for clean edits
- Making photos sharper, clearer, and more polished
Why Pictura?
Pictura combines multiple AI photo enhancement tools in one simple iOS app. Whether you want a quick one-tap improvement or a creative AI transformation, Pictura makes it easy to edit, enhance, save, and share beautiful images from your iPhone.
Unlock Pictura Pro for unlimited enhancements, all AI filters, advanced tools, priority processing, and exclusive features.

- Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store Account Settings
- Availability and pricing may vary by region
Support: jonathan.benavides@suyai.ch

There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------

----------------------------

Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.


Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.


Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!


Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.


Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.


Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

bluejetty:00095507:ios.description:
Cindy’s life turns upside down when she discovers her father is alive and her stepmother is a wicked sorceress! In the free-to-play version of "Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty", dive into a magical world of hidden object games, where you’ll seek and find hidden objects, solve puzzles, and uncover family secrets. This tale of love and courage blends thrilling adventure games and emotional storytelling. Explore beautiful scenes, collect magical artifacts, and enjoy our enchanting look and find games!
Cindy is a young orphan who lives with a stepmother and stepsister, mourning her late father. She is almost used to her low status in the house, but things change with one overheard talk. Cindy discovers that her father is actually alive, and it’s her stepmom Rachel who merely hides him. Now is Cindy’s chance to save her dad by sneaking into the Town Hall to pick up one important letter. And how fortunate that there's a ball tonight! Meanwhile, the Mayor's son, Albert, is furious about his father not attending the ball he has arranged himself. But he has no idea that once he goes down to the party, he will meet her. The one and only…
Help two lovebirds to meet and overcome all obstacles:
· Magical Puzzles & Hidden Mysteries!
Experience immersive storytelling while solving captivating puzzles designed for fans of hidden object games and look and find games. There’s always something exciting to seek and find hidden objects in every chapter!
· Thrilling Hidden Object Games!
Embark on an object hunt that challenges you to find hidden objects crucial to advancing the love story. Our hidden object games are designed to integrate seamlessly with the romantic games plot, adding excitement!
· Explore a Rich, Magical World!
Step into beautifully crafted scenes filled with enchanted items, secret doors, and mind-bending challenges — ideal for those who adore hidden object games, adventure games, and seek and find hidden objects missions!
· Collect, Brew, and Discover!
Gather ancient artifacts, brew powerful potions, and unlock family secrets. For lovers of seek and find hidden objects, look and find games, and mystical adventure games, this journey offers hours of magical gameplay!
Start your free journey today in "Connected Hearts: Cost of Beauty" — the ultimate blend of romance and mystery!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00015125:ios.description:
Built for medical students, teaching professionals and practicing clinicians, Complete Anatomy is the most advanced 3D anatomy platform available on the market. Take your anatomy learning to the next level exploring thousands of interactive anatomical structures in full 3D. Study with guided courses and prepare for exams with tools no other anatomy app offers. 
WHY CHOOSE COMPLETE ANATOMY?
The app offers the most detailed 3D gross anatomy models available anywhere using diverse female and male models built to the highest medical standards. Unlike basic atlas apps with limited structures or flashcard-only platforms, Complete Anatomy offers an entire learning ecosystem of 3D models, dissection videos, radiology, courses and clinical content all in one place. 
DOWNLOAD and start your FREE 3-DAY TRIAL today!
EXPERIENCE UNIQUE AND INTERACTIVE FEATURES:
· Unique customizable 3D models: Full gross anatomical models you can rotate, zoom into, isolate or dissect layer by layer
· 12 body systems with cross sections, real-time muscle motion plus nerve tracing, blood supply, insertion and origin
· Trace the path and ramifications of structures like nerves and blood vessels using the Branches tool
· View the bone landmarks of the skeletal system using the parts, surfaces, and landmarks tools
· Cut through models with ease to explore relationships between structures and even simulate surgical procedures
· Access 20+ microscopic anatomy models, 150+ hours of interactive lectures and 1,500+ clinical videos across cardiology, orthopaedics, ophthalmology, fitness and dentistry
LEARN ANATOMY YOUR WAY
1. Guided courses - complete courses including Dissection, Human Anatomy, Female Anatomy with Alice Roberts, Point of Care Ultrasound and Clinical Correlates - all based on Elsevier's anatomy textbooks.
2. Virtual dissection - Gray's Anatomy-powered guided dissections combining 3D models with videos that provide a systematic approach to each anatomical region
3. Interactive radiology - explore radiographs, CTs, and MRIs from a library of 100+ interconnected images
4. Augmented Reality - place anatomy models in your real environment with AR mode 
GRAY’S ANATOMY CONTENT
By offering 700+ Gray’s-inspired, interactive 3D models, dissection courses plus 1,000+ illustrations, Complete Anatomy becomes a comprehensive digital tool for studying structural anatomy. It connects clinical images, surface anatomy and detailed 3D structures, offering a robust platform designed for students and professionals to explore the human anatomy.
STUDY TOOLS DESIGNED FOR EXAMS:
Access 700+ preset atlas screens based on illustrations from Elsevier's foremost anatomy textbooks, curated to align with anatomy curricula. 
Available in English, French, German, Spanish and Chinese
STUDENT LICENSE: Full access to 3D models, all courses, 1,500+ videos and curated learning materials across all platforms. 
PRO LICENSE: Adds clinical practice and classroom, lab or lecture theatre teaching permissions.
DOWNLOAD and start your FREE 3-DAY TRIAL today!
Subscriptions are charged annually & automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before end of the current period. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your iTunes Account will be charged the current annual subscription cost each year for renewal within 24-hours prior to end of current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings any time after purchase. Any free trial will be interrupted when a paid subscription is purchased.

Privacy policy: https://3d4medical.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00126424:ios.description:
The Fiesta Rewards app is becoming Fiesta Americana Travelty. In the App, you can quickly and easily learn about the benefits to which you have access before, during, and after your travels. Everything is at your fingertips! We want to be closer to you so that you can make reservations at any time, check your upcoming stays from wherever you are, complete your pre-check-in and check-out, request room service, and more.
We want to get to know you and recognize you with exclusive experiences because we value your loyalty and enjoy surprising you with details that will make your stays unique and special, just as you are to us.
If you are already a Fiesta Rewards member, with the Fiesta Americana Travelty app, you can access your profile, check your points balance, see the privileges you can access, and review any certificates pending for use.
Discover why Fiesta Rewards gives traveling for pleasure or business a new meaning. If you stay at any of our participating hotels within Fiesta Americana Travelty, including Live Aqua, Grand Fiesta Americana, Curamoria, Fiesta Americana, The Explorean, IOH, Fiesta Inn, Gamma, and one, we recognize and appreciate your preference through point accumulation, book with preferential rates through the app, receive our personalized service at all times, and gain access to exclusive events. Discover more by downloading the Fiesta Americana Travelty app and enjoy an unparalleled experience. We have hotels to suit all tastes and styles; let us pamper you with personalized details and strategic locations that make each visit incomparable.
The Fiesta Americana Travelty app will accompany you beyond each trip. Discover over 190 hotels available in Mexico and the Caribbean, choose your favorite, and make your reservation directly from the app.
If you have any questions about the operation of the Fiesta Rewards program or the app, you can contact us through the Fiesta Rewards hotline (*8585).

bluejetty:00029282:ios.name: Easy Read Book - Brave Bundee
bluejetty:00029282:ios.summary: Welcome to "Brave Bundee," a delightful story app designed for preschool and kindergarten children! This interactive bedtime app offers a heartwarming tale about overcoming fear and finding courage. Perfect for kids and early readers, it pr
bluejetty:00029282:ios.description:
Welcome to "Brave Bundee," a delightful story app designed for preschool and kindergarten children! This interactive bedtime app offers a heartwarming tale about overcoming fear and finding courage. Perfect for kids and early readers, it provides an engaging way to enjoy children’s books while practicing easy reading and learning to read.
— INTERACTIVE LEARNING FOR YOUNG LEARNERS
* Read Aloud & Learn Along: Enjoy professional narration with a friendly storyteller voice that lets children read aloud or follow along with the audio. With clear English text and narration, this book provides an easy way to learn new words, build confidence, and develop reading skills. It is especially helpful for beginner readers developing early reading comprehension.
* Engaging Activities: This interactive storybook lets kids tap, pull, pop, and drag objects, bringing the bunny's adventure to life with charming anime-style pictures and delightful sound effects. These activities make learning fun and help children stay engaged as they explore the story.
* Perfect for Bedtime: "Brave Bundee" is a short and gentle story that is ideal for bedtime. This book helps children unwind and prepare for sleep while introducing positive Christian messages about courage, faith, and peace. It makes a wonderful addition to a child's bedtime routine.
* Kid-Safe & Offline: Designed with children in mind, this app has no ads or in-app purchases. All narration, text, and activities work completely offline, allowing kids to enjoy their book anytime, anywhere. It is suitable for preschool, nursery school, and young children.
* Biblical Lessons: Brave Bundee is more than just a story. This Christian tale is inspired by Bible stories and Scripture-based lessons about faith, courage, and peace. Inspired by Bible verses such as Psalm 23:4 and John 14:27, it helps children learn about trusting God and finding peace even when they feel afraid.
* Have fun and enjoy the game-like experience! Interactive activities and playful moments make this more than a traditional book, giving children an enjoyable way to read, explore, and learn.
* This easy-to-read beginner storybook is perfect for preschoolers and starter readers. It helps build literacy, reading comprehension, confidence, and resilience through engaging Bible-based adventures centered on the teachings of Jesus and the courage to overcome fears.
— BIBLE VERSE
* Bible Verse 1: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me. (Psalm 23:4. ESV)
* Bible Verse 2: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. Not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid. (John 14:27. ESV)
— ENRICHING EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE
This educational book app is a helpful resource for preschool and kindergarten classrooms, homeschooling, and independent study. With simple language, beginner stories, and clear scriptural principles, children can practice easy reading while learning important lessons about courage, trust, and God's peace.
Whether used for quiet reading, bedtime, or early learning, "Brave Bundee" gives young readers an engaging introduction to children’s books and Christian stories.
— LANGUAGES
* English
* Spanish
* French
* Japanese
— WALA BEAR INC.
https://www.walabear.com

bluejetty:00040344:ios.description:
One minute a day to look after your emotional health. Make a note of your emotions, receive customised exercises and, if you wish, start your therapy with one of our psychologists.
ifeel: Emotional well-being for today.
Ifeel joins forces with companies to help employees to overcome the challenges of daily life with the support of registered psychologists specialising in a range of areas. Whether you need professional help or you simply want to take your personal development a step further, at ifeel you'll find the help you need through our comprehensive emotional well-being service for businesses. At ifeel everyone can have confidential access to the best personalised professional psychological support.
How does it work?
At ifeel we know that therapy requires continuity and that accessing it has to be easy. When you are assigned your therapist, you'll enter an "online therapy room" created exclusively for you. Your room is open 24 hours a day and is completely private and confidential; only you and your personal psychologist can read and write inside the room. This will be the place where the two of you will work to achieve your goals.
All our specialists are authorised to practise clinical psychology; they are registered and insured. They have been selected and well trained in our method. They are also regularly supervised and monitored.
How can ifeel help me?
Our online psychologists have helped thousands of people in the following areas:
- Personal development.
- Work-related stress.
- Depression.
- Anxiety.
- Eating disorders.
- Grief.
- Family problems.
- Sexuality.
You don’t feel ready to start therapy yet?
Asking for help isn't easy but it can be a good decision. If you don't yet feel able to take that step and you need encouragement, you can start off by using our free resources. We offer a wide variety of exercises to help you reduce your stress and deal with anxiety, a range of relaxation techniques, breathing programmes, articles of interest and mindfulness activities. All our tools have been developed by clinical psychologists in order to help you with the areas that concern you on a daily basis and are completely free of charge for all users of our emotional well-being service for businesses.
Contact us
Do you have any questions or suggestions? Please write to us at info@ifeelonline.com. We always reply to each message as quickly as possible.

bluejetty:00016222:ios.summary: Surround each clue with lines to form one single loop! Each puzzle consists of a rectangular lattice of dots with some clues in various places. The object is to connect the dots surrounding each clue so that the number of lines equals the v
bluejetty:00016222:ios.description:
Surround each clue with lines to form one single loop! Each puzzle consists of a rectangular lattice of dots with some clues in various places. The object is to connect the dots surrounding each clue so that the number of lines equals the value of the clue and the lines around all clues form one continuous loop with no crossings or branches. Empty squares may be surrounded by any number of lines.
Slitherlink are addictive loop-forming puzzles which were invented in Japan. Using pure logic and requiring no math to solve, these fascinating puzzles offer endless fun and intellectual entertainment to puzzle fans of all skills and ages.
The game features 2-finger tapping for quick zoom, auto complete clues setting and a link segment highlighting option to help to avoid creating separate loops. To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Slitherlink contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 200 free Slitherlink puzzles
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Multiple difficulty levels from very easy to extremely hard
• Grid sizes up to 16x22
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually selected, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Auto complete clues
• Highlight link segment
• Quick zoom using 2-finger tap
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Slitherlink have also become popular under other names such as Fences, Loop the Loop, Loopy, Suriza, Dotty Dilemma and Number Line. Similar to Sudoku, Kakuro and Hashi, the puzzles are solved using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

bluejetty:00016743:ios.description:
Get the latest Mega Millions results within moments of the draw taking place. This easy to use app shows the Mega Millions numbers and full prize breakdowns including the number of winners and prizes paid for each Multiplier option.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications
----------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest lottery results and prize breakdowns become available. The App allows you to customise notifications for specific lottery games and you can also choose which days of the week you play. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
-----------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on house numbers and anniversary dates!
Results Archive
----------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw of each lottery.
Settings
----------------------------
Customise which lotteries display in the app and in which order.
Support
----------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at contact@lottery.net.

apple-macos:6791101460.name: Formline: Workout & Food Log
apple-macos:6791101460.description:
Formline is a strength training and nutrition app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. It lines up your next workout, keeps each set clear, and tracks what you eat against your targets. Use it for training, for nutrition, or for both.
LOG WORKOUTS CURATED BY FORMLINE
• Get a program matched to your goal, experience, and the days you can train
• Choose from six built-in programs, or build your own with straight sets and alternating blocks
• Work one set at a time, with the movement, the load, the reps, and what you did last time
• See why each weight is suggested, and open any lift for its history
• Follow rest and progress on the Lock Screen and on Apple Watch
• Double tap on Apple Watch to save a set
• See your next workout in a widget, on the watch face, and in the Smart Stack
• Start any of your workouts from Siri or Shortcuts
• Swap an exercise or skip its remaining sets when the day changes
• Plan your week: move a workout to another day, change it, or make it a rest day, and undo any change
• Leave a note on a movement, like a seat height, and see it on the set screen next time
HIT YOUR MACROS
• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fat against daily targets set for your goal
• Search the food catalog or scan a barcode
• Add a food the catalog doesn’t have, from the label, per 100 g or per serving
• Put recipes together from your foods, and log them by the serving or by the gram
• Suggest a correction when a catalog food looks wrong
• Star your favorites so they come first in search
• Count water, on your iPhone, from Apple Watch, Siri, or Control Center, and see your day in Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Log the same meal again in one tap
• Pregnant? Add your week, and your targets follow it
KEEP YOUR STREAK
• A food streak counts the days you log, and a training streak counts the weeks you hit your target
• One spare flame a month covers a day or a week you missed
• Your streaks, workouts, and food log are saved in your iCloud, on every device you use
COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
• Start a private season and invite your friends
• A season can count workouts, the days you log food or hit your targets, or both
• Only display names, weekly points, and streak lengths are shared. Exercises, weights, foods, body data, and Health records are not.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Readiness each morning, from the sleep and heart readings in Apple Health
• Training history, and a page for every lift
• Completed workouts, and the food and water you log, saved to Apple Health, if you allow it
• Your weight from Apple Health, and how it moved in 30 days
• Every lift shows how it moved in the last 30 days
ON IPHONE, IPAD, MAC, AND APPLE WATCH
• One membership covers every device
• iPad and Mac have a layout made for the bigger screen
PRIVACY
Your workouts, meals, and Health data stay on your devices and with Apple. None of it is sent to us. A food search sends only the search term or the barcode. A correction you suggest sends only that food and your values for it.
ONE MEMBERSHIP
Choose monthly, three-month, six-month, or yearly billing. Every option unlocks the full app. New members pay $0.99 for their first month. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://formline.elbantli.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Simple drag and drop interface that works for adults and children. A simple tutorial on "How To Play" is included. Puzzles in each pack start easy and get harder the more you do.
HARD TO MASTER
Puzzles range from easy (solve in minutes) through to very hard (an hour or more). But don't worry, your placed pieces are automatically saved so you can do the puzzle over several sessions. You can also turn on and off useful guides like outlines or a ghost image depending on how hard you want it to be. And if some pieces are too small, just turn on the Auto-Zoom feature.
Can you earn all the Game Center achievements?
EDUCATIONAL
As you concentrate on each piece in the puzzle you see details of the artwork that aren't immediately obvious when looking at the completed piece. See the artwork as the original artist did - an element at a time. Once a puzzle is completed you can explore a zoomed in version to see all the detail.
PEACEFUL
An uncluttered puzzle solving space lets you be in the moment as you work your way through the puzzle at your own pace.
BEAUTIFUL
Work with some of the most beautiful and intriguing artworks from around the world and across the centuries.
HELPFUL
Some of the puzzles are hard. If you get stuck, use the Shuffle button to get new pieces, the Auto Fill feature to put those difficult pieces into their correct places or a Ghost image to help you find the right place.
CONNECTED
Works on your iPads and Macs. In-App purchases of puzzle packs are shared between your devices and you can easily enable synching up Puzzle completion progress between them. Start of one device and finish it on another.

apple-itunes:808183456.description:
تطبيق «مكتبة أنيس» :
١- متجر الكتروني يحتوي على الآف الكتب الرقمية في مختلف المواضيع، مع إمكانية شراء الكتب ومطالعتها بسهولة
٢- يتوفر فيه الكثير من الكتب المجانية 
٣ - دار نشر المنتجات الفكرية والعلمية، مما يتيح للناشرين والمؤلفين إمكانية نشر وتسويق كتبهم الرقمية بطريقة سريعة.
٤- قراءة الكتب الرقمية بإمكانيات:( مشاهدة فهرس الكتاب, وضع علامات مرجعية متعددة, تدوين ملاحظة وكتابة تعليق, تظليل نصوص الكلمات أو الجمل, تغيير حجم نصّ الكتاب )
٥- سهولة استخدام التطبيق 
٦- تقنية تشفير عالية الآمان لحماية الكتب
٧- تصميم عصري لواجهة التطبيق يمتاز بالبساطة والفخامة
٨- عمليات آمنة في الشراء والتحميل بإستخدام حساب متجر ابل 
المتجر:
«متجر أنيس » يحتوي على الآف الكتب الرقمية في مختلف المواضيع، مع إمكانية شراء الكتاب أو تحميله مباشرة (إذا كان مجاناً)
أهم ما يتميز به المتجر:
- تبويب الكتب حسب المواضيع مثل: ( العلوم القرآنية، العقائد، الحديث، الفقه، الأخلاق، الفلسفة، التراجم، التاريخ، اللغة، الطب... إلى آخره)
-عرض قائمة بأسماء المؤلفين مرتبة أبجدياً مع إمكانية البحث في أسمائهم
- عرض الكتب المميزة : "قائمة الكتب الأكثر تحميلاً" و "قائمة الكتب الأعلى تقييماً"
- إمكانية استرجاع الكتب المشتراة أو ما تم تحميله
- محرك بحث متطور ( نصي) أو ( موضوعي) 
- توفر نبذة في تعريف كل كتاب وتفاصيل هويته: (المؤلف، الناشر، عدد الصفحات وغيره)ء
-إمكانية كتابة رأي حول الكتاب ومشاهدة آراء الأعضاء
- خاصية تقييم الكتب ومشاهدة تقييمات الأعضاء
- إمكانية مشاركة صديق عبر البريد الإلكتروني ودعوته للاطلاع على الكتاب
المكتبة:
هي واجهة البرنامج الرئيسية ومكتبة المستخدم الشخصية، وتحتوي على الكتب المشتراة أو المحملة من المتجر
من خصائص المكتبة:
- تغيير اللغة : " العربية " - " الإنجليزية "
- تغيير لون واجهة تصميم المكتبة بين: "رخامي " و " خشبي "
- إمكانية البحث في عناوين ومؤلفي الكتب المعروضة في المكتبة
- يمكن للمستخدم تغيير ترتيب عرض الكتب في رفوف المكتبة بسحب الكتاب
- إمكانية تصنيف كتب المكتبة من قبل المستخدم وتبويبها ضمن مجموعات خاصة به
- تغيير حالة عرض قائمة الكتب حسب ترتيب: "رف الكتب" أو "العناوين" أو "المؤلفين" أو "المواضيع"
قارئ الكتاب:
- إمكانية تصفح الكتاب بسهولة وذلك بالنقر على جانبي الكتاب
- دعم محاذاة النص (من اليمين إلى اليسار)، ودعم ترقيم الصفحات بالعربية
- عرض النصوص المحركة والملونة وبتنسيقات وأحجام مختلفة
- مشاهدة فهرس الكتاب والانتقال المباشر إلى الفصل أو العنوان المختار
- وضع علامات مرجعية متعددة في صفحات الكتاب للرجوع إليها لاحقاً
- تدوين ملاحظة وكتابة تعليق على أية كلمة أو فقرة من الكتاب
- إمكانية تظليل النصوص - سواء جملة كانت أم كلمة - في الكتاب وتلوينه بلون معين
- مراجعة قائمة العلامات التي تم تسجيلها في الكتاب (العلامات المرجعية، التظليل والملاحظات)
- البحث عن كلمة أو عبارة في أي مكان من الكتاب وعرض نتائج البحث، مع إمكانية الانتقال المباشر
- البحث عن الكلمة أو العبارة من الكتاب في "جوجل" أو موقع "ويكيبيديا" مباشرة
- تحديد جزء من نص الكتاب ونسخه إلى حافظة الجهاز
- تغيير حجم نص الكتاب تكبيراً أو تصغيراً
- تغيير لون خلفية صفحات الكتاب من الأبيض إلى خلفية خافتة لسهولة القراءة
- إمكانية تنظيم سطوع الشاشة مباشرة من التطبيق لاختيار الإضاءة الملائمة لقراءة الكتاب
 - سهولة التصفح السريع في الكتاب وذلك بسحب مؤشر الصفحة الموجود في الأسفل

ADHAN AND REMINDERS

APPLE WATCH

WIDGETS, CONTROLS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES

QIBLA AND MORE

MAKE IT YOURS

• English, Arabic and Turkish
• Accessibility support, including VoiceOver and Dynamic Type
Light on battery and data, built on the latest Apple technologies.

Tesseract — private messaging that leaves no trail.
No accounts. No phone numbers. No cloud history. Add a friend with a one-time invite code, pick an emoji for each other, and start talking. Every message is end-to-end encrypted; the relay only ever sees opaque bytes.
Your identity lives in this device's secure keychain. Reinstall the app and it's gone — nothing is recoverable, from us or anyone else.
What you get for free
• End-to-end encrypted 1:1 chat (X25519 + AES-256-GCM)
• Emoji-based contacts instead of names or numbers
• Invite codes that expire in 24 hours or on first use
• Notification Disguise — 10 preset alt-icons and lock-screen texts
• App Lock with PIN + optional silent Duress PIN
• Minimalist brutalist interface built for speed
Unlock TESSERACT PLUS for the full suite
• TOR ROUTING — every request tunneled through Tor; the relay sees an exit node, never you
• GHOST TEXT — messages your eye reads but cameras average away
• PIXEL SHATTER — text realigns only at the owner's viewing angle
• CUSTOM TIMER — self-destructing messages that vanish from both phones
• PHOTOS · VIDEOS · GIFS — end-to-end encrypted media
• 30-DAY MAILBOX — missed messages held longer
Tesseract does not have a "delete for everyone" button because there is nothing to delete. Messages don't live on a server. The relay is a dumb pipe.

apple-macos:6761950044.name: GalacticAR for Education
apple-macos:6761950044.description:
GalacticAR for Education is the complete school edition of GalacticAR. Explore and learn about the universe, from comets and planets to black holes, galaxies, and the cosmos as a whole.
GalacticAR combines a comprehensive astronomy encyclopedia, interactive 3D models and scenes, and a quiz with 300 questions across multiple difficulty levels. Ideal for schools, classrooms, students, and anyone who wants a complete astronomy experience. It is available across Apple platforms as a one-time app purchase for educational use.
Features:
• 300 quiz questions to test and expand your knowledge
• 121 astronomical topics in the encyclopedia
• 43 interactive 3D models
• 16 immersive outer space scenes, from the Solar System to galaxies.
• 9 main categories: Comets, Asteroids, Moons, Planets, Solar System, Stars, Black Holes, Galaxies, and Universe.
• 8 Game Center achievements to collect
• 3 Game Center leaderboards to compete in
• 6 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese)
• Made for Vision Pro, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch.
